<!-- docs/content-parts/03-wysiwyg-html.md -->

# WYSIWYG HTML (content part 14)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt14.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt14.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt14.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt14.article.inc.php`

The rich text block edited in the WYSIWYG editor configured per backend user — CKEditor by default, TinyMCE as an alternative, or a plain textarea. The editor produces HTML, stored and output as entered. On top of the editor you can activate freely defined custom fields per template — the mechanism that turns a text part into a small structured template.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | Content part template from `template/inc_cntpart/wysiwyg/`. Changing it reloads the dialog when template-bound field groups exist. |
| HTML text | WYSIWYG editor, 15 rows | — | Main content, edited with the user's configured editor, 400 px height. |
| Custom fields | mixed | — | Optional. Each field renders from the definition in `$template_default['settings']['wysiwyg_custom_fields']` (`include/config/conf.template_default.inc.php`). Supported types: `str`, `textarea` (optionally with `render: 'wysiwyg'`), `option`, `select`, `int`, `float`, `bool`. Common definition keys: `legend`, `placeholder`, `default`, `class`, `hr`; textarea adds `rows`/`height`; `int`/`float` add `min`/`max`/`step`; `option`/`select` carry a `values` list where the `empty` key means "no value". |

### Custom fields configuration

Field groups are defined in `include/config/conf.template_default.inc.php` under `$template_default['settings']['wysiwyg_custom_fields']`; the shipped definitions are commented out, so the dialog shows only the editor until you enable one. A group is bound to a content part template through its `template` key, or to all templates with `template => 'default'`. Values survive in the dialog even when the group definition moves to another template: unbound stored values travel as hidden inputs.

## Rendering

### Template selection

Renderer order: selected file from `template/inc_cntpart/wysiwyg/<name>.tmpl`, else `template/inc_default/wysiwyg.tmpl`, else this built-in skeleton:

```html
[TITLE]<h3>{TITLE}</h3>[/TITLE]
[SUBTITLE]<h4>{SUBTITLE}</h4>[/SUBTITLE]
[TEXT]{TEXT}[/TEXT]
```

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]…[/ATTR_CLASS]` / `{ATTR_CLASS}` | Wrapper class and its conditional branch (`[ATTR_CLASS_ELSE]`). |
| `[ATTR_ID]…[/ATTR_ID]` / `{ATTR_ID}` | Wrapper `id` and its conditional branch. |
| `{TITLE}` / `{SUBTITLE}` | Content part title / subtitle, HTML-escaped. |
| `[TEXT]…[/TEXT]` / `{TEXT}` | The editor HTML, output as stored. |
| `{WYSIWYG_<FIELD>}` | Each custom field value by its uppercase field key. |
| `[WYSIWYG_<FIELD>]…[/WYSIWYG_<FIELD>]` | Conditional block, kept when the field has a value. |
| `[WYSIWYG_<FIELD>_ELSE]…[/WYSIWYG_<FIELD>_ELSE]` | Inverse conditional block. |
| `[WYSIWYG_<FIELD>_<OPTION>]…[/WYSIWYG_<FIELD>_<OPTION>]` | For `option`/`select` fields: the block of the selected value's key. |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID. |

How values render depends on the field definition: `bool` toggles the conditional block; `int`/`float` print the number; `render: 'html'` prints the stored markup; `render: 'markdown'` runs `parse_markdown()`; `render: 'plain'` runs `plaintext_htmlencode()`; `render: 'wysiwyg'` prints as stored; everything else prints HTML-escaped with line breaks converted.

## Storage

- Editor content: `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_html`
- Template: `acontent_template`
- Custom fields: serialized `cnt_fieldgroup` and `cnt_fields` in `acontent_form`

## Related

- Field-rich alternative text parts: [Text w/image (cp 1)](01-text-with-image.md)
- Raw markup alternative: [HTML (cp 6)](02-html.md)
- The same custom-field mechanism for image parts: [Images special (cp 31)](11-images-special.md)

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/04-code.md -->

# Code (content part 11)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt11.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt11.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt11.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt11.article.inc.php`

Displays source code as source code: the stored text is escaped and, unless the template already wraps it in `<pre>`, gets line break conversion. It never executes the content.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | Content part template from `template/inc_cntpart/code/`. Empty uses the shipped default. |
| Code | textarea, 15 rows | — | The code. Edits in the Ace code editor in PHP mode. Stored without trimming, so leading blank lines of the snippet survive. |

## Rendering

### Template selection

Renderer order: selected file from `template/inc_cntpart/code/<name>.tmpl`, else `template/inc_default/code.tmpl`, else this built-in skeleton:

```html
[TITLE]<h3>{TITLE}</h3>[/TITLE]
[SUBTITLE]<h4>{SUBTITLE}</h4>[/SUBTITLE]
[CODE]<code>{CODE}</code>[/CODE]
```

The shipped default `template/inc_default/code.tmpl` wraps the code in `<pre>` instead:

```html
[CODE]<pre>{CODE}</pre>[/CODE]
```

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]…[/ATTR_CLASS]` / `{ATTR_CLASS}` | Wrapper class and its conditional branch (`[ATTR_CLASS_ELSE]`). |
| `[ATTR_ID]…[/ATTR_ID]` / `{ATTR_ID}` | Wrapper `id` and its conditional branch. |
| `{TITLE}` / `{SUBTITLE}` | Content part title / subtitle, HTML-escaped. |
| `[CODE]…[/CODE]` / `{CODE}` | The escaped code. Removed when empty. |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID. |

### Output processing

The renderer prepares `{CODE}` as follows:

- HTML-escapes the text (`&`, `<`, `>`, quotes).
- Spaces become `&nbsp;`, tabs four `&nbsp;`.
- Square and curly brackets become numeric entities, so replacement tag syntax in the snippet is never interpreted.
- If the template contains no `<pre` tag, line breaks are converted with `nl2br()`.

## Storage

- Code: `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_text`
- Template: `acontent_template`

## Related

- Rendered markup instead of displayed source: [HTML (cp 6)](02-html.md)
- Unformatted text: [Plain text (cp 0)](00-plaintext.md)

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/05-list.md -->

# List (content part 4)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt4.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt4.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt4.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt4.article.inc.php`

A flat bullet list: one list entry per line, each rendered through the template's `<li>` markup. There are no nesting levels and no links — for indented or definition lists use [ul-list (cp 100)](06-list-ul.md). The backend labels both IDs "List".

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | Content part template from `template/inc_cntpart/bulletlist/`. Empty uses the shipped default. |
| List (table) | textarea, 20 rows | — | One entry per line. Empty lines are dropped, each line trimmed. Stored HTML-escaped. |

## Rendering

### Template selection

Renderer order: selected file from `template/inc_cntpart/bulletlist/<name>.tmpl`, else `template/inc_default/bulletlist.tmpl`, else this built-in skeleton:

```html
[TITLE]<h4>{TITLE}</h4>[/TITLE]
[SUBTITLE]<h5>{SUBTITLE}</h5>[/SUBTITLE]
[BULLETLIST]<ul class="bulletlist">{BULLETLIST}<!--BULLETLIST_ITEM_START//-->
    <li>{BULLETLIST_ITEM}</li>
<!--BULLETLIST_ITEM_END//--></ul>[/BULLETLIST]
```

The shipped default `template/inc_default/bulletlist.tmpl` is the same markup with `h3`/`h4` title levels and a plain `<ul>`. The `[BULLETLIST_ITEM]` section is the entry pattern: the renderer repeats it for every non-empty line, filling `{BULLETLIST_ITEM}` with the HTML-escaped line, and removes the section markers from the output.

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]…[/ATTR_CLASS]` / `{ATTR_CLASS}` | Wrapper class and its conditional branch (`[ATTR_CLASS_ELSE]`). |
| `[ATTR_ID]…[/ATTR_ID]` / `{ATTR_ID}` | Wrapper `id` and its conditional branch. |
| `{TITLE}` / `{SUBTITLE}` | Content part title / subtitle, HTML-escaped. |
| `[BULLETLIST]…[/BULLETLIST]` / `{BULLETLIST}` | The list block holding all entries; removed when no entries. |
| `{BULLETLIST_ITEM}` | Inside the entry section, one list entry. |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID. |

With no entries the whole `[BULLETLIST]` block is removed.

## Storage

- Entries, LF separated: `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_text`
- Template: `acontent_template`

## Related

- Nested and definition lists: [ul-list (cp 100)](06-list-ul.md)
- List of links: [Link list (cp 5)](08-linklist.md)

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/06-list-ul.md -->

# ul-list (content part 100)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt100.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt100.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt100.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt100.article.inc.php`

Builds a nested HTML list from plain text: one list entry per line, nesting depth marked by leading tildes. The output markup is hard-coded — this content part has no template.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| List type | radio group | `<ul>` | Output element: `<ul>` for an unstyled unordered list, `<ol>` for a numbered list, `<dl>` for a definition list. |
| List | textarea, 20 rows | — | One entry per line. `~` = first level, `~~` = second level, and so on; the first line always starts with a tilde. For `<dl>`, a `|` separates definition term and description. |

The backend hint reads "~ = 1st level, ~~ = 2nd level, etc.". A leading tilde is added automatically if missing; an empty list content renders in a plain text paragraph instead.

## Rendering

### Output markup

Depth is computed from the tilde count of every line and converted into nested elements without CSS classes:

```html
<ul>
<li>first level entry</li>
<ul>
<li>second level entry</li>
</ul>
</ul>
```

- `<ul>` (default) and `<ol>`: each line is one `<li>`; entry text passes `plaintext_htmlencode()`, so it is HTML-escaped, renders basic BBCode (`[b]`, `[i]`, `[u]`, `[s]`, `[strong]`, `[em]`, `[nowrap]`) and keeps single line breaks as `<br />`.
- `<dl>`: splits each line at `|` into one `<dt>` and, when a description follows, one `<dd>`.
- Without any `~` in the text, the raw content renders as escaped paragraph text in the default article text wrapper instead of a list.

## Storage

- List text: `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_text` (`mediumtext`), stored HTML-escaped
- List type: serialized `list_type` (0 = `<ul>`, 1 = `<ol>`, 2 = `<dl>`) in `acontent_form`

## Related

- Flat template-driven list: [List (cp 4)](05-list.md)
- Linked entries instead of plain text: [Link list (cp 5)](08-linklist.md)

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/07-link-email.md -->

# Link &amp; email (content part 3)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt3.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt3.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt3.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt3.article.inc.php`

Renders a single link — an external URL or a `mailto:` email address — as one anchor line. Link text and `href` are the same value, so for external URLs the address doubles as the label.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | Lists files from `template/inc_cntpart/linkemail/`. The default directory is empty and the renderer does not use content part templates, so the selection has no effect on the output. |
| Direct link | text | — | The URL or `mailto:` address. |
| Target | select | *(blank)* | Where the link opens: blank (same), "In a new window" (`_blank`), "In parent frame of the window" (`_parent`), "In same window without frames" (`_top`), "In the same frame or window" (`_self`). |

## Rendering

The output is fixed markup, not template driven — the anchor is wrapped by the layout defaults `$template_default['article']['link_email_before']` / `link_email_after` from `include/config/conf.template_default.inc.php`:

```html
<div class="link-email"><a href="mailto:name@example.com">name@example.com</a></div>
```

- The `href` is the stored link as typed; the visible link text is the link with any `mailto:` prefix removed, HTML-escaped.
- The `target` attribute is emitted only when a target is selected.

## Storage

- Link and target: `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_redirect`, stored as one string `<link> <target>`; split on rendering and on reopening the dialog
- Template: `acontent_template`

## Related

- A list of links: [Link list (cp 5)](08-linklist.md)
- Page-internal teasers with links: [Teaser/link article (cp 8)](17-teaser-link-article.md)

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/08-linklist.md -->

# Link list (content part 5)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt5.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt5.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt5.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt5.article.inc.php`

A list of external links edited as plain text: one entry per line, each line a name, a URL, and optionally a tooltip title. The template defines the entry markup, so you can turn the list into any HTML shape the entry pattern can express.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | Content part template from `template/inc_cntpart/linklist/`. Empty uses the shipped default. |
| Linklist | textarea, 20 rows | — | One entry per line: `name | link | title`. |

### Line syntax

Fields are separated by `|`; the title field is optional.

```text
phpwcms home | https://www.phpwcms.org/ | The phpwcms website
Support forum | https://forum.phpwcms.org/ | EN and DE boards
https://www.phpwcms.org/
```

- A line with the URL only: the URL becomes the link value, and the link text falls back to the URL as well.
- Title empty: no `title` attribute.
- Multiple spaces collapse to one before storage; the second whitespace-separated word of the link field is the frame target (for example `https://example.org/ _blank`).

## Rendering

### Template selection

Renderer order: selected file from `template/inc_cntpart/linklist/<name>.tmpl`, else `template/inc_default/linklist.tmpl`, else this built-in skeleton:

```html
[TITLE]<h4>{TITLE}</h4>[/TITLE]
[SUBTITLE]<h5>{SUBTITLE}</h5>[/SUBTITLE]
[LINKLIST]<ul class="linklist">{LINKLIST}</ul>[/LINKLIST]
```

The entry pattern comes from the template's `[LINKLIST_ENTRY]` section:

```html
[LINK]<li><a href="{LINK}"{TARGET}{LINKTITLE}>{LINKNAME}</a></li>[/LINK]
```

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]…[/ATTR_CLASS]` / `{ATTR_CLASS}` | Wrapper class and its conditional branch (`[ATTR_CLASS_ELSE]`). |
| `[ATTR_ID]…[/ATTR_ID]` / `{ATTR_ID}` | Wrapper `id` and its conditional branch. |
| `{TITLE}` / `{SUBTITLE}` | Content part title / subtitle, HTML-escaped. |
| `[LINKLIST]…[/LINKLIST]` / `{LINKLIST}` | The list block holding all entries; removed when empty. |
| `[LINK]…[/LINK]` | The entry pattern inside the `[LINKLIST_ENTRY]` section. |
| `{LINK}` | The URL, HTML-escaped. `#` when no link value exists. |
| `{TARGET}` | `target="…"` attribute from the link field's second word, empty otherwise. |
| `{LINKNAME}` | Link text: the name, or the link value when no name is given. HTML-escaped. |
| `{LINKTITLE}` | `title="…"` attribute from the third field, empty otherwise. |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID. |

The section between `<!--LINKLIST_SPACE_START//-->` and `<!--LINKLIST_SPACE_END//-->` renders between entries; both markers sit together in the shipped default and are invisible there.

## Storage

- Normalized entries, one `name | link | title` line each, LF separated: `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_text`
- Template: `acontent_template`

## Related

- Single link output: [Link &amp; email (cp 3)](07-link-email.md)
- Downloads as a list: [File list (cp 7)](16-filelist.md)

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/09-images.md -->

# Images (content part 2)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt2.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt2.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt2.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt2.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/img.func.inc.php` (`imagelisttable()`)

The classic image gallery content part: a list of images from the file center, arranged in columns and one of eight positions, each with its own single-line caption. Rendering goes through `imagelisttable()`, which emits either an HTML `<table>` or a `<div>` sequence depending on the Table switch. Despite its `imagetable` template names this is the "Images" content part; [Images &lt;div&gt;](10-images-div.md) and [Images special](11-images-special.md) are the structured successors.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(default)* | Template file from `template/inc_cntpart/imagetable/`. Empty uses `template/inc_default/imagetable.tmpl`. |
| Images | multi-select | — | Images picked in the file browser (`filebrowser.php?opt=1`), sortable up/down, removable. The select order is the output order. |
| Position | icon group 0–7 | 0 | 0 top left, 1 top center, 2 top right, 3 bottom left, 4 bottom center, 5 bottom right, 6 float left, 7 float right. |
| Table | switch, next to Position | off | Render the image rows as an HTML `<table>` instead of `div` wrappers. |
| Max width / Max height | number px | `imagegallery_default_width` (490) / `imagegallery_default_height` (370) | Thumbnail size. With `RESPONSIVE_MODE` off the width is capped to `(content_width − (columns − 1) × space) / columns`, divided by 1.75 additionally for positions 6/7. |
| Crop thumbnail | switch | off | Crop thumbnails to the given size instead of proportional scaling. |
| Images max. | select | All | Renders only the first N images of the list (options 1 to list count + 10). Combination with random allows "N random images" teasers. |
| Select images randomly | switch | off | Shuffles the image list before rendering. |
| Column | select 1–25 | 1 (`imagegallery_default_column`) | Images per row; capped to the number of images. |
| Image space | number px | 0 (`imagegallery_default_space`) | Spacing between image columns in table mode. |
| Click enlarge | switch | off | Link each image to a large version, by default as lightbox. |
| Gallery image | switch | off | Group images for the lightbox (`rel="lightbox[<group>]"`); implies Click enlarge. |
| Hide caption for thumbnails | switch | off | Suppress caption output. |
| Caption | textarea, one line per image | — | Line n describes image n. Format per line: `caption \| alt \| link target \| title \| copyright`. |

## Rendering

### Template selection

Order: selected file from `template/inc_cntpart/imagetable/<name>.tmpl`, else `template/inc_default/imagetable.tmpl`, else the built-in wrapper (`[ATTR_CLASS]…[IMAGETABLE]{IMAGETABLE}[/IMAGETABLE]…`). The shipped default wraps the table output:

```html
<div class="image-table images-count-{IMAGE_COUNT}" id="imgtable-id-{ID}">
    {IMAGETABLE}
</div>
```

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[IMAGETABLE]…[/IMAGETABLE]` | The complete `imagelisttable()` output. |
| `{IMAGE_COUNT}` | Number of stored images. |
| `{ATTR_CLASS}` / `[ATTR_CLASS]…[/ATTR_CLASS]` | Content part wrapper class (`acontent_attr_class`), `[ATTR_CLASS_ELSE]` fallback branch. |
| `{ATTR_ID}` / `[ATTR_ID]…[/ATTR_ID]` | Wrapper `id`. |
| `{TITLE}` / `{SUBTITLE}` | Content part title / subtitle — rendered into the template only when the template text contains the string `TITLE`; otherwise titles are appended by `headline()` relative to the image block, depending on the position. |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID. |

### IMAGETABLE_SETTINGS

The `[IMAGETABLE_SETTINGS]` INI section (comment style `key = value`) merges over the stored backend values. Keys read by the code:

```ini
[IMAGETABLE_SETTINGS]
class_top_left         = imgtable-top-left
class_top_center       = imgtable-top-center
class_top_right        = imgtable-top-right
class_bottom_left      = imgtable-bottom-left
class_bottom_center    = imgtable-bottom-center
class_bottom_right     = imgtable-bottom-right
class_float_left       = imgtable-left
class_float_right      = imgtable-right
class_image_thumb      = image-thumb
class_image_wrapper    = image-wrapper
class_image_link       = image-link
class_image_zoom       = image-zoom
class_image_lightbox   = image-lightbox
width / height / zoom / crop / lightbox / nocaption / col / space / limit / random =
                        override the stored backend values
```

The shipped default template also lists a commented `colspace` key; the renderer reads `space`, not `colspace`.

### Output

Table mode (`Table` on): one `<table class="imagelist-table">` with an image `<td>` per column, spacer `<td>`s of `space` px, and a second caption row below each image row.

Div mode (`Table` off): one wrapper `<div class="image-table">` (or the value of the `class` setting) containing per image:

```html
<div class="image-wrapper first row-1">
    <img src="/img/…" data-image-id="12" data-image-hash="…" data-image-ext="jpg"
         alt="…" title="…" class="image-thumb" />
    <p style="width:<thumb width>px" class="caption">Caption text <span class="copyright">© …</span></p>
</div>
```

The first image of a row carries `first`, rows are numbered `row-1`, `row-2`, … . Classes come from the `class_image_*` settings (merged over `template_default['classes']`).

Zoom behavior: without Gallery image the thumbnail links to `image_zoom.php?…` (popup via `clickZoom()`); with Gallery image the link points at the enlarged image (`img_prev_width` × `img_prev_height`, default 978 × 734) and carries `rel="lightbox[<group>]"` plus the caption as `title`. If the caption itself carries a link segment, the image links to that URL instead, in both modes. The lightbox script is `initSlimbox()`.

> **Note:** Since 2.0, `initSlimbox()` initializes [GLightbox](../general/concepts.md); the `rel="lightbox[…]"` attributes are kept for compatibility.

## Storage

- Everything except the template name is serialized into `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form`: `images` (list of `id,name,hash,ext,width,height,caption` tuples), `width`, `height`, `pos`, `col`, `zoom`, `space`, `lightbox`, `nocaption`, `crop`, `random`, `limit`, `usetable`
- Template file name: `acontent_template`

## Related

- Single image variant: [Text w/image (cp 1)](01-text-with-image.md)
- Successors with full template sections: [Images &lt;div&gt; (cp 29)](10-images-div.md), [Images special (cp 31)](11-images-special.md)
- Hover-swap gallery: [Rollover images (cp 50)](14-rollover-images.md)

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/10-images-div.md -->

# Images &lt;div&gt; (content part 29)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt29.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt29.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt29.takeval.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt29.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt29.article.inc.php`

The structured successor of [Images (cp 2)](09-images.md): images render through free `IMAGES_HEADER` / `IMAGES_ENTRY` / `IMAGES_FOOTER` template sections producing `div` wrappers, which plain templates ship as simple grids and slider templates (Bootstrap 5 carousel, Slick, Splide) as sliders. Supports image centering, a WYSIWYG intro text and per-content-part custom fields defined in the article layout template.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(default)* | Template file from `template/inc_cntpart/images/` (files starting with `list.` are hidden). Empty uses `template/inc_default/images.tmpl`. |
| Image alignment | select | Do not center | 0 no centering, 1 center horizontal/vertical, 2 center horizontal, 3 center vertical. Disabled unless max width and max height are both set. |
| Max width / Max height | number px | `imagegallery_default_width` (490) / `imagegallery_default_height` (370) | Thumbnail size. |
| Crop thumbnail | switch | off | Crop to the given size; disabled unless both sizes are set. |
| Images max. | number | All | Limit the number of rendered images. |
| Select images randomly | switch | off | Shuffle the image list. |
| Column | select 1–25 | 1 (`imagegallery_default_column`) | Images per row; drives `[FIRST]`/`[LAST]` and the row structure. |
| Image space | number px | 0 (`imagegallery_default_space`) | Value of `{SPACE}`; spacing handled by the template (entry/row spacer sections). |
| Click enlarge | switch | off | Link each image to the enlarged image (`img_prev_width` × `img_prev_height`). |
| Gallery image | switch | off | Group images for the lightbox (`rel="lightbox[…]"`); implies Click enlarge. |
| Hide caption for thumbnails | switch | off | Removes `[CAPTION]` and `[CAPTION_ELSE]` output entirely. |
| Images | multi-select | — | File center images, sortable; select order is the render order. |
| Caption | textarea, one line per image | — | Line n describes image n. Format: `caption \| alt \| link target \| title \| copyright`; alt/title/copyright fall back to the file center values of the image. |
| Custom fields | per field group | — | Fields defined in the article layout template setting `imgdiv_custom_fields`; the group is bound to the selected template. Types: `str`, `textarea`, `option`, `select`, `int`, `float`, `bool`, `file`. |
| Text | WYSIWYG / HTML | — | Intro text, rendered at `{TEXT}` in the header section. |

There is no position selector; the renderer ignores the position value stored in `acontent_form`.

## Rendering

### Template selection

Order: when the article renders in list mode, `inc_default/list.images.tmpl` or `inc_cntpart/images/list.<selected>`, else `inc_default/images.tmpl` or `inc_cntpart/images/<selected>`. With no template selected and no default file present nothing renders (no built-in skeleton).

The template consists of INI-like `IMAGE_SETTINGS` plus comment-marked sections `<!--IMAGES_HEADER_START//-->…`, `IMAGES_ENTRY`, `IMAGES_ENTRY_SPACER`, `IMAGES_ROW_SPACER`, `IMAGES_FOOTER`. Content outside these sections is ignored.

### IMAGE_SETTINGS

```ini
; settings will overwrite CP settings
;width          = 100
;height         = 100
;col            = 1
;zoom           = 1
;crop           = 0
;space          = 10
;lightbox       = 1
;nocaption      = 0
;thumb_class    = image-responsive
;random         = 0
;limit          = 0
;hide_limited   = 0    ; 1 = images beyond limit stay in the DOM, hidden
;center_image   = 0    ; 0 none, 1 h/v, 2 horizontal, 3 vertical
;image_class_center_center     = image-center-center
;image_class_center_horizontal = image-center-horizontal
;image_class_center_vertical   = image-center-vertical
```

Centering adds `image-center-*` classes and inline `margin` styles that equalize the empty space around smaller thumbnails.

### Template tags

Entry section (`IMAGES_ENTRY`), filled per image:

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{IMAGE}` | The complete `<img>` plus, when linked, the wrapping `<a>`. |
| `[LINK]…[/LINK]` | Same wrapping link markup, independent of the image. |
| `{IMGID}` | Zero-based index of the image in the list. |
| `{ROW_COUNT}` | Same value as `{IMGID}`. |
| `{ENTRY_ID}` / `{ENTRY_NUM}` | 0-based / 1-based position of the rendered image. |
| `[FIRST]` / `[LAST]` | Present on the first / last image of a row; filled with the column number. |
| `[IMAGE_FIRST]` / `[IMAGE_LAST]` | Present on the first / last image of the whole set. |
| `[ROW]…[/ROW]` | Filled with the row number (1-based). |
| `{IMGNAME}` | HTML-escaped file name. |
| `{THUMB_NAME}` `{THUMB_REL}` `{THUMB_ABS}` `{THUMB_WIDTH}` `{THUMB_HEIGHT}` `{THUMB_COLUMNS}` | Thumbnail info; `REL` is relative to the site root, `ABS` absolute. |
| `{IMAGE_ID}` `{IMAGE_HASH}` `{IMAGE_EXT}` | File ID, hash, extension of the current image. |
| `[ZOOM]…[/ZOOM]` | Present when the image is enlarged. `{IMAGE_NAME}` `{IMAGE_REL}` `{IMAGE_ABS}` `{IMAGE_WIDTH}` `{IMAGE_HEIGHT}` describe the enlarged image (empty without zoom). |
| `[CAPTION]…[/CAPTION]` / `[CAPTION_ELSE]…[/CAPTION_ELSE]` | Caption text; `_ELSE` branch renders on images without a caption text. Both blocks vanish when "Hide caption" is set. |
| `[COPYRIGHT]…[/COPYRIGHT]` | Copyright part of the caption line. |
| `[TITLE]…[/TITLE]` / `[ALT]…[/ALT]` | Caption title / alt segments. |
| `[URL]…[/URL]` / `[URL_TARGET]…[/URL_TARGET]` | Link URL and target from the caption link segment. |
| `[HIDDEN]…[/HIDDEN]` | Filled with `style="display:hidden"` when `hide_limited = 1` and the image is beyond the limit (the shipped default template writes `style="display:none"` into this block). |
| `[LANDSCAPE]…[/LANDSCAPE]` | Filled with the letter `L` for images wider than tall (raster images are measured live, SVG by stored size); both branches are stripped when the file is not readable. |

Header / footer section, filled once:

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID. |
| `{IMAGE_COUNT}` | Number of rendered images (after the limit). |
| `{THUMB_WIDTH_MAX}` / `{THUMB_HEIGHT_MAX}` | Largest rendered thumbnail dimensions. |
| `{SPACE}` | Stored image space value. |
| `[DATA]…{DATA}…[/DATA]` | `ENTRY_DATA` sections of all entries, concatenated. Slider templates put their indicator markup here. |
| `{ATTR_CLASS}` / `[ATTR_CLASS]…[/ATTR_CLASS]`, `{ATTR_ID}` / `[ATTR_ID]…[/ATTR_ID]` | Wrapper class / id with `[…_ELSE]` branches. |
| `[TITLE]` `{TITLE}`, `[SUBTITLE]` `{SUBTITLE}`, `[TEXT]` `{TEXT}` | Content part title, subtitle and raw WYSIWYG text. |
| `[IMAGE_CLASS_CENTER]…[/IMAGE_CLASS_CENTER]` | Filled with the centering class when centering is active. |
| `[IMGDIV_<FIELD>…]` | Custom field values (uppercase field key); `bool` renders a presence marker, `option`/`select` also fill `[IMGDIV_<FIELD>_<OPTION>]` per value, `file` renders the file list renderer (cnt 7), `render` keys `html`/`markdown`/`plain`/`wysiwyg` choose the output mode. |

`ENTRY_DATA` must be nested inside the `IMAGES_ENTRY` section: the renderer cuts it out of each rendered entry and collects the pieces for `{DATA}` in the footer.

## Storage

- Image list, options, custom fields: serialized in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` (`images`, `width`, `height`, `col`, `space`, `zoom`, `crop`, `center_image`, `lightbox`, `nocaption`, `limit`, `random`, `fieldgroup`, `custom`)
- WYSIWYG intro text: `acontent_text`
- Template name: `acontent_template`

## Related

- Table-based classic: [Images (cp 2)](09-images.md)
- Image with per-image detail tabs: [Images special (cp 31)](11-images-special.md)
- [Content part templates](../general/concepts.md#templates)

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/11-images-special.md -->

# Images special (content part 31)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt31.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt31.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt31.takeval.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt31.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt31.article.inc.php`

A gallery where every entry is an accordion tab with its own thumbnail image, zoom image, caption, info text, URL and custom fields. Thumbnail and zoom version are picked independently, so the small view and the enlarged view can be different files. Renders through the same section-based template scheme as [Images &lt;div&gt;](10-images-div.md) but with its own template folder and tag set.

## Backend form

Global settings, top to bottom:

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(default)* | Template file from `template/inc_cntpart/imagespecial/` (files starting with `list.` are hidden). Empty uses `template/inc_default/imagespecial.tmpl`. |
| Image alignment | select | Do not center | 0 none, 1 center h/v, 2 center horizontal, 3 center vertical; disabled without thumbnail size. |
| Column / Image space | select 1–25 / number px | 1 / 0 (`imagegallery_default_*`) | Images per row and `{SPACE}` value. |
| Thumbnail: Width / Height / Crop | number px, switch | `imagegallery_default_width` (490) / `imagegallery_default_height` (370) / off | Thumbnail size and crop. |
| Zoom: Width / Height / Crop image | number px, switch | `img_prev_width` (978) / `img_prev_height` (734) / off | Size of the enlarged image and crop switch. |
| Click enlarge | switch | off | Enable the zoom link. |
| Gallery image | switch | off | Group images for the lightbox (`rel="lightbox[…]"`); implies Click enlarge. |
| Hide caption for thumbnails | switch | off | Suppress caption output. |
| Effect 1 / 2 / 3 | switches | off | Fill the `[EFFECT_1]` / `[EFFECT_2]` / `[EFFECT_3]` conditional template blocks. |

Per-image entries (sortable accordion, add top/bottom, per-entry on/off toggle):

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| Thumbnail | file select | Image shown small. An entry without one is skipped in rendering. |
| Zoomed view | file select | Image shown enlarged; falls back to the thumbnail when empty. |
| Caption | textarea | Pipe format `caption \| alt \| link target \| title \| copyright`; missing values fall back to the file center metadata of the thumbnail file. |
| Info text | textarea | Per-image text, rendered at `[INFOTEXT]` with the mode from `text_render`. |
| URL | text | Rendered at `[URL]` / `[URL_TARGET]`; second word is the target. |
| Custom fields | per field group | Fields from `imagespecial_custom_fields` in the article layout template, bound to the selected template; same types as [Images &lt;div&gt;](10-images-div.md#backend-form). |
| Active | toggle | Off-entries stay editable but are not rendered. |

A WYSIWYG HTML editor (field `image_html`) sits below the entry list.

## Rendering

### Template selection

List mode: `inc_default/list.imagespecial.tmpl` or `inc_cntpart/imagespecial/list.<selected>`; article page: `inc_default/imagespecial.tmpl` or `inc_cntpart/imagespecial/<selected>`. Sections and INI handling are identical to [Images &lt;div&gt;](10-images-div.md#rendering) (`IMAGE_SETTINGS`, `IMAGES_HEADER`, `IMAGES_ENTRY`, `IMAGES_ENTRY_SPACER`, `IMAGES_ROW_SPACER`, `IMAGES_FOOTER`; content outside sections is ignored).

### IMAGE_SETTINGS

Same keys as Images &lt;div&gt;, plus the special variants:

```ini
;width_zoom     = 600   ; zoom image width
;height_zoom    = 600   ; zoom image height
;center         = 2     ; 0 none, 1 h/v, 2 horizontal, 3 vertical
;crop_zoom      = 0     ; crop the zoom image
;fx1 / fx2 / fx3 = 0    ; effect switches
;text_render = plain    ; info text mode: plain, text, html, markdown, textile
```

`text_render` defaults to `plain` (HTML-encoded, line breaks kept as entered).

### Template tags

Entry section, per image:

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{IMAGE}` | The complete `<img>` plus, when linked, the wrapping `<a>`. |
| `{IMGID}` / `{ROW_COUNT}` | List index of the entry (0-based). |
| `{IMGNAME}` | File name of the thumbnail entry. |
| `{ENTRY_ID}` / `{ENTRY_NUM}` | 0-based / 1-based rendered position. |
| `{THUMB_ID}` `{THUMB_HASH}` `{THUMB_EXT}` `{THUMB_FILENAME}` `{THUMB_NAME}` `{THUMB_REL}` `{THUMB_ABS}` `{THUMB_WIDTH}` `{THUMB_HEIGHT}` | Thumbnail file data and resized name. |
| `{IMAGE_ID}` `{IMAGE_HASH}` `{IMAGE_EXT}` `{IMAGE_FILENAME}` `{IMAGE_NAME}` `{IMAGE_REL}` `{IMAGE_ABS}` `{IMAGE_WIDTH}` `{IMAGE_HEIGHT}` | Zoom image data; empty without zoom. |
| `[ZOOM]…[/ZOOM]` | Present when the image is enlarged. |
| `{LIGHTBOX}` | `rel="lightbox[…]"` attribute string when Gallery image is on; empty otherwise. |
| `{LIGHTBOX_CAPTION}` | `title="…"` attribute for the lightbox link. |
| `[CAPTION]` / `[CAPTION_ELSE]`, `[COPYRIGHT]`, `[TITLE]`, `[ALT]` | Caption parts, as in Images &lt;div&gt;. |
| `[LINK]…[/LINK]` | The wrapping link markup around the image. |
| `{IMAGE_URL}` / `{IMAGE_TARGET}` | Caption link URL and raw target. |
| `[INFOTEXT]…[/INFOTEXT]` | Info text in the `text_render` mode. |
| `[URL]…[/URL]` / `[URL_TARGET]…[/URL_TARGET]` | Website URL field of the entry. |
| `[FIRST]` / `[LAST]` / `[IMAGE_FIRST]` / `[IMAGE_LAST]` / `[ROW]` | Row and set position markers, values as in Images &lt;div&gt;. |
| `[EFFECT_1]` / `[EFFECT_2]` / `[EFFECT_3]` | Present when the matching effect switch is on. |
| `[IMGSPCL_<FIELD>…]` | Custom field values (uppercase key), option-conditional variants included, `file` fields render the file list renderer. |

Centering emits inline `margin` styles that pad the thumbnail to the configured size.

The caption link segment (third pipe segment) links the image; the entry's own URL field only fills `[URL]` and does not wrap the image.

## Storage

- Whole CP: serialized in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` (`width`, `height`, `width_zoom`, `height_zoom`, `col`, `space`, `zoom`, `lightbox`, `nocaption`, `center`, `crop`, `crop_zoom`, `fx1`–`fx3`, `fieldgroup`, `images` list with `thumb_id`, `zoom_id`, `thumb_name`, `zoom_name`, `sort`, `caption`, `freetext`, `url`, `active`, `thumb_hash`, `thumb_ext`, `zoom_hash`, `zoom_ext`, `custom_fields`)
- WYSIWYG HTML: `acontent_html` (fills `{TEXT}`)
- Template name: `acontent_template`

## Related

- Base gallery: [Images (cp 2)](09-images.md), [Images &lt;div&gt; (cp 29)](10-images-div.md)
- [Content part templates](../general/concepts.md#templates)

# Multimedia (content part 9)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt9.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt9.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt9.takeval.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt9.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt9.article.inc.php`

Embeds one media file — internal from the file center or external by URL — at a chosen position in the article. Player options 0–2 render HTML5 `<video>`/`<audio>` elements; option 3 renders a Flash `<object>` with SWFObject registration. The legacy plugin names (Quicktime, RealPlayer, MediaPlayer) only switch the rendering branch to HTML5.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(default)* | Template file from `template/inc_cntpart/multimedia/`. Empty uses `template/inc_default/multimedia.tmpl`. |
| Media type | radio | Video | Video, Audio, Flash. Choosing Flash forces the Flash Plugin player, choosing Video/Audio switches it back. |
| Player | radio | Quicktime | Quicktime, RealPlayer, MediaPlayer render as HTML5; Flash Plugin renders a Flash object. |
| Show control bar | switch | off | Adds `controls` to the HTML5 element. |
| Autoplay | switch | off | Adds `autoplay`. |
| Flash transparent | switch | off | Flash only: `wmode` `transparent` instead of `opaque`. |
| Source | radio + input | Internal | Internal: file from the media browser (`filebrowser.php?opt=2`). External: full URL (`https://…`). |
| Position | icon group 0–4 | 0 | 0 top left, 1 top center, 2 top right, 3 float left, 4 float right. |
| Width / Height | number px | — | Player box size; preset buttons fill 160×120, 240×180, 320×240, 480×360; a clear button empties both. |
| Alt. image | file select | — | Image shown as fallback content inside the player element, resized to the player size. |
| Alt. text | textarea | — | Caption/fallback text rendered below the alt image. |

## Rendering

Source resolution: an external URL wins; otherwise the internal file is loaded from `phpwcms_file` (public and active; granted-restricted files need a frontend login) and served as `filearchive/<hash>.<ext>`.

### HTML5 players (Quicktime / RealPlayer / MediaPlayer)

Audio detection: media type Audio, or a file ending in `mp3, m4a, aac, wav, oga, ogg, flac, wma, ra`.

```html
<audio id="mediaID<cp id>" controls autoplay preload="metadata">
  <source src="<source>" type="audio/mpeg">
  <div class="alt-image"><img src="/img/cmsimage.php/<w>x<h>x1/<id>/<name>" alt="…" /></div>Alt. text
</audio>
```

```html
<video id="mediaID<cp id>" width="…" height="…" controls autoplay playsinline
       preload="metadata" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;">
  <source src="<source>" type="video/mp4">
  …alt content…
</video>
```

The MIME type maps from the file's stored type: `video/quicktime` and `mov|mp4|m4v` become `video/mp4`, `webm` stays `video/webm`, `ogv|ogg` becomes `video/ogg`. Without a detected type the defaults are `video/mp4` and `audio/mpeg`.

### Flash player (Flash Plugin)

Renders the nested Internet Explorer-safe `<object>` markup (classid, `param movie/quality/scale/loop/play/wmode`, inner `<object type="application/x-shockwave-flash">`) and registers it through SWFObject (`initSwfObject()`); width/height fall back to the measured media size when empty and the source is local. The alt image and text are the fallback content.

### Positions

Position 0–2 print the title/subtitle headline and wrap the code in `align` divs (`center`, `right`); positions 3/4 wrap it in a `<table align="left|right">` with title in `tableHead` and subtitle in `tableSubHead` cells. With no media source only the headline renders.

### Template

Order: `template/inc_default/multimedia.tmpl`, else `template/inc_cntpart/multimedia/<selected>`, else built-in. Tags:

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[MULTIMEDIA]…[/MULTIMEDIA]` / `[MULTIMEDIA_ELSE]…[/MULTIMEDIA_ELSE]` | Player output block; `_ELSE` branch when nothing is rendered. |
| `{MULTIMEDIA}` | The player markup. |
| `{ATTR_CLASS}` / `[ATTR_CLASS]…[/ATTR_CLASS]`, `{ATTR_ID}` / `[ATTR_ID]…[/ATTR_ID]` | Wrapper class / id with `_ELSE` branches. |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID. |

## Storage

- All settings serialized in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form`: `media_type`, `media_player`, `media_src`, `media_auto`, `media_transparent`, `media_control`, `media_pos`, `media_width`, `media_height`, `media_id`, `media_name`, `media_extern`, `image_name`, `image_id`, `image_caption`
- `acontent_media` is written as an empty string
- Template name: `acontent_template`

## Related

- Video/audio player with format variants: [HTML5/Flash media player (cp 25)](13-flashplayer.md)
- [Text w/image (cp 1)](01-text-with-image.md) for image positions

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/13-flashplayer.md -->

# HTML5/Flash media player (content part 25)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt25.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt25.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt25.takeval.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt25.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt25.article.inc.php`

A single media player with per-format sources (H.264, WebM, Ogg/MP3), rendered as a [Video.js](https://videojs.com) `<video>`/`<audio>` element. When "HTML5 only" is off the player initializes through Video.js and keeps a Flash fallback object (NonverBlaster via SWFObject) for legacy media.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(default)* | Template file from `template/inc_cntpart/flashplayer/`. Empty uses `template/inc_default/flashplayer.tmpl`. |
| Player size | select + Width/Height px | 320 × 240 | Presets include 240p…2160p (4k), 21:9 variants and fixed sizes (`template_default['settings']['html5_player']['sizes']`). |
| HTML5 H.264 | internal/external | Internal | `mp4, m4v, mov, m4p, m4a, mp3, aac, mpeg`; media browser filter `opt=12`. |
| HTML5 WebM | internal/external | Internal | `webm`; `opt=13`. |
| HTML5 Ogg | internal/external | Internal | `ogg, ogv, oga, ogx`; `opt=14`. |
| Flash | internal/external | Internal | Fallback media: `mp4, mp3, flv, mov, swf, f4v, m4v, jpg, png`; `opt=6`. With no HTML5 source the player renders as pure SWFObject embed. |
| Caption | textarea | — | Rendered at `[CAPTION]`. |
| Link | text | — | `URL target`; the URL also becomes the Flash `onClick` target. |
| Thumbnail | file select | — | Poster/teaser image, rendered cropped (`/<w>x<h>x1x85/`) via the image resize endpoint. |
| Markers | textarea | — | One per line: `time \| text \| overlay text \| css class`; time as seconds (`10.5`). Passed as JSON to the Video.js instance. |
| HTML5 only | switch | off | Raw `<video>`/`<audio>` tag without Video.js and without Flash fallback. |
| Audio only | switch | off | Renders `<audio>` and maps sources to `audio/*` MIME types. |
| Autostart | switch | off | `autoplay="autoplay"`. |
| Loop | switch | off | `loop="loop"`. |
| Hide HTML5 download button | switch | off | Adds `controlsList="nodownload"`. |
| Preload | select | auto | `auto`, `metadata`, `none` — emitted as `preload` attribute. |
| Skin HTML5 | select | default | CSS from `template/lib/video-js/skins/<name>.css`; adds a stylesheet link and the skin class. |
| Controlbar | select | bottom | `bottom` (default) or `over` add `controls="controls"`, `none` drops it; `none` also disables the Flash `controlsEnabled`. |
| Volume | select 0–100, step 5 | 80 | Set through `this.volume(…)` on the Video.js instance; 0 adds `muted` to the tag. |
| Background color / Foreground color (HEX) | text | 000000 / FFFFFF | Flash control bar colors (`controlBackColor`, `controlColor`, `bgcolor`). |
| Watermark (URL) | text | — | Flash-only `indentImageURL` logo overlay. |

Internal media plays through `download.php?file=<hash>[.<ext>]&type=<mime>`; on iOS an `&ios=/` parameter is appended. Files with image extensions (`jpeg, jpg, png, gif, swf`) cancel the poster image.

## Rendering

### Video.js element

The leading tag collects `id="video-js-fmp<cp id>"`, class `video-js <skin> vjs-default-skin`, `width`/`height` (video only), `poster` (video only), `autoplay`, `loop`, `controls` unless Controlbar is `none`, `muted` at volume 0 and `preload`. Each configured source becomes `<source src="…" type="…">`:

| Source kind | Video | Audio |
| ----------- | ----- | ----- |
| H.264 | `video/mp4` | `audio/mpeg` (m4a file: `audio/mp4`) |
| WebM | `video/webm` | `audio/webm` |
| Ogg | `video/ogg` | `audio/ogg` |

Video.js loads locally from `template/lib/video-js/video.min.js`, else from the `vjs.zencdn.net/8.24.0` CDN (`initVideoJs()`); the init script registers the instance in `videoJsInstances`, applies markers, volume and deep links, and honors the `js_in_body` config for head vs. body placement. A URL parameter `?fmp=<cp id>-<seconds>` (or `-m<marker number>`) seeks the matching player instance and scrolls to it.

### Flash fallback

The fallback `<object class="vjs-flash-fallback">` carries SWFObject flashvars: `mediaURL`, `loop`, `showScalingButton`, `scaleIfFullScreen`, `crop`, `defaultVolume`, `buffer: 6`, `allowSmoothing`, `controlsEnabled`, `autoPlay`, `controlBackColor`, `controlColor`, plus `teaserURL` (poster) and `indentImageURL` (watermark) when set. Player SWF: `template/lib/nonverblaster/NonverBlaster.swf`, params `allowfullscreen`, `menu: false`, `wmode: opaque`, `allowScriptAccess: always`. Without HTML5 sources the CP embeds the SWF directly via `swfobject.embedSWF` using the Flash version stored in `fmp_set_flashversion` (default 10, fallback 11).

### Template

Order: `template/inc_default/flashplayer.tmpl`, else `template/inc_cntpart/flashplayer/<selected>`, else built-in wrapper. Tags:

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{ATTR_CLASS}` / `[ATTR_CLASS]…[/ATTR_CLASS]`, `{ATTR_ID}` / `[ATTR_ID]…[/ATTR_ID]` | Wrapper class / id with `_ELSE` branches. |
| `[TITLE]` `{TITLE}`, `[SUBTITLE]` `{SUBTITLE}` | Content part title / subtitle, HTML-escaped. |
| `[PLAYER]…[/PLAYER]` / `{PLAYER}` | The complete player markup; block dropped when no media is configured. |
| `[CAPTION]…[/CAPTION]` / `{CAPTION}` | Caption text, HTML-escaped. |
| `[LINK]…[/LINK]` / `{LINK}`, `[TARGET]…[/TARGET]` / `{TARGET}` | Link URL and target. |
| `{ID}` | Player id `fmp<cp id>` (also used by the `video-js-` element id). |

## Storage

- The whole `fmp_data` array serialized in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` (template name, size, per-format internal/external values, caption, link, markers, thumbnail, all `fmp_set_*` switches; legacy keys `fmp_set_flashversion` and `fmp_player` persist from the defaults)
- Template name: `acontent_template`

## Related

- Simple HTML5 embed: [Multimedia (cp 9)](12-multimedia.md)
- [Images &lt;div&gt; (cp 29)](10-images-div.md) for lightbox-based galleries

# Rollover images (content part 50)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt50.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt50.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt50.takeval.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt50.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt50.article.inc.php`

Legacy hover gallery: the first image of the list renders as the large reference image; every image — the first one included — also renders as a small thumbnail that swaps the large image on mouseover and updates a caption layer. Table-based output, popup zoom, no lightbox, and more than one thumbnail is required for the thumbnail row to appear.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(default)* | Template file from `template/inc_cntpart/reference/`. Empty uses `template/inc_default/reference.tmpl`. |
| Plain text | textarea | — | Text right of the images; HTML-special-chars on save, rendered with `nl2br`. |
| Image | multi-select | — | File center images (`filebrowser.php?opt=3`), sortable. First image = large view. |
| Caption | textarea, one line per image | — | Line n belongs to image n; used as `alt`/`title` and as text for the caption layer. |
| Zoom | switch | off | Every thumbnail additionally links to a `image_zoom.php` popup (`window.open`). |
| Large reference image — Max width / Max height | number px | `content_width` (978) | Size of the large image; width is capped to `content_width`. Border pixels subtract from both sizes. |
| Large reference image — Border | number px | 0 | `border` attribute of the large image. |
| Small reference images — Alignment | radio | Horizontal | Horizontal = all thumbnails in one table row, vertical = one thumbnail per row. |
| Small reference images — Cell position | select | Default | Alignment of each thumbnail cell: combinations of left/center/right and top/middle/bottom (values 1–9, 0 = default). |
| Small reference images — Block w × h | number px | `content_width` / `img_prev_height` (734) | Available space for the thumbnail row; only used with more than one thumbnail. |
| Small reference images — Image space | number px | 0 | Spacer pixels between thumbnails (`img/leer.gif`). |
| Small reference images — Border | number px | 0 | `border` attribute of the thumbnails. |

Thumbnail size is computed from the block: `(block size − (n − 1) × space) / n − 2 × listborder`, at least 10 px.

## Rendering

Output is a set of nested `<table>` elements (defined in the template). The large image carries `id`/`name` `refimgid<cp id>`; each thumbnail carries `refimgid<cp id>a<index>` and an inline `onmouseover` handler from `template/inc_js/frontend.js` (`initFrontendJS()`):

```html
<table>
  <tr>
    <td><table>
      <tr><td><img src="… large …" id="refimgid12" /></td></tr>
      <tr><td><div id="refcaptid12">First caption line</div></td></tr>
    </table>
    <table><tr>…thumbnail <td>s with onmouseover="swapImage(…);addText(…);return false;"…</tr></table></td>
    <td width="98%"><h3>Title</h3><p>Text</p></td>
  </tr>
</table>
```

`swapImage()` replaces the `src` of the large image with the thumbnail rendered at large size; `addText('refcaptid<cp id>', '<caption>')` only fires when the template contains a `[CAPTION]` block. Zoom popups open `image_zoom.php?…` in a `previewpic` window when Zoom is on and the enlarged version exists.

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[REF]…[/REF]` / `{REF}` | Large image `<img>`; contains the placeholder text `[NO&nbsp;IMAGE]` without images. |
| `[CAPTION]…[/CAPTION]` / `{CAPTION}` | Caption layer (`div#refcaptid<cp id>`), shows caption line 1. |
| `[LIST]…[/LIST]` / `{LIST}` | Thumbnail `<table>`; empty with only one image. |
| `[TITLE]` `{TITLE}`, `[SUB]` `{SUB}` / `[TEXT]` `{TEXT}` | Content part title, subtitle, and the plain text with `nl2br`. |
| `{ATTR_CLASS}` / `[ATTR_CLASS]…[/ATTR_CLASS]`, `{ATTR_ID}` / `[ATTR_ID]…[/ATTR_ID]` | Wrapper class / id with `_ELSE` branches. |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID. |

## Storage

- Everything — including the template name under key `tmpl` — is stored in the single serialized `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` value: `text`, `tmpl`, `list` (image tuples with rendered sizes), `caption`, `zoom`, `width`, `height`, `border`, `pos`, `basis`, `blockwidth`, `blockheight`, `space`, `listborder`, plus computed `col`, `showlist`, `temp_list_width`, `temp_list_height`

## Related

- Modern gallery alternatives: [Images (cp 2)](09-images.md), [Images &lt;div&gt; (cp 29)](10-images-div.md)
- Popup zoom helper shared with [Images (cp 2)](09-images.md)

# Map (content part 51)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt51.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt51.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt51.takeval.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt51.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt51.article.inc.php`, `img/mapimage.php`

A location map over a static graphic you upload to `template/inc_cntpart/map/map_img/`. Each location is a pixel coordinate pair on that graphic; rendering draws the markers (GD) and links every marker to its location entry, selected through a URL parameter. This is file-based, not a Google Maps/OpenStreetMap integration.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | — | Files from `template/inc_cntpart/map/` (`.tmpl` and `.html`). No default fallback exists — an empty selection renders the built-in output below. |
| Map image | radio list | — | JPG/GIF/PNG images in `template/inc_cntpart/map/map_img/`, with hover preview. Locations can be added only after an image is selected. |
| X / Y | number, max 4 digits px | — | Pixel position of the next location on the map image; "open map" (`cnt51.open.php`) is a click picker that fills both. |
| Location title | text | — | Required; saving without a title raises an error. |
| ZIP / City | text | — | Shown in the location info. |
| Entry/info | WYSIWYG | — | Description of the location. |
| Location list | table | — | Existing locations with X×Y, title, edit and delete links; delete is a soft delete (`map_deleted = 9`). |
| Text | textarea | — | Intro text rendered at `{TEXT}`. |

Location rows save immediately through the content part Save button (`INSERT`/`UPDATE` on `phpwcms_map`).

## Rendering

The renderer reads all locations of the content part (`phpwcms_map`, `map_deleted = 0`, ordered by ZIP and city) and builds:

- the map graphic as `<img src="img/mapimage.php?i=<name>&xy=<x,y, x,y>&v=<VAR>" usemap="#locations">`, where `mapimage.php` draws a rectangle marker per coordinate pair;
- one `<area shape="rect" coords="x-4,y-4,x+4,y+4">` per location, linking to `index.php?…&loc=<map_id>` with title and alt set to the location title;
- the location selected by `?loc=<map_id>` rendered into the `[LOCATION]` section.

Wrapper: with content part CSS class or ID set, the output is wrapped in one `<div>`; title and subtitle print through `headline()` before the content.

### Template

The template file is loaded strictly from `template/inc_cntpart/map/<selected>`; there is no `inc_default` fallback. Three sections (comment markers `<!--NAME_START//-->…`):

| Section | Tags |
| ------- | ---- |
| `VAR` | One line with five comma-separated values: `border, marker width, marker height, background HEX, marker fill HEX` — e.g. `1,9,9,FFFFFF,FF4000`. Used as the `v=` value of `mapimage.php`; without a `VAR` section the default is `1,7,7,FFFFFF,FF4000`. |
| `CONTENT` | `[MAP]` `{MAP}` map image markup, `[TEXT]` `{TEXT}` intro text (`nl2br`, HTML-escaped), `[LOCATION]` `{LOCATION}` rendered location block. |
| `LOCATION` | `{TITLE}`, `[ZIP]` `{ZIP}`, `[CITY]` `{CITY}` (HTML-escaped) and `[ENTRY]` `{ENTRY}` (the WYSIWYG entry, raw). |

Shipped files: `default_map.html` (documentation with examples inside the sections) and `BS5.tmpl`.

When no CONTENT section exists the renderer falls back to built-in output: map image floated right, text with `nl2br`, then the selected location as `<h5>` title plus ZIP (bold) and entry.

## Storage

- Template name, text, map image file name: serialized in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` (`template`, `text`, `image`)
- Each location: one row in `phpwcms_map` — `map_cid` (content part ID), `map_x`, `map_y`, `map_title`, `map_zip`, `map_city`, `map_entry`, `map_deleted` (0 = active, 9 = deleted)

## Related

- [Images &lt;div&gt; (cp 29)](10-images-div.md) for real image galleries
- [General concepts](../general/concepts.md) for the content part model

<!-- docs/content-parts/16-filelist.md -->

# File list (content part 7)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt7.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt7.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt7.inc.php`

Publishes files picked from the file center as an ordered download list. Each file can carry its own display name, title, target, thumbnail size and copyright line. Only files with `f_public=1`, `f_aktiv=1`, `f_kid=1` (public category) end up selectable in the browse dialog.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | Template from `template/inc_cntpart/filelist/`. Empty uses the shipped default. The preset `download-inline` loads `template/inc_default/filelist_inline.tmpl`. |
| Direct download | checkbox | off | Link straight to the file in `/filearchive` instead of through `download.php`. Disabled when `filearchive/.htaccess` contains a `deny` directive. |
| Files | multi-select + sort up/down + delete | empty | Chosen files, in list order. |
| Description | textarea | — | One line per file, pipe separated: `description \| display name \| title \| target \| imagesize \| copyright \| custom URL`. |
| Text | WYSIWYG / HTML | — | Additional text above the list. |

The description hint under the textarea lists the columns in order. `target` accepts `_blank`, `_parent`, `_self` (default `_blank` when empty) — any other value acts as custom URL, with the following space separate value as its target.

## Rendering

### Template selection

Template source order: selected `template/inc_cntpart/filelist/<name>.tmpl`, else `template/inc_default/filelist.tmpl`, else the built-in skeleton:

```html
[HAS_FILES][ATTR_CLASS]<div class="{ATTR_CLASS}"[ATTR_ID] id="{ATTR_ID}"[/ATTR_ID]>
[TITLE]<h4>{TITLE}</h4>[/TITLE][SUBTITLE]<h5>{SUBTITLE}</h5>[/SUBTITLE][TEXT]{TEXT}[/TEXT]
<ul class="fileDownload">
  <li><a href="{FILE_LINK}"{FILE_TARGET}>{FILE_NAME}</a></li>
</ul>
[/HAS_FILES]
```

The per-file markup lives in the `[FILE_ENTRY]…[/FILE_ENTRY]` template section; `[HAS_FILES]` wraps the whole output so nothing renders when the file stack is empty.

### Template tags

Wrapper: `{ATTR_CLASS}`, `{ATTR_ID}`, `{TITLE}`, `{SUBTITLE}`, `{TEXT}`, `{FILE_COUNT}`.

Per file entry:

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{FILE_ID}` | File ID. |
| `{FILE_LINK}` | Download URL via `rel_download()` (or direct file URL with "Direct download" on). |
| `{FILE_NAME}` | Display name — description column 2, else the real file name. |
| `{FILE_EXT}` | File extension. |
| `{FILE_TARGET}` | Target attribute from description column 4. |
| `{FILE_SIZE}` | Human-readable size, rounding + separator from settings. |
| `{FILE_DATE}` | File creation date, strftime format from settings. |
| `{FILE_DOWNLOADS}` | Download counter. |
| `{FILE_ICON}` | Icon markup — `icon_path`/`icon_name` settings, default system icon. |
| `{FILE_IMAGE_WxH}` … | Thumbnail of image files sized `WxH` when description column 5 says so; lightbox-ready with `lightbox_init = 1`. |

### FILE_SETTINGS (INI section)

```ini
[FILE_SETTINGS]
icon_path        =
icon_name        =
thumbnail        = 0
thumbnail_width  = 50
thumbnail_height = 50
thumbnail_crop   = 1
lightbox_init    = 0
file_size_round  = 3
file_size_space  = " "
date_format      = %m/%d/%y
set_locale       =
inline_download  = (config key `inline_download`)
```

`set_locale` applies a PHP locale for the strftime date output. `inline_download` forces `Content-Disposition: inline` for displayable types; the key comes from `config.inc.php` `$phpwcms['inline_download']` by default.

## Storage

- Selected file IDs: `acontent_form` (`file_list`)
- Per-file info lines: joined with `|` into `file_info` in `acontent_form`
- Template name: `acontent_template`
- Text / description / direct download flag: `acontent_text`, `file_descr` + `file.direct_download` in `acontent_form`

## Related

- [Link list (cp 5)](08-linklist.md) — links, not downloads
- [File center](../backend/04-files-filecenter.md)
- [File storage settings](../administration/file-storage.md)

# Teaser/link article (content part 8)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt8.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt8.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt8.article.inc.php`, `template/inc_default/teaser.tmpl`, `template/inc_default/list.teaser.tmpl`

Lists articles chosen one by one or collected automatically by sorting rule, structure level and keyword tags, each rendered from a teaser template. The same renderer also serves the news-style listing of any article selection.

## Backend form

Fields as they appear in the content part dialog, top to bottom.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default `<ul><li>`)* | File from `template/inc_cntpart/teaser/`. Files with a `list.` prefix are hidden here; they apply only in list mode (see Rendering). |
| Unique teaser entry | checkbox | off | Skip articles that an earlier teaser content part on the same page has already output. |
| Columns | text (3 chars) | *(empty)* | Teasers per row. The template's `TEASER_COLUMN_OVERWRITE` value wins when it holds an unsigned integer. |
| Check against category alias | checkbox | off | When the article sits in a structure level containing exactly one article, link to that level's URL instead of the article. |
| Wordlimit | text (5 chars) | *(empty)* | Truncate the summary. A negative value counts characters instead of words. |
| No summary | checkbox | off | Strip the summary from all entries. |
| Allowed tags | text | `<b><i><u><s><strong>` | HTML tags kept when `SUMMARY` is stripped; empty removes all tags. |
| Max width | text (4 chars, px) | *(empty)* | Overrides the list image width. |
| Max height | text (4 chars, px) | *(empty)* | Overrides the list image height. |
| Crop image | switch | off | Crop the list image to the given size instead of scaling. |
| Sorting | select | Manual | One of the values in the sorting table below. Choosing a non-manual value shows the auto fields (Max articles, Site level) and hides the manual selection lists. |
| Use prio | checkbox | off | Prepend `article_priorize DESC` to the chosen sort order. |
| Selection | two multi-select lists | — | Manual mode only: move articles between the selected list (`calink[]`, reordable with sort up/down buttons and removable) and the available list (`calinklist`). Both list non-hidden, non-deleted articles. |
| Filter | select + checkbox | — | Manual mode only: restrict the available list to a structure level, optionally also to articles carrying the CP's tags (applied via backend session). |
| Max articles | text (5 chars) | *(empty)* | Auto mode only: `LIMIT` for the collection query. |
| Site level | multi-select | *(none)* | Auto mode only: `calink_level[]`; source structure levels including Index (0). |
| Tags | text with tag autosuggest (categories) | *(empty)* | Keyword tags from `phpwcms_categories` (`cat_type='article'`); combined with the mode select below. |
| And/or | select | OR | `OR`, `AND`, `NOT`, `NOR` for the tag comparison. |

### Sorting values

Sorting applies to the auto collection; value 0 (manual) uses the hand-picked order instead.

| Value | Meaning |
| ----- | ------- |
| 0 | Manual selection, order as listed |
| 1 / 2 | Create date (`article_created`) DESC / ASC |
| 3 / 4 | Change date (`article_tstamp`) DESC / ASC |
| 5 / 6 | Live date (`article_begin`) DESC / ASC |
| 7 / 8 | Kill date (`article_end`) DESC / ASC |
| 9 | Random |
| 10–17 | Random, then create / change / live / kill date DESC / ASC |
| 18 / 19 | Article title (`article_title`) DESC / ASC |
| 20 / 21 | Random, then title DESC / ASC |
| 22 / 23 | Keywords/tags (`article_keyword`) DESC / ASC |
| 24 / 25 | Article sort (`article_sort`) DESC / ASC |
| 26 / 27 | Random, then article sort DESC / ASC |

For the random-plus-sort values (10–21, 26–27) the query runs twice as `(SELECT … ORDER BY RAND()) UNION DISTINCT (SELECT …)` deduplicated, then re-sorted by the chosen column and limited.

## Rendering

### Selection and query

- Both modes request `article_aktiv=1 AND article_deleted=0 AND article_noteaser=0`; published-visibility window (`article_begin`/`article_end`) applies unless the page runs in preview mode.
- Manual mode queries the stored article IDs (minus unique-teaser skips); auto mode queries by structure level (`article_cid IN …`) and, with tags set, LEFT JOINs `phpwcms_categories` with `cat_type='article'`.
- Tag modes against the selected tags: `OR` keeps articles carrying at least one tag, `AND` only those carrying every tag (post-filtered by matched count), `NOT` excludes articles carrying all tags, `NOR` keeps those carrying none.
- A frontend edit link is prepended per entry when `FE_EDIT_LINK` is enabled and the backend user is admin or owns the article.

### Template selection

Renderer order: in list mode (rendered through `{SHOW_CONTENT}`, flag `acontent_template_listmode`) the `list.<name>` variant inside `template/inc_cntpart/teaser/`, else the selected template; then `template/inc_default/list.teaser.tmpl` in list mode, else `template/inc_default/teaser.tmpl`; otherwise the built-in skeleton:

```html
<div>…<ul class="article-link-internal">…<li><a href="{ARTICLELINK}">{TITLE}</a></li>…</ul>…</div>
```

### Template sections

| Section | Meaning |
| ------- | ------- |
| `TEASER_HEAD` | Top of the block; wraps `TEASER` and carries `[TITLE]`/`[SUBTITLE]`. `{LINK_ARTICLE_CLASS}` resolves to the standard article link list class (`template_default['article']['link_article_class']`). |
| `TEASER_ENTRY` | Repeated per article. |
| `TEASER_ENTRY_SPACER` | Inserted between entries (columns > 1) or between all entries without columns. |
| `TEASER_ROW_SPACER` | Inserted once when a new row starts. |
| `TEASER_FOOTER` | Bottom of the block. |
| `TEASER_COLUMN_OVERWRITE` | Plain untagged value between the two markers: unsigned integer overrides Columns; `0` disables columns for this template. |
| `[TEASER]` block | Removed entirely when no article qualified. |

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{ARTICLEID}` `{CATEGORYID}` `{COLUMN}` `{ROW}` | Numeric positions: article ID, structure level ID, 1-based column, current row. |
| `[MENUTITLE]`/`{MENUTITLE}`, `[MENUTITLE_ELSE]` | Article menu title with `{TITLE}` as the usual `ELSE` fallback. |
| `[TITLE]`/`{TITLE}` | Article title, HTML-escaped. |
| `[SUBTITLE]`/`{SUBTITLE}` | Article subtitle. |
| `{DATE:d/m/y lang=EN}` `{LIVEDATE:…}` `{KILLDATE:…}` | Standard date format tags. `{DATE}` shows the article change date, or the create date when sorting by create date; live/kill dates render through their own tags regardless of sorting. |
| `[PRIO]`/`{PRIO}` | `article_priorize` value. |
| `[ACTIVE]` | Holds `active` when the teasered article is the one currently displayed. |
| `[CLASS]`/`{CLASS}` | Article class from keyword CSS markers (`*CSS-myclass*`), merged with the article's meta class. |
| `[CATEGORY]`/`{CATEGORY}` | Structure level name of the article. |
| `[ARTICLELINK]`/`{ARTICLELINK}`, `{ARTICLELINK_TARGET}` | Detail URL and link target, filled only when the article's more-link option is set; with an article redirect, the redirect URL and target. Without it the block is stripped. |
| `[IMAGE]`/`{IMAGE}` | List image `<img>` built by the cached-image mechanism, with `data-image-id`/`data-image-hash`, alt and title; empty without an article image. If the template contains `cmsimage.php`, `{IMAGE}` is the raw file hash instead, for `img/cmsimage.php/<w>x<h>[x<crop>]/<hash>.<ext>` URLs. |
| `{THUMB_NAME}` `{THUMB_REL}` `{THUMB_ABS}` `{THUMB_WIDTH}` `{THUMB_HEIGHT}` `{THUMB_ID}` `{THUMB_HASH}` `{THUMB_CROP}` `{THUMB_EXT}` `{IMAGE_NAME}` | List image metadata: generated file name, relative and absolute URL, pixel size, file ID/hash, crop flag, extension, original name. |
| `[CAPTION_SUPPRESS]`, `[CAPTION]`/`{CAPTION}`, `{CAPTION_ALT}`, `{CAPTION_TITLE}`, `{CAPTION_URL}` | List image caption, alt, title and link; `[CAPTION_SUPPRESS]` stays when the article asked for caption suppression. |
| `[IMAGE_DETAIL]`/`{IMAGE_DETAIL}`, `{IMAGE_DETAIL_ID}` `{IMAGE_DETAIL_HASH}` `{IMAGE_DETAIL_EXT}` `{IMAGE_DETAIL_NAME}` | Article detail image (not the list image) rendered as `<img>` with `data-detail-id`/`data-detail-hash`, plus its metadata. |
| `[CAPTION_DETAIL_SUPPRESS]`, `[CAPTION_DETAIL]`/`{CAPTION_DETAIL}`, `{IMAGE_TITLE}`, `{ALT}`, `{URL}`, `{URL_TARGET}`, `{COPYRIGHT}` | Detail image caption parts. |
| `[SUMMARY_RAW]`/`{SUMMARY_RAW}` | Untruncated summary as stored (`strip_tags` not applied), stripped when No summary is set. |
| `[SUMMARY]`/`{SUMMARY}` | Summary stripped to allowed tags, truncated to Wordlimit (words, or characters for negative values; the article's list-image wordlimit applies when the CP leaves it empty), ellipsis from `template_default['ellipse_sign']`. |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]`/`{ATTR_CLASS}` `[ATTR_ID]`/`{ATTR_ID}` `[ATTR_CLASS_ELSE]` | Content part wrapper class and `id` (`acontent_attr_class`/`acontent_attr_id`). |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID (`acontent_id`). |
| `[TITLE]`/`[SUBTITLE]` at block level | Content part title and subtitle. |

The list image comes from the article's summary image: when the articlesummary list-image option is off or unset, the summary image values are used (`setArticleSummaryImageData()` in `include/inc_front/front.func.inc.php`).

## Storage

Serialized array `alink` in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` with the keys `alink_template`, `alink_allowedtags`, `alink_id` (array of article IDs), `alink_level`, `alink_type`, `alink_wordlimit`, `alink_hidesummary`, `alink_columns`, `alink_categoryalias`, `alink_max`, `alink_width`, `alink_height`, `alink_zoom` (legacy, not evaluated), `alink_unique`, `alink_crop`, `alink_prio`, `alink_andor`, `alink_category`. Older records keep their article IDs as `id:id:id` string in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_alink`; the renderer falls back to it when the serialized array carries no `alink_id`.

## Related

- Other article listers: [Article menu (cp 15)](18-article-menu.md), [News (cp 33)](19-news.md)
- List image source: article summary options, see [Text w/image (cp 1)](01-text-with-image.md)

<!-- docs/content-parts/18-article-menu.md -->

# Article menu (content part 15)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt15.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt15.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt15.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/general.inc.php` (`get_order_sort()`)

Lists the articles of a single structure level as a simple menu, with optional per-article summary text. The content part has no own templates; markup follows the four fixed output modes.

## Backend form

Fields as they appear in the content part dialog, top to bottom.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Site level | radio + select | Current level | `calist_cat` 0 = the level the article is placed in; otherwise `calist_catid` picks a level from the structure tree (Index = 0). |
| Show as | radio | Table | `calist_ul`: `<ul>` (1), `<div>` (2), `<dl>` (3), `<span>` (4), Table (0). Invalid values fall back to Table. |
| CSS class | text | *(empty)* | `calist_class` on the wrapper tag; in Table mode a `<div class="…">` wraps the table; the active item gets `<class>-active` (or `alink-active` when the class is empty). |
| Numerize title | checkbox | off | `calist_titleasnumber`: menu text becomes the item's position number instead of the menu title/title. |
| Label | text | *(empty)* | `calist_label`: rendered once inside the wrapper as item tag with `class="label"` — `li`, `div`, `dt` or `b` depending on the output mode. |
| Break | text | *(empty)* | `calist_break`: HTML inserted between items, wrapped in the item tag with `class="break"`. |
| Summary | checkbox | off | `calist_headertext`: show the article summary under each menu entry. |
| Max char | text | *(empty)* | `calist_maxchar`: truncate the summary at this character count (first line after word wrapping); replacement tags are removed and entities decoded. |
| More link | text | *(empty)* | `calist_morelink`: append a "more" link to the truncated summary, pointing back to the article. |
| Title wrap | select | *(empty = none)* | `calist_titlewrap`: wrap each link in `p`, `div`, `span`, `h1`–`h6`, `pre`, `blockquote` or `em`. |
| Hide active | checkbox | off | `calist_hideactive`: exclude the article currently displayed from the list. |

## Rendering

- The list queries articles of the chosen level: `article_aktiv=1 AND article_deleted=0`, the visibility window unless preview mode, plus `article_id != <current>` when Hide active is set. It selects `article_id, article_title, article_cid, article_summary, article_alias, article_menutitle`.
- Sorting comes from the structure level's article order (`acat_order`, `get_order_sort()` in `include/inc_lib/general.inc.php`), always led by `article_priorize DESC`:

  | `acat_order` | SQL order |
  | ---- | ------------- |
  | 0 / 1 | `article_sort` ASC / DESC |
  | 2 / 3 | `article_created` ASC / DESC |
  | 4 / 5 | `article_tstamp` ASC / DESC |
  | 6 / 7 | `article_begin` ASC / DESC |
  | 8 / 9 | `article_title` ASC / DESC |
  | 10 / 11 | `article_end` ASC / DESC |

- Menu text per item: menu title, else article title, both HTML-escaped; the numeric position replaces it when Numerize title is set. Each link carries `title="…"` with the article title.
- Wrapper tags per mode — 1: `ul`/`li`, 2: `div`/`div`, 3: `dl`/`dd` (`dt` for the label), 4: `div`/`span` (`b` for the label). Each item is rendered inside its mode's item tag.
- `Table` mode wraps rows in a bare `<table>`; each row opens with a sign cell (`template_default['article']['link_article_sign']`, sign as `valign="top"` cell with class `nowrap`), the link cell carries `article-link-internal` (the `link_article_class` default) plus the summary occupying a second row (`rowspan="2"` on the item cell).
- The current article's item receives `class="alink-active"` or `<CSS class>-active` in all modes.
- Article links are built as `index.php?<aid parameter>` via `setGetArticleAid()`, so URL aliases are honored by the URL routing.
- The whole block is wrapped in `<div class="… attr class" id="…">` when the content part carries an attribute class or ID, and the content part title/subtitle render through the standard `headline()` function — no template tags, no template file.

## Storage

Serialized array `alist` in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` with the keys `cat`, `catid`, `headertext`, `ul`, `class`, `maxchar`, `morelink`, `titlewrap`, `hideactive`, `titleasnumber`, `break`, `label`. No `acontent_template` value is used.

## Related

- Auto-collected teasers with templates: [Teaser/link article (cp 8)](17-teaser-link-article.md)
- News records as list: [News (cp 33)](19-news.md)
