# News (content part 33)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt33.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt33.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt33.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/news.inc.php`, `template/inc_default/news.tmpl`

Renders news records — rows in `phpwcms_content` with `cnt_module='news'`, edited in the backend news area (`include/inc_lib/news.inc.php`). The content part works without any module activation; it reads the news table directly. Each content part instance acts as list and detail renderer: when the URL carries a `newsdetail` parameter the matching record is shown, otherwise the list.

## Backend form

Fields as they appear in the content part dialog, top to bottom.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | File from `template/inc_cntpart/news/`. Empty uses `template/inc_default/news.tmpl`. |
| Sorting | select | Live date, DESC (`5` in the dialog; empty/invalid values are saved as `9`) | Sort value per table below. |
| Use prio | checkbox | off | Prepend `cnt_prio DESC` to the sort order. |
| Tags | text with tag autosuggest (news tags) | *(empty)* | `news_category`: values compared against `phpwcms_categories` rows with `cat_type='news'`, combined by And/or. |
| And/or | select | OR | `OR`, `AND`, `NOT` for the tag comparison. |
| Language | checkboxes | *(empty = all)* | `news_lang`: restrict to `cnt_lang` values; shown only when the installation allows more than one backend language. |
| Show | select | Archived items: exclude (`1` in the dialog) | Archive behavior per table below. |
| Item count | text (5 chars) | *(empty)* | `news_limit`: last value of `LIMIT` for the list. |
| Skip first items | text (5 chars) | *(empty)* | `news_skip`: `LIMIT` offset — the first N matching records are ignored. |
| Pagination | checkbox | off | `news_paginate`: enable `?newspage=N` navigation. |
| Pagination basis | select | Count (0) | `news_paginate_basis`: 0 count, 1 day, 2 ISO week, 3 month, 4 year. Higher values are reset to 0 when invalid. |
| Items per page | text (5 chars) | 10 when Pagination is on else empty | `news_paginate_count`; only used with basis Count. |
| Archive link | text (250 chars) + article browser | *(empty)* | `news_archive_link`: article alias or `aid=1`/`id=3` target. Stored; not evaluated by the current renderer. |
| News article | text (250 chars) + article browser | *(empty)* | `news_detail_link`: target article for detail links — numeric value becomes `aid=<n>`, otherwise it is a URL alias. Empty opens details on the article containing the content part. |

### Sorting values

| Value | Meaning |
| ----- | ------- |
| 9 / 10 | Sort date (`cnt_ts_sortdate` = custom `cnt_sort`, else live date, else create date) DESC / ASC |
| 1 / 2 | Create date (`cnt_created`) DESC / ASC |
| 3 / 4 | Change date (`cnt_changed`) DESC / ASC |
| 5 / 6 | Live date (`cnt_livedate`, falling back to `cnt_created`) DESC / ASC |
| 7 / 8 | Kill date (`cnt_killdate`) DESC / ASC |
| 17 / 18 | Title (`cnt_title`) DESC / ASC |
| 11 / 12 | Editor (`cnt_editor`) then sort date DESC / ASC |
| 13 / 14 | Internal name (`cnt_name`) DESC / ASC |
| 15 / 16 | Place (`cnt_place`) then sort date DESC / ASC |

### Show (archive) values

| Value | Meaning |
| ----- | ------- |
| 0 | Include archived: live date passed and (kill date not passed or `cnt_archive_status=1`) |
| 1 | Exclude archived: live date passed and kill date not passed |
| 2 | Archived only: kill date passed and `cnt_archive_status=1` |
| 3 | All items with live date passed, including expired ones |

The list compares against `cnt_ts_livedate` (live date, falling back to `cnt_created`) and `cnt_ts_killdate` (kill date, falling to the current time + 1 hour when empty).

## Rendering

### List and detail

- Detail request: `newsdetail` must match `YYYYMMDD-<aid>_<id|alias>`; the number after `_` selects by `cnt_id` (numeric) or `cnt_alias`. Detail mode disables the canonical `<link>`, sets the OpenGraph type to `article`, and promotes the record title to the page title plus meta description from the teaser text.
- List mode groups SQL by `cnt_id` when tag filtering, applies `news_skip`/`news_limit` as `LIMIT`, and in pagination mode computes page counts (count basis: `ceil(total / per page)`; date bases bucket by `DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(cnt_ts_livedate), …)` per day/week/month/year, ordered like the list). Page navigation uses the `newspage` GET parameter.
- A frontend edit link is prepended per entry when `FE_EDIT_LINK` is enabled.

### Template sections

| Section | Meaning |
| ------- | ------- |
| `NEWS_SETTINGS` | INI-style settings (see table below). |
| `NEWS_LIST` | List wrapper; removed in detail mode. |
| `NEWS_LIST_ENTRY` | Repeated per entry in list mode. |
| `NEWS_LIST_ENTRY_SPACE` / `NEWS_LIST_ROW_SPACE` | Spacers between entries/rows per `news_per_row`. |
| `NEWS_DETAIL` | Entry markup in detail mode. |
| `GALLERY_ITEM` | Sub-section of the entry template, repeated per gallery image. |

`NEWS_SETTINGS` keys, merged over renderer defaults (the shipped template overrides the gallery extension default):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | ------- | ------- |
| `news_per_row` | 1 | Entries per row; drives entry/row spacers. |
| `news_teaser_limit_chars` / `news_teaser_limit_words` | 0 | Truncate the teaser text by characters or words (`getCleanSubString`, characters win when both are set). |
| `news_teaser_limit_ellipse` | `template_default['ellipse_sign']` | Ellipsis mark for truncation. |
| `files_template_list` / `files_template_detail` | `default` | File list template passed to the files content part renderer per mode. |
| `files_direct_download` | 0 | Forwarded to the files renderer. |
| `gallery_allowed_ext` | `jpg,jpeg,png,svg` | Image extensions eligible for the gallery. |
| `gallery_filecenter_info` | 1 | Use description/copyright from the file center; 0 parses the per-file caption lines instead. |

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[NEWS_TITLE]`/`{NEWS_TITLE}`, `[NEWS_SUBTITLE]`/`{NEWS_SUBTITLE}`, `[NEWS_TOPIC]`/`{NEWS_TOPIC}` | Record title, subtitle and internal name (`cnt_title`, `cnt_subtitle`, `cnt_name`). |
| `[NEWS_TEASER]`/`{NEWS_TEASER}` | Teaser text (`cnt_teasertext`), format per record setting: plain text default (HTML-encoded with breaks preserved by `plaintext_htmlencode`), also supports `br`, `markdown`, `textile`, raw HTML — each HTML-safe before output. |
| `[NEWS_TEXT]`/`{NEWS_TEXT}` | Body text (`cnt_text`), output as stored. |
| `[NEWS_TAGS]`/`{NEWS_TAGS}` | The record's tag string (`cnt_object['cnt_category']`). |
| `[AUTHOR]`/`{AUTHOR}`, `[PLACE]`/`{PLACE}` | `cnt_editor`, `cnt_place`. |
| `[PRIO]`/`{PRIO}` | `cnt_prio`. |
| `[FIRST]` / `[LAST]` | Present on the first and last entry of the listing. |
| `[IS_ARCHIVE]` / `[IS_ARCHIVE_ELSE]` | Present when the kill date has passed (detail: archive/live wrapper classes). |
| `[NEWS_DETAIL_LINK]`/`{NEWS_DETAIL_LINK}` | Detail URL `base?newsdetail=YYYYMMDD-<aid>_<alias|id>`; only filled when the record allows read-more (`cnt_object['cnt_readmore']`). |
| `[NEWS_LIST_LINK]`/`{NEWS_LIST_LINK}` | Back link to the list URL (detail mode only). |
| `{ID}` | Record ID (`cnt_id`), e.g. for `id="news-{ID}"`. |
| `[IMAGE]`/`{IMAGE}`, `{IMAGE_ID}` `{IMAGE_EXT}` `{IMAGE_HASH}` `{IMAGE_WIDTH}` `{IMAGE_HEIGHT}` | Record image (`cnt_object['cnt_image']['id']`); `{IMAGE}` is the image name, width/height resolve from the file storage, hash/ext from the file record. |
| `[ZOOM]`/`[ZOOM_ELSE]` | Present when detail zoom is set for the record image. |
| `{LIGHTBOX}` | `rel="lightbox"` plus gallery attributes; initializes slimbox when present. |
| `[CAPTION]` `{CAPTION}`, `[COPYRIGHT]` `{COPYRIGHT}`, `[ALT]` `{ALT}`, `[TITLE]` `{TITLE}`, `[CAPTION_LINK]` `{CAPTION_LINK}`, `{CAPTION_TARGET}`, `[LIGHTBOX_CAPTION]` `{LIGHTBOX_CAPTION}`, `[LIGHTBOX_COPYRIGHT]` `{LIGHTBOX_COPYRIGHT}` | Image caption parts from `cnt_object['cnt_image']['caption']`. |
| `[IMAGE_URL]`/`{IMAGE_URL}` `{IMAGE_URL_TARGET}` | Image link from `cnt_object['cnt_image']['link']` with target. |
| `[URL]` `{URL}`, `{URL_TARGET}`, `[URL_TEXT]`/`{URL_TEXT}` | Record link (`cnt_object['cnt_link']` — numeric values become an `aid=` URL) and link text (`cnt_object['cnt_linktext']`). |
| `{DATE:… lang=EN}` `{LIVEDATE:…}` `{KILLDATE:…}` `{SORTDATE:…}` | Change date (`cnt_changed`), live date, kill date, sort date. |
| `[GALLERY]`/`{GALLERY}` with `{IMAGE_HASH}.{IMAGE_EXT}` `{IMAGE_ID}` `{IMAGE_NAME}` `{IMAGE_WIDTH}` `{IMAGE_HEIGHT}` `[CAPTION]` `[COPYRIGHT]` `[FIRST]` | Image gallery from the record's file list when gallery mode is on and the files are public images. |
| `[FILES]`/`{FILES}` | File list rendered through the files content part renderer (`cnt7.article.inc.php`) in a news context, using the settings' list/detail template. |
| `[PAGINATE]`/`[PAGINATE_ELSE]`, `{PAGE_PREV}`/`[PAGE_PREV]`/`[PAGE_PREV_ELSE]`, `{PAGE_NEXT}`/`[PAGE_NEXT]`/`[PAGE_NEXT_ELSE]`, `{PAGE_CURRENT}` `{PAGE_TOTAL}`, `[PAGE_PERIOD]` | Pagination: filled only when pagination is on and in list mode; `PAGE_PERIOD` shows the bucketed day/week/month/year value on date bases. |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]`/`{ATTR_CLASS}`, `[ATTR_ID]`/`{ATTR_ID}`, `[TITLE]` `{TITLE}`, `[SUBTITLE]` `{SUBTITLE}` | Content part wrapper class/id and title/subtitle; `[NEWS_ENTRIES]` holds the assembled entries. |

## Storage

- Content part: template file name in `acontent_template`, serialized array in `acontent_form` with the keys `news_lang`, `news_category`, `news_sort`, `news_paginate`, `news_prio`, `news_paginate_count`, `news_paginate_basis`, `news_limit`, `news_skip`, `news_archive`, `news_andor`, `news_archive_link`, `news_detail_link`.
- News records: `phpwcms_content` rows with `cnt_module='news'` — `cnt_title`, `cnt_subtitle`, `cnt_name`, `cnt_alias`, `cnt_teasertext`, `cnt_text`, `cnt_editor`, `cnt_place`, `cnt_livedate`, `cnt_killdate`, `cnt_sort`, `cnt_prio`, `cnt_lang`, `cnt_status`, `cnt_archive_status`, `cnt_opengraph`, and the serialized `cnt_object` (image, files, link, text format, read-more, tags, search switch); tags additionally normalized in `phpwcms_categories` with `cat_type='news'`.

## Related

- Article teasers: [Teaser/link article (cp 8)](17-teaser-link-article.md)
- Searching news: [Search (cp 13)](20-search.md)

<!-- docs/content-parts/20-search.md -->

# Search (content part 13)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt13.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt13.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt13.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt_functions/cnt13.func.inc.php`, `template/inc_default/search.tmpl`

Searches article content plus optional news records and frontend-searchable modules, ranks matches by occurrence count and paginates the result list. The same content part renders the search form and the result listing.

## Backend form

Fields as they appear in the content part dialog, top to bottom.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | File from `template/inc_cntpart/search/`. Empty uses `template/inc_default/search.tmpl`. |
| Results per page | text (5 chars) | 25 at runtime when empty | `result_per_page`; a negative value means "all" (`-1` is treated as 100000). |
| Open in new window | checkbox | off | `newwin`: result links get `target="_blank"`. |
| Wordlimit | text (5 chars) | 35 words at runtime when empty | Truncation of each result summary; a negative value counts characters. |
| Highlight | checkbox | off | `highlight_result`: wrap hits and attach `highlight=<words>` to result URLs. |
| Min char | text (5 chars) | 3 | `minchar`: minimum word length; words shorter than this are not highlighted (saved as 3 when empty). |
| Hide summary | checkbox | off | `hide_summary`: drop the `[TEXT]` summary from results. |
| Start at | multi-select | *(empty = all)* | `start_at`: restrict the search to selected structure levels (Index = 0). |
| Default type | select | OR | `type`: `AND` requires every search word to occur. |
| Not search | checkboxes — file names / user name / caption / keywords | off (all searched) | `no_filenames`, `no_username`, `no_caption`, `no_keyword`: exclude the corresponding data from the search corpus. |
| News | checkbox | off | `search_news`: also search news records. |
| Language | text with autosuggest | *(empty = all)* | `news_lang`: comma list restricting news search languages. |
| Tags | text with autosuggest + select | *(empty = all), OR | `news_category` and `news_andor` (`OR`/`AND`/`NOT`) against news tags. |
| Target | text (article alias / `aid=1` / `id=3`) + article browser | *(empty)* | `news_url`: article that hosts the news content part opening news details. |
| Modules | checkboxes per module | off | `module`: include modules providing `frontend.search.php`. |
| Input label / CSS class | text | *(empty)* | `label_input` / `style_input` for the form's input cell/field. |
| Button text / CSS class | text | *(empty = backend word for Search)* | `label_button` / `style_button`. |
| Result label / CSS class | text | *(empty)* | `label_result` / `style_result`: stored, not evaluated by the current renderer. |
| Page of pages | 5 checkboxes | on (except where noted) | `show_always` show pagination on all pages, otherwise only with more than one page; `show_top`/`show_bottom` place it above/below; `show_prev`/`show_next` render disabled prev/next links instead of nothing. |
| Page-of-pages template | textarea | *(empty; built-in default)* | `label_pages`: custom pagination line; empty uses the template's `SEARCH_PAGINATE` section. |
| Align | radio | left | `align`: alignment of the built-in table form (left/right/center). |
| Text/HTML | radio | Text | `text_html`: intro/result/no-result texts output HTML or as plain text with HTML encoding. |
| Intro text | textarea | *(empty)* | `text_intro` shown before any search. |
| Result text | textarea | *(empty)* | `text_result` on successful search. |
| No result text | textarea | *(empty)* | `text_noresult` when nothing matched. |

## Rendering

### Request handling

- The form posts `search_input_field`; the renderer immediately redirects to a `?searchwords=<words>&searchstart=1` URL so the browser history stays clean. Results are always driven by the GET parameter `searchwords`, the page by `searchstart`.
- Words are split at spaces, cleaned of replacement tags and entities, deduplicated; from every word of at least `minchar` length the highlight list is built, with `?` and `*` usable as wildcards.

### Search corpus

- Articles: title, subtitle, summary, keywords, user name, plus the text content of visible content parts of types 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 14, 26, 27, 29, 100, 31, 32. With the "search" switches enabled, file names (file lists and image parts), image captions and file-list captions and the recipe's preparation/ingredients fields are included; alias articles (`article_aliasid`) fall back to the referenced article's data unless the alias keeps its own header data.
- News records (`cnt_module='news'`): text, teaser text, place, subtitle, title, optional editor, tags, image and file captions; a record with `cnt_object['cnt_searchoff']` set is skipped. Result detail links use the configured Target article or an absolute URL containing `___NEWSDETAIL___`/`___HIGHLIGHT___`.
- Modules: `frontend.search.php` of every enabled frontend-searchable module appends its results to the same list.
- Excluded from search: articles flagged "no search" (`article_nosearch`), structure levels flagged `acat_nosearch`, registration-only levels for guests, and expired content part records.

### Ranking and result list

- Each match is ranked by the total number of occurrences; with `type=AND` only results containing every distinct word survive; the list is sorted descending by rank.
- Every result item fills the `SEARCH_ITEM` section with `{LINK}` (target URL; with Highlight enabled the link embeds `highlight=<encoded words>`), `{LINK_TARGET}`, `{RANKING}`, `[TITLE]`, `[SUBTITLE]`, `[TEXT]` (truncated summary, HTML-encoded, highlighted) and, when the item template contains `{IMAGE…}` and the article has a list image, `{IMAGE_HASH}` `{IMAGE_ID}` `{IMAGE_NAME}` `{IMAGE_EXT}` inside `[IMAGE]` (the `{PHPWCMS_RESIZE_IMAGE}` prefix builds thumbnails).
- Results are paginated over the ranked list in PHP: the page from `searchstart` slices `result_per_page` items.

### Template sections and tags

| Section / tag | Meaning |
| ------------- | ------- |
| `SEARCH_HEADER` / `SEARCH_FOOTER` | Wrapper; also hold `[RESULTS]` and the `[TEXT]` status line, `[ATTR_CLASS]`/`[ATTR_ID]`, `[TITLE]`, `[SUBTITLE]`. |
| `SEARCH_ITEM` | Per-result markup. |
| `SEARCH_ITEM_SPACER` | Between result items. |
| `SEARCH_PAGINATE` | Pagination markup, overridden by the backend textarea when filled. |
| `{FORM}` / `[SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL]` | When the template contains a literal `{FORM}`, the built-in table form (aligned per `align`) replaces it; otherwise the modern form inside `[FORM]` is used with `{SEARCH_ACTION}`, `{SEARCH_INPUT}` (the input's name and ID `search_input_field`), `{SEARCH_BUTTON}`, `{SEARCH_VALUE}`, plus the optional label `[SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL]`/`{SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL}`. |
| `[RESULTS]` / `{RESULTS}` | The joined result items; empty when nothing matched. |
| `[PAGINATE_TOP]` / `[PAGINATE_BOTTOM]` | Rendered pagination (same markup both places) per the show switches. |
| `{TEXT}` | Intro, result, or no-result text depending on state. |
| `[TITLE]` / `[SUBTITLE]` | Content part title/subtitle. |

### Pagination markup

Built-in default: `[PREV]{PREV:&laquo; Previous} | [/PREV]Page #/##[NEXT] | {NEXT:Next &raquo;}[/NEXT]`.

| Token | Meaning |
| ----- | ------- |
| `{PREV:…}` / `{NEXT:…}` | Link text, replaced by a link to the previous/next page (or a disabled link per the show switches). |
| `#` | Current page. |
| `##` | Total pages. |
| `###` | First result number on the page. |
| `####` | Last result number on the page. |
| `#####` | Total result count. |
| `{NAVI:123}` | Page number links 1…N. |
| `{NAVI:1-3}` | Result-range links like `1–25`. Both accept `,separator|link prefix|link suffix` options, e.g. `{NAVI:1-3, &middot;|<li>|</li>}`. |

Link classes come from `template_default['classes']`: `search-paginate-link`, `search-paginate-link-active`, `search-paginate-link-disabled`; custom pagination output is wrapped in `<div class="…search-nextprev">`.

## Storage

Serialized array `search` in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` with the keys `result_per_page`, `wordlimit`, `newwin`, `highlight_result`, `label_input`, `style_input`, `label_button`, `style_button`, `label_result` (legacy, unused), `style_result` (legacy, unused), `align`, `text_intro`, `text_result`, `text_noresult`, `template` (legacy duplicate of `acontent_template`), `text_html`, `label_pages`, `minchar`, `start_at`, `show_always`, `show_top`, `show_bottom`, `show_next`, `show_prev`, `module`, `search_news`, `news_lang`, `news_category`, `news_andor`, `news_url`, `no_filenames`, `no_username`, `no_caption`, `no_keyword`, `hide_summary`, `type`. The template file name is additionally stored in `acontent_template`.

## Related

- News records searched here: [News (cp 33)](19-news.md)
- Article listing content parts: [Teaser/link article (cp 8)](17-teaser-link-article.md), [Article menu (cp 15)](18-article-menu.md)

<!-- docs/content-parts/21-sitemap.md -->

# Sitemap (content part 19)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt19.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt19.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt19.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/front.func.inc.php` (`build_sitemap()`, `build_sitemap_articlelist()`)

Walks the visible structure levels below a start level and optionally lists each level's articles. Output is fixed nested `<ul>/<li>` markup — no template file.

## Backend form

Fields as they appear in the content part dialog, top to bottom.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Before | textarea | *(empty)* | `before`: raw HTML prepended to the sitemap. |
| After | textarea | *(empty)* | `after`: raw HTML appended. |
| Category image | text (URL) | *(empty)* | `catimg`: used as `list-style-image` on every category `<li>`. |
| Article image | text (URL) | *(empty)* | `articleimg`: `list-style-image` on every article `<li>`. |
| Start level | select | Index (0) | `startid`: structure level where the walk begins. |
| Display | radio | Structure only | `display`: 0 lists only structure levels; 1 also lists each level's articles. |
| Without parent | checkbox | off | `without_parent`: do not wrap the start level itself as the first `<li>`. |
| Category class | text | *(empty)* | `catclass`: CSS class on the category `<ul>` tags. |
| Article class | text | *(empty)* | `articleclass`: CSS class on the article `<ul>` tags. |
| Class counter | radio | None | `classcount`: append the nesting depth number to both classes. |

## Rendering

- The start level is only rendered when it is not flagged "no sitemap" (`acat_nositemap`); child levels pass the same check plus `_getStructureLevelDisplayStatus()`: the level must directly follow the requested start level in the tree, not be hidden (hidden-with-keyword levels excepted), and not be registration-only for guests.
- Structure markup: every level becomes `<li style="list-style-image:url(catimg)"><a href="…">name</a>` followed by the optional article list and the child `<ul>`. Level names are HTML-escaped; the class on each child `<ul>` is `catclass` with the depth number appended when Class counter is set.
- Level links use the level alias or `id=<level id>`; a level redirect (`acat_redirect`) links straight to its target with the redirect target attribute.
- Article list (Display = structure + articles): selects `article_id, article_title, article_alias` where the article summary's "Sitemap" checkbox is set (`article_nositemap = 1`), the article is active and not deleted, and the visibility window applies outside preview mode. Sorted by the level's article order (`acat_order`, `get_order_sort()`, led by `article_priorize DESC`) — the same table as in Article menu (cp 15). The list only renders when more than one article matches (`count > 1`), wrapped in `<ul class="articleclass…">`.
- Article links use the article alias or `aid=<article id>`; titles are HTML-escaped.
- The whole block is wrapped in `<div class="…" id="…">` when the content part carries an attribute class or ID, and the content part title/subtitle render through the standard `headline()` function.

## Storage

Serialized array `sitemap` in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` with the keys `before`, `after`, `catimg`, `articleimg`, `display`, `catclass`, `articleclass`, `classcount`, `startid`, `without_parent`. No `acontent_template` value is used.

## Related

- Simple article list of one level: [Article menu (cp 15)](18-article-menu.md)
- Teaser lists with templates: [Teaser/link article (cp 8)](17-teaser-link-article.md)

# RSS feed (content part 22)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt22.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt22.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt22.article.inc.php`, `template/inc_default/rssfeed.tmpl`

Fetches a remote feed with SimplePie and renders feed info plus item list from a template. Nothing is output while the feed cannot be read or parsed.

## Backend form

Fields as they appear in the content part dialog, top to bottom.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | File from `template/inc_cntpart/rssfeed/`. Empty uses `template/inc_default/rssfeed.tmpl`. |
| Feed URL | text | *(empty)* | `rssurl`: the feed to import; without a URL the content part renders nothing. |
| Items | text (10 chars) | *(empty = all)* | `item`: maximum number of items (`set_item_limit`). |
| Source content type | select | Automatic | `content_type`: input charset passed to SimplePie when the feed does not declare it; values come from the installation's charset list. |
| Cache | checkbox | on | `cacheoff`: check "Off" to disable caching entirely. |
| Cache timeout | select | Default | `timeout`: 0 = default value of 3600 seconds (1 hour), otherwise 1 minute to 1 month; picking a value unchecks the cache Off box. |

The feed cache lives in `content/rss/` (`PHPWCMS_RSS`, defined in `include/inc_lib/default.inc.php`). Rendered feed text is passed to the output charset (`PHPWCMS_CHARSET`), wrapped in div removed, and all HTML tags are stripped before rendering.

## Rendering

### Template sections

| Section | Meaning |
| ------- | ------- |
| `RSSFEED` | Overall wrapper — also holds the assembled `{FEEDINFO}` and `{ITEMS}`. |
| `FEEDINFO` | Feed-level block: feed title, description and feed image. |
| `ITEM` | Repeated per item. |
| `DIVIDER` | Markup placed through `{DIVIDER}` wherever the wrapper wants it (the default puts it above and below the item `<ul>`). |

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[TITLE]`/`{TITLE}`, `[DESCRIPTION]`/`{DESCRIPTION}` | Feed title and description in `FEEDINFO`; item title and description in `ITEM`; content part title/subtitle in `RSSFEED` (where the tag is `{TITLE}` inside `[TITLE]`). |
| `[IMAGE]`/`{IMAGE}` | Feed logo `<img>` linked to the feed image link or feed permalink (in `FEEDINFO`); item thumbnail URL from the first enclosure (in `ITEM`) — only image extensions `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `gif` qualify. |
| `[LINK]`/`{LINK}` | Item permalink in `ITEM`; feed permalink in `RSSFEED`. |
| `[CONTENT]`/`{CONTENT}` | Item full content. |
| `[AUTHOR]`/`{AUTHOR}` | Item author name. |
| `{DATE:… lang=EN}` | Item publication date (`render_cnt_date`, so `{LIVEDATE}`/`{NOW}` variants work). |
| `{ITEMS}` | All rendered items joined by line breaks. |
| `{FEEDINFO}` | The rendered feed info block. |
| `{DIVIDER}` | Divider markup. |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]`/`{ATTR_CLASS}`, `[ATTR_ID]`/`{ATTR_ID}` `[ATTR_CLASS_ELSE]` | Content part wrapper class and `id`. |

Values pass through mostly unescaped — as parsed from the feed after tag stripping.

## Storage

Serialized array `rssfeed` in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` with the keys `rssurl`, `template`, `item`, `cut1st` (legacy, no backend field and not evaluated), `cacheoff`, `timeout`, `content_type`. No `acontent_template` value is used.

## Related

- News list content part (own records, not remote feeds): [News (cp 33)](19-news.md)

<!-- docs/content-parts/23-ext-content.md -->

# Ext. content (content part 21)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt21.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt21.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt21.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/front.func.inc.php` (`include_url()`, `include_ext_php()`)

Includes the content of a page file from `content/pages/` or — in manual mode — any other local file or remote URL. No templates, no template tags.

## Backend form

Fields as they appear in the content part dialog, top to bottom.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Source | radio in input group | From file | `cpage_source`: 0 selects a file from the page browser, 1 takes what is typed into the text field (manual/URL). |
| Custom source field | text | *(empty)* | `cpage_custom`: in manual mode a local path (must exist as file at save time) or a URL — the URL must pass URL validation, and its base URL (without query string) must be fetchable at save time, otherwise the field is cleared. |
| Page browser | radio file list | — | Lists `content/pages/` recursively; accepted extensions are `html`, `htm`, `txt`, `php`, `inc`, `tmpl`; selecting a radio fills the include path (`cpage_file`). Shown regardless of the chosen source. |

A warning shows below the browser while `phpwcms['enable_inline_php']` is off: local PHP files are read as text, not executed.

File paths are normalized and must resolve inside `content/pages/` (`path_is_within()` check); anything else is dropped on save.

## Rendering

- Content part wrapper: `<div class="…" id="…">` when an attribute class or ID is set; content part title/subtitle render through the standard `headline()` function.
- Manual/URL mode (`source = 1`): runs `include_url()` in `include/inc_front/front.func.inc.php`:
  - Fetches the URL via `file_get_contents`; a trailing `CACHE=<seconds>` fragment caches the fetched markup in `content/tmp/` for that many seconds.
  - Charset detection from the meta tag; the body converts into the installation charset.
  - Content between `<body>` and `</body>` is extracted; PHP delimiters are neutralized; relative `href`/`src`/`action` attributes become absolute URLs; output is sanitized (`htmlfilter_sanitize`).
- File mode (`source = 0`): the stored path is read from disk relative to the installation root — or executed through `include_ext_php()` when `phpwcms['enable_inline_php']` is on, so local PHP can generate the output. The result is emitted as: body inner markup when a full HTML document with `<body>`; the markup as-is when it looks like HTML; otherwise HTML-escaped plain text.
- Remote URLs are only honored when `allow_remote_URL` is enabled in `conf.inc.php` (checked inside `include_ext_php`; `include_url()` itself fetches regardless — the save-time validation gates entry).

## Storage

Serialized array `page_file` in `phpwcms_articlecontent.acontent_form` with the keys `source` (0 = file from `content/pages/`, 1 = manual/URL) and `pfile` (path, file path, or URL). No `acontent_template` value is used.

## Related

- Local records instead of remote content: [News (cp 33)](19-news.md)
- Output pipeline for included markup: [General concepts](../general/concepts.md)

<!-- docs/content-parts/24-ecard.md -->

# E-card (content part 16)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt16.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt16.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt16.inc.php`

The visitor picks one image from the CP gallery, fills in sender, recipient and an optional message, and the content part mails the result as an HTML e-mail to the recipient. Everything is configured inside the content part dialog; the CP has no template selection.

## Purpose

A pick-and-send greeting card form. When the form is posted with valid e-mail addresses, phpwcms sends the mail immediately and prints the send confirmation; otherwise the chooser image list and the form are shown again with validation. The CP uses `PhpwcmsMailer` with the site SMTP settings.

## Backend form

Fields top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt16.inc.php`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Subject | text, max 250 | *(empty)* | Mail subject. Empty subject falls back to `E-Card: <caption>` where `<caption>` is the text line of the chosen image. |
| Chooser | radio | Radiobutton | How the visitor picks the card: `Radiobutton` (radio list) or `JavaScript` (table cells with your JS event handlers plus a hidden `ecard_chooser` input). |
| Onmouseover | text | — | JS snippet appended as `onmouseover` on each chooser caption cell of the chooser. JavaScript mode only. |
| Onclick | text | — | JS snippet appended as `onclick` on the same cell. Trailing semicolons are normalized automatically. |
| Onmouseout | text | — | JS snippet appended as `onmouseout` on the same cell. |
| Image | multi-select | none | Images from the file center (`filebrowser.php?opt=3`). Order is set with the up/down buttons; thumbnails are listed below the select. |
| Alignment | select | Left | Chooser table alignment: `0` left, `1` center, `2` right. |
| Max width | number, px | — | Chosen image width. Capped to `(content_width − (columns − 1) × space) / columns` when `RESPONSIVE_MODE` is off or the value is empty. |
| Max height | number, px | — | Chosen image height, proportional when the other value is 0. |
| Columns | select 1–25 | 1 | Chooser table columns; reduced to the image count when larger. |
| Image space | number, px | — | Horizontal space between chooser images; factored into the width cap above. |
| Enlarge | checkbox | off | Stored as `zoom`; the frontend renderer (`cnt16.article.inc.php`) does not read this flag. |
| Card texts | textarea, one line per image | — | One line per image, mapped to the image at the same position. A line starting with `~` shows the text (without the `~`) as caption only and the image is not offered as a card. A second segment after `\|` keeps the caption part for the entry list. |

## Rendering

The three HTML blocks are single storage fields, not template files.

**Chooser list** — built by `imagelisttable()` (`include/inc_front/img.func.inc.php`) with `type=1`: each card gets a caption cell with a radio (`ecard_chooser_<index>`) or the JS handlers in JavaScript mode. Cell classes come from `template_default['article']['ecard_chooser_css']` (`class="my-1"` by default) and `ecard_chooser_text` (`class="fw-bold"`). The list replaces `###ECARD_CHOOSER###` in the form template.

**Form** — the renderer strips any `<form>…</form>` wrapper from your markup (readform) and wraps everything itself:

```html
<form action="<REQUEST_URI>" method="post" name="send_ecard">…</form>
```

| Placeholder | Meaning |
| ----------- | ------- |
| `###ECARD_CHOOSER###` | The chooser list. |
| `###SENDER_NAME###` `###SENDER_EMAIL###` `###RECIPIENT_NAME###` `###RECIPIENT_EMAIL###` `###SENDER_MESSAGE###` | Value re-fill after a failed post. A `name="###SENDER_NAME###"` etc. attribute is rewritten to `ecard_sender_name`, `ecard_sender_email`, `ecard_recipient_name`, `ecard_recipient_email`, `ecard_sender_msg`. |
| `###ECARD_SUBJECT###` | Prefilled subject. |
| `<!--FORM_ERROR_START-->…<!--FORM_ERROR_END-->` | Kept only when validation failed (invalid sender or recipient address). |
| `###BUTTON###` | Not replaced by the renderer; the shipped default form carries it inside `name="###BUTTON###"`. The submit posts with `ecard_chooser` as identifier. |

**Send confirmation** — printed after a successful post. Placeholders: `###ECARD_TITLE###` (image caption), `###ECARD_IMAGE###` (thumbnail at the stored card size), `###RECIPIENT_NAME###`, `###RECIPIENT_EMAIL###`, `###SENDER_MESSAGE###`, `###ECARD_SUBJECT###`.

**Mail template** — HTML mail body when you provide one. Same placeholders plus `###SENDER_NAME###` and `###SENDER_EMAIL###`; `###ECARD_IMAGE###` here is a site-absolute `<img>` at `img_prev_width`/`img_prev_height`. Without a mail template phpwcms uses a built-in layout: title, sender line, image, message and a link back to `$phpwcms['site']`.

## Storage

One serialized value; no separate template column.

- `acontent_form` — `serialize($content['ecard'])` with `images[]` as `f_id : name : hash : ext : width : height : caption` rows, `form`, `send`, `mail`, and all chooser settings.

## Related

- Every CP shares title/subtitle, block and attribute fields: see [Core concepts](../general/concepts.md#the-content-hierarchy).
- Form handling with result storage lives in the Form CP (cp 23); this CP mails only.
- Glossary entries for terms used above: [Glossary](../modules/13-glossary.md#content-part).

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/25-form.md -->

# Form (content part 23)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt23.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt23.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt23.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/general.inc.php`

The general-purpose form builder, labeled `Form` in the backend. You add any number of fields, phpwcms renders them, validates the post and delivers the values as text or HTML mail to one or more recipients. Form tracking, spam protection, file uploads, a newsletter opt-in and double opt-in are built in.

## Purpose

One CP covers contact forms, feedback forms, "send a friend" forms and newsletter sign-up forms. Posts can additionally be stored as result sets that you download from the backend. The CP disables switching it to another type (`target_ctype` is set to 23 and disabled).

## Backend form

The dialog has five tabs (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt23.inc.php`).

> Source for the following three tables: Tab 1 and tab 2 fields, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt23.inc.php`.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Subject | select + text | *(empty)* | Mail subject. The select maps the subject onto a form field (`formfield_<name>`); its posted value is appended to the typed subject. Empty subject falls back to `Webform: <site domain>`. |
| Recipient | select + text | Email | `Email` plus addresses (`;`-separated, lowercased, validated) or one email-typed form field (`emailfield_<name>`); the field value becomes the recipient. Empty recipient falls back to `SMTP_FROM_EMAIL`. |
| Sender email | select + text | Email | Sender address: typed address, system `SMTP_FROM_EMAIL`, or an email field used at post time. |
| Sender name | select + text | Custom | Sender display name: typed, system `SMTP_FROM_NAME`, or a text field used at post time. |
| Send copy to | checkbox + select + text | off | Adds a copy of the mail. The select picks any text field whose value receives the copy at post time; the text field accepts static CC addresses (`;`-separated, validated). A `checkboxcopy` field lets the visitor decline the copy. |
| Recipient differs from sender | checkbox | off | Rejects the post when copy address equals a recipient address. |
| Startup text | textarea, Text/HTML | — | Shown above the form until it is posted. |
| On success | textarea, Text/HTML/Redirect | — | Response after a valid post; HTML is printed, Redirect jumps to the given URL. Field placeholders `{<field>}`, `{REMOTE_IP}`, the `[EMAIL_COPY]…[/EMAIL_COPY]` block (copy address, URL-encoded in redirect mode) and `{SITE}` (redirect mode only) are replaced. |
| On error | textarea, Text/HTML/Redirect | — | Same modes for a failed validation. |

### Form fields

> Source: field loop in `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt23.inc.php` and `include/inc_lib/content/cnt23.readform.inc.php`.

Every field card carries: Type, Name, Label, S/C (`size`: size, select columns or min value), M/R (`max`: maxlength, textarea rows, select max or step), Required, Delete, Value, Placeholder, Error text, CSS class, CSS style, and Sort handle. Types, in select order:

`text`, `email`, `tel`, `url`, `number`, `date`, `time`, `color`, `range`, `textarea`, `special`, `hidden`, `password`, `selectemail`, `select`, `country`, `list`, `newsletter`, `checkbox`, `checkboxcopy`, `radio`, `upload`, `reCAPTCHA`, `Invisible reCAPTCHA`, `captcha`, `captcha image`, `math spam protect`, `send button`, `reset button`, `break`, `break text`.

Type-specific notes verifiable in code:

- `email` — validated with `is_valid_email()`; can act as recipient, sender or sender-name source.
- `special` — value is an INI-style list: `type=` (`MIX`, `INT`, `FLOAT`, `DEC`, `IDENT`, `STRING`, `DATE`, `A-Z`, `a-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `WORD`, `LETTER+SPACE`, `PHONE`, `REGEX`), `default=`, `dateformat=` (default `Y-m-d`), `validatedateformat=`, `pattern=`; `default=NOW` fills the current date in date mode. `IDENT` compares posted value with the default.
- `select` / `selectemail` / `country` / `list` — one option per line, `OPTGROUP <label>` / `/OPTGROUP` group rows, `label-|-value` pairs; a row ending in ` selected` preselects, an option value ending in ` -` renders an empty first option. `selectemail` encrypts posted values with `phpwcms_encrypt()`; `country` takes `lang=`, `default=`, `prepend=`, `first=` INI values and uses `list_country()`.
- `checkbox` / `radio` / `checkboxcopy` — `M/R` accepts `B3`, `B4`, `B5` to switch to Bootstrap form-check markup; multiple value lines build a group and post as array.
- `newsletter` — value is an INI list: `all=`, `email_field=`, `name_field=` (`+`-joined field names), `sender_email=`, `sender_name=`, `url_subscribe=`, `url_unsubscribe=`, `double_optin=`, `optin_template=`, `subject=` and numeric subscription IDs (`<id>=<label>`). Requires a valid `email_field`. A newsletter field shows a `verifyemail` textarea as the opt-in mail template.
- `upload` — value INI list: `maxlength=`, `folder=` (default `content/form/`, must exist and be writable), `accept=` (replaces `exclude=`), `exclude=` (long script/config blocklist by default), `attachment=` (attach to mail instead of link), `text_no_upload=`. Files are renamed `<time>_<sanitized name>`; error text placeholders `{MAXLENGTH}`, `{FILESIZE}`, `{FILENAME}`, `{FILEEXT}`.
- `captcha` / `captcha image` — SPAF captcha (`img/captcha.php`). The backend disables adding a second `captcha`, `captcha image`, `math spam protect`, `reCAPTCHA`, invisible reCAPTCHA or `submit` row once one of each exists in the form.
- `math spam protect` — value INI list of operators text: `+`, `-`, `*`, `:`, `calc`; the question is randomized, the result is posted as MD5 hash of a salted calculation.
- `reCAPTCHA` — INI values `site_key=`, `secret_key=` (aliases `public_key=`, `private_key=`), `lang=`, `theme=`, `type=`, `size=`; missing keys fall back to user reCAPTCHA settings.
- `text`–`radio` single values and `textarea`/`list`/`checkbox` get a "Store in profile" select when "Store in profile" is on.
- Fields whose name, label, value, error and style all stay empty are dropped. Names are cleaned with `attribute_name_clean()`; `submit` and `reset` names get an `It` suffix; duplicate base names get numeric suffixes.
- Newsletter field row 5 also carries the opt-in mail template (`cform_field_verifyemail`).

### Templates tab

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Custom HTML | textarea, ACE | — | Full custom layout, active only when Label position is `Custom`. Placeholder menu offers `{<field>}`, `{ERROR:<field>}`, `{LABEL:<field>}`. |
| Recipient template | Text/HTML radio | Text | Mail body. Text keeps raw values; HTML html-escapes strings and links uploads instead of printing the URL. WYSIWYG editor in HTML mode. |
| PHP function | text | — | Callback for the recipient mail, called before sending with `($POST_savedb, $cnt_form, $mail)`. Stored names that are already callable get a `_Proof_` prefix. |
| Copy template | checkbox "same as recipient" + text/HTML | equal | Separate body for the copy mail. |

### Result tab

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Save results in DB | checkbox | off | Writes each successful post to `phpwcms_formresult`. |
| Store in profile | checkbox | off | Enables per-field "Store in profile" selects for frontend user data. |
| Disable form tracking | checkbox | off | Omits the form tracking token; recommended for "send a friend" forms. |
| Download button | button | — | Shown when results exist; opens `include/inc_act/act_export.php?…action=exportformresult&fid=<CP id>` with a CSRF token and prints the stored row count. |
| Direct download | checkbox + 16-char key + reset/copy | off | Public export URL with `apikey` parameter; the key is regenerated server-side whenever it does not match `^[a-zA-Z0-9]{16}$`. |

> Source: result tab and `include/inc_act/act_export.php`.

The default form settings (`subject`, `label_wrap` = `|:`, `error_class` = `error`, required mark `*`, `template_equal` = 1) come from the defaults block in `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt23.inc.php`.

## Rendering

### Label position

Four modes selected in the fields tab; `0` = table rows label/field, `1` = table rows field only (label above), `3` = DIV-based modern markup, `2` = your custom template. Required fields get the required mark appended to the label and a `required` class; each row gets `form-type-<type>` and optional `ftc-<class>`. The form element carries `id="phpwcmsForm<CP id>"`, `data-bs-toggle="validator"`, `novalidate` when set, `enctype="multipart/form-data"` with an upload field, a hidden `cpID<CP id>` identity field, all hidden fields and the form tracking token; `anchor_off`/`anchor_name` control the form anchor.

### Custom HTML tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{<field name>}` | The rendered field control. |
| `{LABEL:<field name>}` | The label text. |
| `{ERROR:<field name>}` | Field error text; empty when valid. |
| `[IF_ERROR:<name>]…[/IF_ERROR]` | Kept when that field failed validation. |
| `[ELSE_ERROR:<name>]…[/ELSE_ERROR]` | Kept when it passed. |
| `[IF_ERROR]…[/IF_ERROR]` `[ELSE_ERROR]…[/ELSE_ERROR]` | Overall validation state. |
| `data-recaptchainv-submit` | Rewritten to the invisible reCAPTCHA button attributes or stripped when the form has no invisible reCAPTCHA. |

Mail placeholders: `{<field>}`, `{FORM_URL}` (the page URL), `{REMOTE_IP}` (anonymized IP in GDPR mode), `{DATE:<format>}`. Unknown placeholders are stripped after replacement.

### Processing order

A post matching `cpID<id>` runs field validation, then your custom validate function (`function validate($POST_val, $fields, $CP id)`, returning `FALSE` fails the form), then spam tracking, then mail delivery in this order: double-opt-in mail (when configured, without sending the main mail) or copy mail, then recipient mail with attachments. Uploads are deleted when validation fails. On success the startup text is replaced by the success response; on error the error response plus per-field messages (`error_class`, default `error`) precede the form again.

## Storage

- Configuration and fields: `acontent_form`, serialized (max packet raised to 16 MB in `cnt23.sql.inc.php`).
- Stored results: `phpwcms_formresult` rows `formresult_pid`, `formresult_ip`, `formresult_content` (serialized field values plus upload file URLs; double opt-in adds `hash`). Export by `exportformresult` and `exportformresultdetail` in `include/inc_act/act_export.php`.
- Form tracking tokens: `phpwcms_formtracking` (`formtracking_hash` = MD5 of IP + salt + hour, `formtracking_ip`, `formtracking_sent`); see `getFormTrackingValue()` / `checkFormTrackingValue()` in `include/inc_lib/general.inc.php`. Not written in GDPR mode.
- Uploads land in the configured folder, default `content/form/`.
- Newsletter opt-ins are inserted into `phpwcms_address` like the newsletter CP does.

## Related

- Newsletter subscription forms: see [Newsletter (cp 12)](27-newsletter-cp.md).
- [Core concepts](../general/concepts.md#rendering-model) explains how posts reach the CP renderer.

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/26-email-form-old.md -->

# Email form generator [old] (content part 10)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt10.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt10.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt10.inc.php`, `include/inc_act/act_formmailer.php`

**Deprecated.** The backend lists this type as `Email form generator [old]` (`$wcs_content_type[10]` in `include/inc_lib/article.contenttype.inc.php`). It has no template support, no per-field errors, no result storage and no double opt-in. Use the Form CP (cp 23) for new forms.

## Purpose

A quick contact form defined as one text block. The post target is the standalone endpoint `include/inc_act/act_formmailer.php`, which validates, rate-limits and mails the values as plain text.

## Backend form

Fields as in the dialog, top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt10.inc.php`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Subject | text, max 250 | `Online webform email message` | Mail subject. |
| Recipient | text | — | Single, address-validated recipient. Empty or invalid blocks the save with a backend error message. |
| Button text | text, max 35 | `Send` | Submit button label. |
| Send as | radio | Text | `Text` or `HTML` mail type; posted as the hidden field `type`. |
| Form fields | textarea, one field per line | — | Field codes, see table below. |

### Field code syntax

One line per field: `TYPE|name|required|label|length,maxheight|value or options|width(px)`.

| Code | Control | `length,maxheight` | Segment 5 |
| ---- | ------- | ------------------ | --------- |
| `IT` | Text input | size, maxlength | Prefilled value |
| `IN` | Text input, numeric key filtering | size, maxlength | Prefilled value |
| `IP` | Password input | size, maxlength | — |
| `IH` | Hidden input | — | Hidden value |
| `TA` | Textarea | cols, rows (default 3) | Content |
| `SM` | Select menu | — | Options split by `#`; `value%text` pairs |
| `SL` | Select list | size, multiple flag | Options like `SM` |
| `IC` | Checkbox group | columns per row | Options like `SM`; value defaults to 1 |
| `IR` | Radio group | columns per row | Options like `SM`; value defaults to 1 |
| `SC` | Country select | — | Default country code |
| `CA` | Captcha input plus image | size, maxlength | — |

A `required` value of 1 adds the field name to the hidden `required` list posted to the formmailer; `CA` fields are forced to required (readform sets `name=Captcha_Validation`, `required=1`). Lines that do not start with a known code are dropped; an empty name becomes `field_<random>`.

## Rendering

A hard-coded table inside `<form action="include/inc_act/act_formmailer.php" method="post">`; labels get `class="formLabel"` and a filled-marker for required fields, controls get `inputText`, `formTextArea`, `selectMenu`, `selectList`, `formButton` classes. The renderer appends the hidden fields `subject`, `recipient`, `type`, the `required` list, and the form tracking token from `getFormTrackingValue()`.

### Formmailer endpoint behavior

`include/inc_act/act_formmailer.php` accepts the CP post plus optional hidden fields you may add manually to the field codes: `language` (2-letter formmailer language, default `EN`), `charset` (default `utf-8`), `recipient_name`, `label` (`name|label` pairs for error messages), `redirect`, `redirect_template`, `redirect_error`, `redirect_error_template`, and `send_copy` (honored only when `$phpwcms['formmailer_set']['allow_send_copy']` is on; the recipient is overridden by `$phpwcms['formmailer_set']['global_recipient_email']` when configured). The endpoint checks the HTTP referrer, enforces 10 posts per 60 seconds per IP file-based, verifies the form tracking value, validates captcha and required fields and answers failures with the translated error page from `include/inc_lang/formmailer/` or your error redirect. A valid post is mailed as plain text table to the recipient.

## Storage

`acontent_form` holds a `#:#`-joined, non-serialized string: `base64(field lines) #:# subject #:# recipient #:# button text #:# mail type`. Nothing else is written; posts are never stored.

## Related

- Replacement: [Form (cp 23)](25-form.md) covers the current form builder with templates, storage and opt-ins.
- [Templates](../general/concepts.md#templates) — this CP ignores CP template selection.

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/27-newsletter-cp.md -->

# Newsletter (content part 12)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt12.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt12.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt12.inc.php`, `verify.php`

The subscription form of the newsletter system, labeled `Newsletter`. Visitors pick one or more lists, phpwcms writes or updates the address record with a new random key, mails a verification link and prints a success text. Verified addresses are consumed by the newsletter module; this CP only handles subscribing and address updates.

## Purpose

Double opt-in subscription. Posting an already known address resets `address_verified` to 0 and re-sends the verification mail, so the subscriber confirms lists again after a change. Verification and deletion endpoints live in the site root `verify.php`.

## Backend form

Fields top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt12.inc.php`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Subscription | option transfer | — | Left list = offered subscriptions, right = available ones: every active entry of `phpwcms_subscription` plus entry `0` = all subscriptions. Stored as subscription ID list. |
| Label email | text, max 100 | `@@email:@@` | Form label for the email input. |
| Alignment | select | Default | `0` default, `1` left float, `2` center, `3` right float; class comes from `template_default['classes']['newsletter-table']`. |
| Label name | text, max 100 | `@@name:@@` | Form label for the optional name input. |
| Button text | text, max 50 | `@@Subscribe@@` | Submit label. |
| Label subscriptions | text, max 100 | `@@subscribe to:@@` | Fieldset legend for the subscription checkboxes. |
| All subscriptions | text, max 50 | `@@subscribe to all@@` | Label of the "all" checkbox. |
| Info text | textarea | — | Intro paragraph above the form. |
| Success text | textarea | — | Shown after a valid post; `{NEWSLETTER_EMAIL}` is replaced. Without it a generic confirmation is printed. |
| URL 1 | text | — | Redirect target after the subscriber verifies the address (`verify.php?s=…`). Stored per address. |
| URL 2 | text | — | Redirect target after the subscriber deletes the address (`verify.php?u=…`). |
| reCAPTCHA | select | Off | `Off`, `Invisible reCAPTCHA`, `reCAPTCHA v2`. |
| Settings | textarea, INI | `site_key = ` etc. | `site_key=`, `secret_key=`, `type=image\|audio`, `lang=`; v2 adds `theme=dark\|light` and `size=normal\|compact`, invisible adds `badge=bottomright\|bottomleft\|inline`. Invalid values fall back to the defaults. |
| Registration mail | textarea | built-in | Verification mail for new addresses. |
| Logoff mail | textarea | built-in | Verification mail for existing addresses (updates). |
| Change mail | textarea | built-in | Same as registration mail fallback. |

Empty mail texts fall back to a built-in template that asks the subscriber to verify `{NEWSLETTER_EMAIL}` and links `{NEWSLETTER_VERIFY}` / `{NEWSLETTER_DELETE}`, signed with `SMTP_FROM_NAME` and `admin_email`.

## Rendering

The form is hard-coded, id `subscribe-newsletter-form<CP id>`, posts `newsletter_email`, `newsletter_name` and `email_subscription[<id>]` checkboxes. With exactly one subscription the CP emits one hidden field instead of checkboxes. Validation failures print `formError` paragraphs: subscription not chosen, reCAPTCHA error (`@@recaptcha-error:<code>@@`) or mail send error. Success prints the success text with `{NEWSLETTER_EMAIL}` replaced.

### Verification mail tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{NEWSLETTER_NAME}` | Subscriber name. |
| `{NEWSLETTER_EMAIL}` | Subscriber address. |
| `{NEWSLETTER_VERIFY}` | `verify.php?s=<key>` — sets `address_verified=1` and redirects to URL 1 when set. |
| `{NEWSLETTER_DELETE}` | `verify.php?u=<key>` — deletes the address row and redirects to URL 2 when set. |
| `{IP}` `{DATE:<format>}` | Global tags from `replaceGlobalRT()`. |
| `[SUBJECT]…[/SUBJECT]` | Subject inside the mail text; default `Newsletter verification for <site>`. |

Verification pages render `template/inc_default/subscribe.tmpl` and `unsubscribe.tmpl` with `{EMAIL}` and `{PHPWCMS_URL}` replaced; both pages set `robots noindex` and refresh back to the homepage after 10 seconds.

## Storage

- Configuration: `acontent_newsletter`, serialized.
- Subscribers: `phpwcms_address` (`address_key` = 32 hex chars from `random_bytes(16)`, `address_email`, `address_name`, `address_verified`, `address_subscription` serialized ID array, `address_url1`, `address_url2`). Updates log `log_message()` entries 1–4.
- Lists: `phpwcms_subscription` maintained in the newsletter module backend.

## Related

- Newsletter field inside a form: [Form (cp 23)](25-form.md).
- Address and subscription management: Modules section, newsletter module. See [Glossary](../modules/13-glossary.md#backend) for backend terms.

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/28-guestbook.md -->

# Guestbook/comment (content part 18)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt18.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt18.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt_functions/cnt18.func.inc.php`, `template/inc_default/guestbook.tmpl`

A signable guestbook or comment list. Entries share one storage thread identified by the CP id (or an alias id), so several content parts can feed the same guestbook. The CP supports a WYSIWYG-free entry form, SPAF captcha, word and IP ban lists from the template, flood protection, image upload and per-entry image thumbnails with zoom.

## Purpose

Collect visitor posts and render a paginated, sortable list. Entries are stored in their own table, not in article content, so they survive CP edits and can be moderated in the backend article view (trash flag in `phpwcms_guestbook`).

## Backend form

Fields top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt18` via `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt18.inc.php` and readform normalization).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | File from `template/inc_cntpart/guestbook/` (`BS5.tmpl` shipped); empty falls back to `template/inc_default/guestbook.tmpl`. |
| Listing | radio + number | All entries | `All entries` renders the complete list without navigation; `Page listing` activates pagination and needs a non-zero entries-per-page value. |
| Sort order | checkbox | — | Descending (newest first, default) when off, ascending when on. |
| Image upload | checkbox | off | Adds the file input; stores to `content/guestbook_<cid>/`, JPG/GIF/PNG only, size-limited. |
| Max image size | text | `file_maxsize` config | Upload size limit, shortened byte string. |
| Banned words | text | — | Space-separated list, merged with the template `BAN` section. |
| Alias ID | number | — | Reuse another guestbook CP's entry thread (`guestbook_cid`). |
| Flood time | number, seconds | — | Minimum seconds between posts. |
| Cookie flood check | checkbox | off | Also sets a `phpwcms_guestbook<cid>` cookie for the flood check. |
| Captcha | checkbox | off | Shows the SPAF captcha input. |
| Captcha max chars | number | 5 | Accepted code length, clamped 1–15. |
| Visible only when logged in | checkbox | off | Non-logged-in visitors see the `LOGIN_INFO` template section instead of form and list. |
| Post only when logged in | checkbox | off | List stays public; the sign form is replaced by the `LOGIN_INFO` section. |
| Check URL | checkbox | off | Tries to open the posted homepage via `fopen` before accepting it. |
| Notify by email | checkbox + text | off | Sends a plain-text notice per entry to the given addresses. Needs the template file `template/inc_cntpart/guestbook/notify_email.txt`; without it a one-line default is sent. |

## Rendering

The template file is split into sections; each section has `<!--SECTION_START//-->` / `<!--SECTION_END//-->` markers.

| Section | Role |
| ------- | ---- |
| `FORM` | Entry form; wrapped in `<form name="sign_guestbook" method="post"` plus `enctype` when uploads are on, closed with the form tracking token. |
| `FORM_ERROR` | Kept only after a failed post. |
| `FORM_SUCCESS` | Confirmation after a stored entry. |
| `NAV` | Pagination, archive and jump controls. |
| `GUESTBOOK` | Outer list wrapper; `{FORM}` and `{NAV}` placeholders, `GUESTBOOK_ENTRY` block per entry. |
| `BAN` / `BAN_REPLACE` / `BAN_IP` | Banned words, replacement (default `***`), banned IPs from the default template. Entries are filtered case-insensitively. |
| `COMMENT` | Wraps inline comments written in messages as `[c]comment[/c]`; default separator `<span class="gbComment">|</span>`. |
| `LOGIN_INFO` | Shown instead of form and/or list when a login mode is active. |

### Form tags

`{EMAIL}` `{NAME}` `{URL}` `{MSG}` refill posted values, `{GBSHOW_0/1/2}` check the "display email" radios (show, hide, obfuscate as `name at host dot tld`), `{CAPTCHA}` prints the captcha image, `[IMAGE_ERROR]{IMAGE_ERROR}[/IMAGE_ERROR]`-style blocks carry the per-error messages: `ERROR_EMAIL`, `ERROR_NAME`, `ERROR_URL`, `ERROR_IMG`, `ERROR_IMGUPLOAD`, `ERROR_IMGFORMAT`, `ERROR_IMGWRITE`, `ERROR_IMGSAVE`, `ERROR_IMGSIZE`, `ERROR_CAPTCHA`. Post fields are `guestbook_email`, `guestbook_name`, `guestbook_url`, `guestbook_msg`, `guestbook_show`, `guestbook_captcha`, `guestbook_image`.

### List and navigation tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{EMAIL}` `{NAME}` `{MSG}` | Entry data; message runs through `html()` and `nl2br()`. |
| `{URL:HTML}` | Homepage link, prefixed `http://`. |
| `{ID}` / `{DBID}` | Running entry number / `guestbook_id`. |
| `{TIMESTAMP:m/d/Y H:i}` | Entry date via `date()` format. |
| `[EMAIL]…[/EMAIL]` | Dropped when the visitor chose "hide email"; obfuscated text replaces the mailto in obfuscate mode. |
| `[IMAGE]{IMAGE:50x50x1}[/IMAGE]` | Cached thumbnail; third segment 1 enables the zoom popup via `image_zoom.php`, width/height 0 = proportional. |
| `{FIRST:<h>}` `{BACK:<h>}` `{NEXT:<h>}` `{LAST:<h>}` | Page links, argument is the link text. |
| `{PAGE:5:&nbsp;\|<strong>\|</strong>}` | Page number links; `count`, spacer, active wrap. |
| `{ARCHIVE:%Y/%m\|all entries\|go\|&nbsp;}` | Month/year archive select from `FROM_UNIXTIME(guestbook_created, …)`; label, submit text, spacer arguments; URL params `gbd` (format) and `gbs` (value). |
| `{JUMP:page\|go\|&nbsp;}` | Page jump select, posts `showguestbookpage`. |

Entries whose message contains `[url` are excluded from listing (spam marker). New posts set `?guestbookentry=<id>` internally and redirect to avoid double posts; the created entry is then shown.

### Notify mail

The notify template replaces `{FE_URL}`, `{BE_URL}`, `{IP}` (anonymized in GDPR mode), `{BROWSER}`, `{DATE}`, `{NAME}`, `{EMAIL}`, `{URL}`, `{MESSAGE}`, `{IMG_NAME}`, `{IMG_URL}` and sends from `admin_email`.

## Storage

- Entries: `phpwcms_guestbook` — `guestbook_cid` (thread), `guestbook_msg`, `guestbook_name`, `guestbook_email`, `guestbook_url`, `guestbook_show`, `guestbook_created` (unix time), `guestbook_trashed`, `guestbook_ip` (remote or anonymized IP), `guestbook_useragent` (`MD5` of the user agent), `guestbook_image`, `guestbook_imagename`.
- Configuration: `acontent_form`, serialized.
- Images: `content/guestbook_<cid>/<hash>.<ext>`.

## Related

- Login gating works with the [Frontend login (cp 28)](34-frontend-login.md) CP.
- [Users and usergroups](../administration/users-usergroups.md#backend-vs-frontend-users) — frontend login status drives the visible/post modes.

<!-- docs/content-parts/29-contentpart-alias.md -->

# Contentpart alias (content part 24)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt24.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/ext.func.inc.php` (`getContentPartAlias()`), `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt24.inc.php`

Embeds an existing content part by its numeric id. The alias CP resolves the target row, optionally overlays block, spacing, title, top-link and visibility settings with its own values, and the frontend then renders the target through its normal renderer. The CP itself produces no output.

## Purpose

Reuse one content part — a form, a text block, a file list — on several articles without duplicating content. Edits in the target CP propagate everywhere the alias is used.

## Backend form

Fields top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt24.inc.php`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Alias ID | text | — | Numeric `acontent_id` of the target CP, or picked with the sitemap browser (`articlebrowser.php?opt=5`). A non-existing or trashed id is emptied on save. When set, an edit button opens the target CP and the type of the target is shown; module targets (type 30) without an installed module show a warning instead. |
| Display (block) setting | checkbox | off | Off: the alias CP's own block assignment (CONTENT, HEADER, …, named blocks) applies. On: the target keeps its own block. |
| Spaces setting | checkbox | off | Same pattern for the space-before/space-after values. |
| Titles setting | checkbox | off | Same pattern for title and subtitle; off means the alias CP's title/subtitle is printed. |
| Top link setting | checkbox | off | Same pattern for the "top" link flag. |
| Visibility | checkbox | off | On: the target must itself be `acontent_visible=1`, otherwise the alias renders nothing. |

## Rendering

`getContentPartAlias()` in `include/inc_front/ext.func.inc.php` runs during content part gathering, before any renderer:

1. Load the target row with `acontent_trash=0`, within its live/kill date window, visibility check when the box is set, and the same frontend-user grant rule as normal CPs.
2. For each unchecked option, copy the alias CP's own value (block, before/after spaces, title, subtitle, top flag) into the target row; checked options keep the target values.
3. Return the merged row so the render loop `include` targets `cnt<target type>.article.inc.php`.

When the target cannot be resolved, the CP renders nothing. A target that is itself an alias CP (type 24) resolves only one hop: the render loop includes the target row's own renderer, and the alias renderer file outputs nothing, so such chains print no content.

## Storage

- `acontent_form` — serialized array with `alias_ID`, `alias_block`, `alias_spaces`, `alias_title`, `alias_toplink`, `alias_status`.
- Target link itself: none stored beyond `alias_ID`; no back-references are maintained.

## Related

- Block assignments and CP settings: [Core concepts](../general/concepts.md#the-content-hierarchy).
- Same embedding pattern for whole articles: [Teaser/link article (cp 8)](17-teaser-link-article.md).
- Glossary: [Content part](../modules/13-glossary.md#content-part).

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/30-php-variables.md -->

# PHP variables (content part 52)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt52.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/content/cnt52.sql.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt52.article.inc.php`

A data-only content part: one INI-style text block parsed with `parse_ini_str()` and merged into `$GLOBALS['CUSTOM']`. It renders nothing.

## Purpose

Per-article custom configuration for your own frontend scripts, replacements or template logic — for example a map key, a color accent or a flag a custom `frontend_render` script switches on. Because it is a content part, editors set the values per article without touching code.

## Backend form

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Variables | textarea, INI syntax | — | One `key = value` pair per line; parsed with `parse_ini_str()`, so quoted strings, numbers and booleans are supported. Stored raw; title, subtitle, block, spacing and attribute fields behave like in every other CP. |

## Rendering

No output. The renderer parses the block and merges the result:

```php
$GLOBALS['CUSTOM'] = array_merge($GLOBALS['CUSTOM'], parse_ini_str($crow['acontent_text']));
```

Keys already present in `CUSTOM` are overwritten by values of CPs rendered later in the article. `CUSTOM` starts empty and is only filled by this CP, so name collisions between articles on one page follow render order.

## Storage

- `acontent_text` — the raw INI text.
- No `acontent_form`, no template selection.

## Related

- Rendering order of content parts: [Core concepts](../general/concepts.md#rendering-model).
- Scripts that can read `CUSTOM`: [Templates](../general/concepts.md#templates) describes `template/inc_script` integration points.
- Glossary: [Content part](../modules/13-glossary.md#content-part).

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/31-poll.md -->

# Poll (content part 89)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt89.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt89.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt89.inc.php`

A simple voting widget. Each choice is a text line, optionally paired with an image. One vote per client IP; the vote and its result live inside the content part row itself, so no extra tables are involved. The CP ships with template classes (`pollBarCell`, `pollBarMain`, `pollBarPercent`, `pollRadioCell`, `pollInfo`, `pollSubmitButton`) instead of a selectable template.

## Purpose

Quick opinion polls: the visitor picks a radio, submits, and afterwards sees the accumulated result with bar-percentage output. Results update the stored CP configuration directly.

## Backend form

Fields top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt89.inc.php`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Attribute class | text | — | Extra CSS class merged into the CP wrapper class; empty falls back to `defaultPollClass` at render time. |
| Button text | text | *(empty)* | Submit label; the button always gets `class="pollSubmitButton"`. |
| Choices | textarea, one line each | — | Choice texts; the line index pairs with the image at the same position. Line order can be changed by re-editing the CP. |
| Image | multi-select | none | Optional image per choice from the file center, order via up/down buttons. |
| Max width | number, px | `content_width` | Choice image width; capped when `RESPONSIVE_MODE` is off or empty. |
| Max height | number, px | — | Choice image height, proportional when 0. |
| Enlarge | checkbox | off | Stored per image list; rendered images use the cached thumbnail values (the zoom view is only evaluated when the image renderer builds it). |

## Rendering

Two states, keyed on the client IP (anonymized under `PHPWCMS_GDPR_MODE`):

**Vote form** — radio button per choice with the paired image below, submit button, and a hidden `hidden_acontent_id` identifying this CP. Posted to the current frontend URL.

**Result table** — shown to IPs found in the stored vote list. Each choice prints its text, optional image, a result bar and the percentage:

```html
<span class="pollBarBegin"></span>
<span class="pollBarMain" style="width:<percent>px;"></span>
<span class="pollBarPercent"><percent>%</span>
```

Bar width is `round(votes / total * 100)` in px. The vote is written by an `UPDATE` of this content part's `acontent_form`, incrementing the choice counter and registering the IP — there is no history of individual votes.

## Storage

- `acontent_form` — serialized `choice` (text lines), `count` (votes per choice index, seeded 0) and `ip` (voted IPs or anonymized IPs).
- `acontent_image` — serialized `images`, `width`, `height`, `zoom` for the choice images.
- `acontent_text` — serialized `poll_buttontext` and `poll_buttonstyle`.

## Related

- GDPP/IP handling conventions: [Core concepts](../general/concepts.md#where-the-data-lives).
- Glossary: [Content part](../modules/13-glossary.md#content-part).

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/32-recipe.md -->

# Recipe (content part 26)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt26.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt26.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt26.inc.php`

A fixed-field recipe record. Fields map to legacy `acontent_*` columns, so recipe lists can filter on them. Ingredient lines support sub-headlines and amount\|name pairs rendered as list or table.

## Purpose

Store and render recipes with a consistent field set. The headline renderer of this CP is skipped (`headline()` call is commented out), so title and subtitle only print when the template asks for them.

## Backend form

Fields top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt26.inc.php`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Category keywords | textarea | — | Comma-separated keywords ("Zutaten" helper select offers keywords used by other recipe CPs). Normalized to a comma list. |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | File from `template/inc_cntpart/recipe/`; empty falls back to the built-in skeleton. Ships `BS5.tmpl`, `default.tmpl`, `rezept.html` plus a `search` folder. |
| Ingredients | textarea, one line each | — | See syntax below. |
| Preparation time | number + text | — | Minutes and a free "additional" text. |
| Nutritional value | number + text | — | kJ value and a free "additional" text. |
| Difficulty | radio 1–5 | 1 | Clamped to 1–5 on save. |
| Preparation | WYSIWYG | — | Free HTML instructions. |

Ingredient line syntax: a leading `*` starts a new headline group; a `|` splits amount and name; a line without `|` prints the whole line as amount-less text.

## Rendering

Template resolution: selected `template/inc_cntpart/recipe/<file>`, else the built-in skeleton (a `<div class="recipe">` with title, subtitle, ingredients, calories, preparation, time, severity and category). The fallback in code also covers `[ATTR_CLASS_ELSE]`/`[ATTR_ID_ELSE]` branches.

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]` `{ATTR_CLASS}` `[ATTR_ID]` `{ATTR_ID}` | Wrapper attributes with else-branches. |
| `[TITLE]` `{TITLE}` `[SUBTITLE]` `{SUBTITLE}` | CP title/subtitle, HTML-escaped. |
| `[INGREDIENTS]` `{INGREDIENTS}` | `<ul>` list per group, `<h5>` before each `*` headline. |
| `[INGREDIENTSTABLE]` `{INGREDIENTSTABLE}` | Same data as two-column `<table>` rows (`ingredients`, `ingredientsText` classes). |
| `[CALORIES]` `{CALORIES}` | kJ value. |
| `{KCAL}` | Computed `ceil(kJ / 4.1868)`. |
| `[CALORIESADD]` `{CALORIESADD}` | Calorie free-text, appended after kcal. |
| `[PREPARATION]` `{PREPARATION}` | WYSIWYG content, printed as stored. |
| `[TIME]` `{TIME}` / `[TIMEADD]` `{TIMEADD}` | Minutes ("Minuten" suffix in the default skeleton) and the additional time text. |
| `[SEVERITY]` `{SEVERITY}` | Difficulty number 1–5, not escaped. |
| `[CAT]` `{CAT}` | Category keyword list, HTML-escaped. |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID. |

## Storage

Recipe fields reuse assorted columns so queries can filter without JSON parsing:

| Column | Content |
| ------ | ------- |
| `acontent_text` | Category keyword list (comma string). |
| `acontent_form` | Serialized recipe array (template, ingredients, time, calorific value, preparation, severity, category). |
| `acontent_alink` | `0-<calorific value>`, zero-padded to 15 digits. |
| `acontent_media` | `0-<time>`, zero-padded to 15 digits. |
| `acontent_files` | `0-<severity>`, zero-padded to 15 digits. |
| `acontent_newsletter` | Search text: `optimizeForSearch()` over preparation, ingredients, calorie text, time text, category. |

## Related

- How the search uses CP texts: [Core concepts](../general/concepts.md#the-content-hierarchy).
- Glossary: [Content part](../modules/13-glossary.md#content-part).

# FAQ (content part 27)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt27.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt27.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt27.inc.php`, `template/inc_cntpart/faq/`

One content part renders one question/answer pair. Stack several of them for a FAQ list; the shipped templates wrap each pair in an accordion item and carry the CP id, so bootstrap accordions and anchor links work per entry.

## Purpose

A structured Q&A block: plain question text for search and headings, rich-text answer, optional image with caption and zoom. Templates decide the final markup.

## Backend form

Fields top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt27.inc.php`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | File from `template/inc_cntpart/faq/`; ships `BS5-Accordion.tmpl` and `default.tmpl`. Empty falls back to the built-in skeleton in `cnt27.article.inc.php`. |
| Question | textarea | — | Stored as plain text, HTML-escaped at render time. |
| Answer | WYSIWYG | — | Free HTML. |
| Image | file select + delete | none | From the file center; preview thumbnail shown next to the caption field. |
| Max width | number, px | `content_width` | Capped when `RESPONSIVE_MODE` is off or the value is empty. |
| Max height | number, px | — | Proportional when 0. |
| Enlarge | checkbox | off | Links the image to `image_zoom.php`; a caption link wins over the zoom link. |
| Caption | textarea | — | First line prints as caption text, further lines feed the caption URL/title as in image CPs (`getImageCaption()`). |

## Rendering

Built-in fallback skeleton:

```html
<div class="faq">
    <!-- hidden title/subtitle [TITLE]<h3 id="faq_id{FAQ_ID}">{TITLE}</h3>[/TITLE][SUBTITLE]<h4>{SUBTITLE}</h4>[/SUBTITLE] -->
    [FAQ_QUESTION]<h3>{FAQ_QUESTION}</h3>[/FAQ_QUESTION]
    [FAQ_IMAGE]<div class="faq-image">{FAQ_IMAGE}[FAQ_CAPTION]<div class="faq-caption">{FAQ_CAPTION}</div>[/FAQ_CAPTION]</div>[/FAQ_IMAGE]
    [FAQ_ANSWER]<p>{FAQ_ANSWER}</p>[/FAQ_ANSWER]
</div>
```

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]` `{ATTR_CLASS}` `[ATTR_ID]` `{ATTR_ID}` | Wrapper attributes with else-branches. |
| `[TITLE]` `{TITLE}` `[SUBTITLE]` `{SUBTITLE}` | CP title/subtitle (commented out in the default markup). |
| `[FAQ_QUESTION]` `{FAQ_QUESTION}` | Question text, HTML-escaped. |
| `[FAQ_ANSWER]` `{FAQ_ANSWER}` | Answer HTML. |
| `[FAQ_IMAGE]` `{FAQ_IMAGE}` | Rendered `<img>` (and zoom/caption link when set). |
| `[FAQ_CAPTION]` `{FAQ_CAPTION}` | Caption text. |
| `{FAQ_ID}` | Content part record ID. |

`BS5-Accordion.tmpl` uses the same tags to emit a Bootstrap 5 collapsed accordion item with `data-bs-parent` grouping keyed on `{FAQ_ID}`.

## Storage

| Column | Content |
| ------ | ------- |
| `acontent_text` | Question (plain). |
| `acontent_html` | Answer (HTML). |
| `acontent_form` | Serialized `faq_template`. |
| `acontent_image` | `dbid:filename:hash:ext:width:height:caption(b64):position:zoom`; position is always 0 because the template decides the layout. |

## Related

- Image caption syntax: [Text w/image (cp 1)](01-text-with-image.md).
- Glossary: [Content part](../modules/13-glossary.md#content-part).
