<!-- docs/content-parts/34-frontend-login.md -->

# Frontend login (content part 28)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt28.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt28.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt28.inc.php`, `template/inc_cntpart/felogin/`

The login CP, labeled `Frontend login`. It authenticates against the frontend user table (`phpwcms_userdetail`) and optionally the backend user table, manages the session, sets the remember cookie and renders the appropriate template section: login form, logged-in box, reminder form, registration form or profile editor.

## Purpose

Gate protected content parts and levels. Combined with article usergroup settings it covers private areas. Logout is handled globally: a posted or queried `feLogout` destroys the session (`include/inc_front/front.func.inc.php`).

## Backend form

Fields top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt28.inc.php`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty)* | File from `template/inc_cntpart/felogin/` (`fe_login.tmpl`, `BS5.tmpl`). Without a file nothing renders. |
| Cookie runtime | number, seconds | 2592000 (30 days) | Lifetime of the remember-me cookie `phpwcmsFeLoginRemember`, only set when "Remember" is checked and the value is non-zero. |
| Date format | text | `%m/%d/%y` | `strftime()` format used by the profile editor. |
| Locale | text | — | `setlocale()` value for the profile editor (`de`, `de_DE`). |
| Validate against | checkbox set | userdetail on, backend user on | Which tables accept logins: frontend user profiles (`phpwcms_userdetail`) and/or backend users (`phpwcms_user`). |
| Accept email as login | checkbox | off | Allows the stored email address in the login field. |
| Profile: registration | checkbox | on | Enables the `profile_register=…` URL switch rendering the `PROFILE_REGISTER` section. |
| Profile: manage | checkbox | on | Enables the `profile_manage=…` URL switch rendering the `PROFILE_MANAGE` section. |
| Manage redirect | text | — | Target alias, `aid=<id>` or `id=<id>` for the manage link; picked with the article browser (`articlebrowser.php?opt=6`). |

## Rendering

The template file is split into sections with `<!--SECTION_START//-->` markers: `LOGIN_SETTINGS`, `LOGIN_FORM`, `LOGIN_IS`, `PROFILE_REGISTER`, `PROFILE_MANAGE`, `REMINDER_FORM`, `REMINDER_SUCCESS`, `REMINDER_EMAIL`. The CP picks the section to render by state.

### Login state

Posts `feLogin`/`fePassword` are checked with `_checkFrontendUserLogin()`; success stores `$_SESSION[<session id>]` and the user data array, sets the remember cookie if requested, and redirects back to the current URL. Failed attempts re-render `LOGIN_FORM` with `[ERROR]`.

### Reminder

Posts `feReminder` resolve login or email: with a valid email the CP looks up the login and mails it; with a login it resets the password to a random 8-character string and mails the new one. `[SUBJECT]`, `[LOGIN_EMAIL]` and `[PASSWORD_EMAIL]` sections inside `REMINDER_EMAIL` build subject and body, `{LOGIN}`, `{PASSWORD}`, `{LOGIN_URL}` are replaced. Errors render `REMINDER_FORM` with `[ERROR]` and the typed value in `{REMINDER}`.

### Template tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{FORM_TARGET}` | Current URL without `profile_*` and `feLogout` parameters. |
| `{LOGIN}` `{PASSWORD}` `{REMEMBER}` | Refill login form; `REMEMBER` is a `checked` fragment. |
| `[ERROR]…[/ERROR]` `[ERROR_ELSE]…[/ELSE_ERROR]` | Validation state of the active form. |
| `{REGISTER_PROFILE}` `[REGISTER_PROFILE]` | URL to the registration form; block stripped when registration is off. |
| `{MANAGE_PROFILE}` `[MANAGE_PROFILE]` `[MANAGE_PROFILE_ELSE]` | URL to the profile editor (uses the redirect setting); stripped when manage is off. |
| `{REMINDER}` `[REMINDER_FORM]` | Typed reminder value / URL to the reminder form. |
| `{LOGIN_URL}` | URL to the plain login view. |
| `{FE_USER_REGISTER}` `{FE_USER_MANAGE}` | Registration/editor markup. The CP only places the placeholders; you provide the forms via a frontend render script such as `template/inc_script/frontend_render/disabled/fe_user.php`. |

### Redirect and visibility interplay

Articles or levels can require a login. When access is denied and no user is logged in, `include/inc_front/content.func.inc.php` stores `$_SESSION['LOGIN_REDIRECT'] = FE_CURRENT_URL` and redirects to the login page given by the template setting `feloginurl` (`template_felogin_url` in the backend templates section). The CP consumes that session value after a successful login and redirects there; without it you land back on the login page URL. `block['feloginurl']` wins over the template default when set.

### LOGGED_IN sections

In addition to the CP, templates and articles support `<!--LOGGED_IN_START//-->…<!--LOGGED_IN_END//-->` comment blocks and `[LOGGED_IN]…[/LOGGED_IN]` / `[LOGGED_OUT]…[/LOGGED_OUT]` sections, processed globally in `content.func.inc.php` based on `_getFeUserLoginStatus()`. Use them for small switches; use this CP for the forms.

## Storage

- `acontent_template` — template file name.
- `acontent_form` — serialized settings (cookie runtime, date format, locale, validation switches, profile switches, manage redirect).
- Sessions and the `phpwcmsFeLoginRemember` cookie carry the login state; user data stays in `phpwcms_userdetail` (frontend) and `phpwcms_user` (backend).

## Related

- Users, groups and permission models: [Users and usergroups](../administration/users-usergroups.md#backend-vs-frontend-users).
- Guestbook login gating: [Guestbook/comment (cp 18)](28-guestbook.md).

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/35-tabs.md -->

# Tabs (content part 32)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt32.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt32.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt32.inc.php`, `template/inc_default/tabs.tmpl`, `include/inc_front/content.article.inc.php`

Two related mechanisms share this page: the `Tabs` content part (several sub-tabs inside one CP, rendered from a template file) and the per-CP "Subsection" setting that groups several content parts of an article into a tab or accordion block (`$content['cptab']` in `include/inc_front/content.article.inc.php`).

## Purpose

The CP builds tabbed or accordion content without page reloads; every sub-tab carries title, optional headline, WYSIWYG text, optional link and an active flag. Tab content feeds the article search index automatically.

## Backend form

Fields top to bottom (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt32.inc.php`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | File from `template/inc_cntpart/tabs/` (`Accordion.tmpl`, `BS5-Tabs.tmpl`, `simplegmaps.tmpl`). Empty falls back to `template/inc_default/tabs.tmpl`; when no template resolves, the CP prints a plain `<dl>` outline. |
| No WYSIWYG editor | checkbox | off | Disables the editor for tab texts. |
| Tabs | repeat list | 1 empty tab | Add, sort and delete tabs. Per tab: title (default `Tab #<n>`, `-` hides the title), headline, text (WYSIWYG; plain text input without a WYSIWYG editor), link (redirect link, same syntax as article link targets, with optional target), and an active checkbox — an inactive tab is hidden but keeps its data. |
| Custom fields group | select (visible when defined) | — | Fieldgroup from `template_default['settings']['tabs_custom_fields']`; each tab gains the group's extra inputs. |

Without a WYSIWYG editor, tab text lacking `<` is converted with `plaintext_htmlencode()` at save time.

## Rendering

Template resolution order: selected `template/inc_cntpart/tabs/<file>`, else `template/inc_default/tabs.tmpl`. The template uses two sections, `TABS` (wrapper) and `TABS_ENTRY` (per tab).

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]` `{ATTR_CLASS}` `[ATTR_ID]` `{ATTR_ID}` `[TITLE]` `{TITLE}` `[SUBTITLE]` `{SUBTITLE}` | Wrapper, CP title/subtitle. |
| `[TABS_ENTRIES]` `{TABS_ENTRIES}` | All rendered entry blocks. |
| `{TAB_COUNT}` | Number of rendered (active) tabs. |
| `{ID}` | Content part record ID; default markup builds `id="tab{ID}"`. |
| `{TABID}` | Running tab number starting at 1. |
| `[FIRST]` `[LAST]` | Present on first/last entry. |
| `[TABTITLE]` `{TABTITLE}` `[TABTITLE_ELSE]` | Title text; else-branch runs for empty titles, `-` suppresses the whole block. |
| `[TABCONTENT]` | Present when headline or text is non-empty. |
| `[TABHEADLINE]` `{TABHEADLINE}` `[TABTEXT]` `{TABTEXT}` | Headline (escaped) and body (WYSIWYG HTML). |
| `[TABLINK]` `{TABLINK}` `{TARGET}` | Read-more link from the tab link field; `{TARGET}` is the link target attribute. |
| `[TAB_<CUSTOM_FIELD>]` | Custom field value, uppercased key; `bool` fields render the block as flag, `option`/`select` fields add `[TAB_<FIELD>_<OPTION>]` variants, `file` fields render the file list markup of cp 7, `markdown`/`plain`/`html` renders honor the render mode. |

Fallback without any template: `headline()` plus the auto-built `<dl>` of titles and texts stored in `acontent_html`.

## Storage

| Column | Content |
| ------ | ------- |
| `acontent_form` | Serialized tab array (per tab: title, headline, text, link, active, custom fields) plus `tabwysiwygoff` and `tab_fieldgroup`. |
| `acontent_template` | Template file name. |
| `acontent_text` | Search string: stripped title + headline + text + custom field values of all tabs. |
| `acontent_html` | Fallback `<dl>` outline. |

## Content part tab grouping

> Source: `include/inc_lib/article.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content.article.inc.php`, `include/config/conf.template_default.inc.php`

The common CP settings (article content dialog) offer a "Subsection" select: Off, `Tabs`, `Group (accordion)` and any custom group defined in `$template_default['attributes']['cpgroup_custom']`. Stored in `acontent_tab` as `<number>|<type>_<title>` (number = grouping index, title optional).

At render time (`content.article.inc.php`) content parts sharing the same block and number are collected into `$content['cptab']`; the first CP of each group leaves a `<!-- tab-<hash> -->` or `<!-- cpgroup-<hash> -->` comment placeholder that later receives the assembled block. The assembled markup depends on type:

- **Tabs (type 1)** — `<div id="tab-<hash>">` with a navigation `<ul>` (`tab-navigation`, `tab-item-<n>`, `tab-first`/`tab-last` classes) linking to per-tab `<div id="tab-<title-hash>-<n>">` content containers (`tab-content`, `tab-content-item`).
- **Group/accordion (type 2)** — `<div id="cpgroup-<hash>">` containing per-item heading `<h3>` (`cpgroup-title`) with either a `<span data-cpgroupid="…">` or a link (attribute `cpgroup = 'href'`), and content wrappers (`cpgroup`, `cpgroup-<n>`, `cpgroup-content`, first/last classes).
- **Custom group types** — wrap each part with the `prefix`/`suffix` patterns of `$template_default['attributes']['cpgroup_custom'][<type>]`, where `%1$s` is the group title and `%2$s` the group id.

## Related

- Content part templates and template settings: [Core concepts](../general/concepts.md#templates).
- Glossary: [Content part](../modules/13-glossary.md#content-part).

---

<!-- docs/content-parts/36-custom-cp.md -->

# Custom CP (content part 60)

> Source: `include/inc_lib/content/cnt60.readform.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/custom_fields.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt60.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt60.inc.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/admin.custom_cpt.tmpl.php`

The backend label is `Custom CP`. Each Custom CP definition (key, title, fields, mode, template) is created in the admin area **Custom content parts**; an article then adds instantiations of it. One CP definition defines the field set; each CP record holds one or more data rows (`single` or `repeater` mode).

## Purpose

Build your own repeatable structured content — testimonial, feature box, banner — without code: the admin defines the fields and a starter template, editors fill the values, and a template in `template/inc_cntpart/custom/` decides the markup.

## Definition storage

Definitions live in three layers, resolved with `get_custom_contentparts()` in `include/inc_lib/custom_fields.inc.php` (DB wins, presets merge in, legacy last):

1. Database table `phpwcms_custom_cpt`: `cpt_id`, `cpt_key` (unique, lowercase identifiers), `cpt_title`, `cpt_desc`, `cpt_mode` (`single` or `repeater`), `cpt_icon`, `cpt_template`, `cpt_active`, `cpt_schema` (JSON field map created by `ensure_custom_cpt_table()`).
2. Presets: `template/config/custom_cpt/<key>.json` with the same fields; ignored when a DB row with the key exists.
3. Legacy `$template_default['settings']['customctp_custom_fields'][<key>]` groups from the template config.

Field keys are sanitized to `[a-z0-9_-]`; reserved keys (`title`, `subtitle`, `attr_class`, `attr_id`, `anchor`, `id`, `before`, `after`, `html`, `text`, `cpt_key`, `module`, `cpt_title`, `cpt_desc`, `item_index`, `item_num`, `item_total`) are reserved for the standard tags and rejected for fields.

## Backend form

Field rows depend on the definition (`include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt60.inc.php`). The CP select for the definition is fixed in the content part list; the dialog offers:

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Template | select | *(empty = default)* | First templates from `template/inc_cntpart/custom/<cpt_key>/`, then matching `inc_cntpart/custom/<cpt_key>*` files, then all general files. |
| Data rows | repeat list | — | `repeater` mode: add, sort, delete rows. `single` mode: exactly one row. Each row renders one input per defined field. |

Sanitization per field type (`custom_field_sanitize_value()`): `int`, `float`, `bool` cast; `url` filter-sanitized; `color` accepts `#rgb`/`#rrggbb`; `date` cleaned to 20 chars; `file`/`image` keep arrays; `textarea` with render `html`, `markdown`, `wysiwyg` keep HTML; everything else `clean_slweg()` honoring `maxlength`.

## Rendering

Template resolution (`cnt60.article.inc.php`): selected template, then `<cpt_key>/default.tmpl` or `.html`, then `<cpt_key>.tmpl`/`.html`, then `default.tmpl`/`default.html`. Sections: `CUSTOM_HEADER`, `CUSTOM_ENTRY` (per row), `CUSTOM_FOOTER`, `CUSTOM_ENTRY_SPACER` (between rows, else line feed). Without markers the whole file acts as the entry template.

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| `{<FIELD>}` / `{CUSTCTP_<FIELD>}` | Field value, rendered per type: bool prints a space or nothing, color/date/url/str are HTML-escaped, textarea render modes honor `markdown` (`parse_markdown()`), `plain` (`plaintext_htmlencode()`), `html`/`wysiwyg` raw; `file`/`image` resolve a file id to `download.php` or cached image URL. |
| `[<FIELD>]…[/FIELD]` (and prefixed) | Kept when the field holds a value. |
| `[<FIELD>_<OPTION>]` | For option/select fields: kept for the chosen value, stripped otherwise. |
| `{ITEM_INDEX}` / `{ITEM_NUM}` / `{ITEM_TOTAL}` | Zero-based index, 1-based number, row count. |
| `[ITEM_FIRST]` `[ITEM_LAST]` | First/last row of the set. |
| `[ENTRY_DATA]…[/ENTRY_DATA]` | Collected and re-emitted at `[DATA]` in header/footer — data usable outside the row loop. |
| `[ATTR_CLASS]` `[ATTR_ID]` `[TITLE]` `[SUBTITLE]` `[ANCHOR]` `{ID}` `[BEFORE]` `[AFTER]` | Standard CP attributes. |
| `[HTML]` `[TEXT]` | `acontent_html` and `acontent_text` raw values. |
| `[CPT_KEY]` `[MODULE]` `{CPT_TITLE}` `[CPT_DESC]` | Definition key and metadata. |

## Storage

| Column | Content |
| ------ | ------- |
| `acontent_form` | JSON (not serialized): `custom_elements[]` rows of `custom_fields` key/value sets plus `fieldgroup`/definition key. Legacy rows store the same structure serialized; the renderer accepts both. |
| `acontent_template` | Selected template path. |
| `acontent_html` | Round-tripped `custom_html` value; the current backend dialog exposes no input for it. |
| `acontent_module` | Definition key (`cpt_key`) — the CP is listed and filtered by it. |

## Related

- Fieldgroup custom fields for the Tabs CP use the same rendering rules: [Tabs (cp 32)](35-tabs.md).
- Templates and `template/inc_cntpart`: [Core concepts](../general/concepts.md#templates).

<!-- docs/modules/index.md -->

# Modules

> Source: `include/inc_lib/modules.check.inc.php`, `include/inc_module/<module>/module.default.php`

Modules are optional functional units shipped in `include/inc_module/`. Each module lives in a single directory and adds backend pages, database tables and — where applicable — content parts and frontend behavior. phpwcms ships the modules listed in [the page table](#reference-pages); third-party modules follow the same structure.

## Architecture

### Discovery

`include/inc_lib/modules.check.inc.php` scans the subdirectories of `include/inc_module/` on every request. A directory counts as a module only when both `module.default.php` and `lang/en.lang.php` exist inside it — English is the mandatory base language, merged from `lang/<BE_LANGUAGE>.lang.php` when present. Discovery is automatic: dropping a module directory into `include/inc_module/` registers it, deleting the directory unregisters it. No install step exists.

### Registration variables

`module.default.php` sets the module metadata. All variables are read by the discovery loop and stored in `$phpwcms['modules'][$_module_name]`:

| Variable | Type | Values | Stored as |
| -------- | ---- | ------ | --------- |
| `$_module_name` | string | Lower case, no spaces or special characters | Key under `phpwcms['modules']` |
| `$_module_type` | int | 0 = backend and frontend, 1 = backend only, 2 = frontend only | `type` |
| `$_module_contentpart` | bool | True to list in the content part selection | `cntp` |
| `$_module_fe_render` | bool | Registers `frontend.render.php` for the replacement tag pass | `search`/`setting` flags plus the render list |
| `$_module_fe_init` | bool | Registers `frontend.init.php` for the early frontend pass | Init list |
| `$_module_fe_search` | bool | True to participate in frontend search | `search` |

A module that sets `$_module_contentpart = true` needs the content part bridge files under `inc/` (see [Bridging into content parts](#bridging-into-content-parts)). Language keys go into `$BL['modules'][$_module_name]`; every module defines `backend_menu` and `listing_title` there.

### Frontend hooks

Registered module scripts run in the frontend render pipeline (`include/inc_front/content.func.inc.php`):

| Hook | Script | Run |
| ---- | ------ | --- |
| Init | `frontend.init.php` | Early in `content.func.inc.php` (line 641) |
| Render | `frontend.render.php` | In the replacement tag pass (line 1148) |

The init hook handles request-level tasks (shopping cart, address lookups); the render hook parses module replacement tags in the finished page markup.

### Backend access and usergroup gating

Two conditions gate the **Modules backend menu** (`phpwcms.php`):

1. The configuration key `$phpwcms['enable_backend_module']` must be true (default true, `include/config/dist.conf.inc.php` line 166). `$phpwcms['enable_backend_newsletter']` gates the separate newsletter menu the same way.
2. The user must belong to the SYSGROUP permission group with syskey `module`.

Each module entry in the menu additionally requires membership of the [module group](../administration/users-usergroups.md#module-groups) whose `group_modkey` holds the module's internal name; the group editor seeds one matching group per module.

### Bridging into content parts

Content part **type 30** ("Plug-in") carries all module content parts; its number is never used directly in the content part type list (`include/inc_lib/article.contenttype.inc.php` line 12). When any module sets `$_module_contentpart = true`, the type list gains one "Plug-in" entry whose options are the individual modules (`30:<module_name>`, only modules with `inc/cnt.list.php` — `include/inc_lib/backend.functions.inc.php` line 533). Editing a module content part routes files from the module directory:

| File | Role |
| ---- | ---- |
| `inc/cnt.form.php` | Content part edit form, included in `articlecontent.edit.tmpl.php` |
| `inc/cnt.read.php` | Loads stored values into `$content`, `article.editcontent.inc.php` line 562 |
| `inc/cnt.sql.php` | Builds the insert/update statement on save, line 645 |
| `inc/cnt.post.php` | Validates POST data on save, `article.readform.inc.php` line 147 |
| `inc/cnt.article.php` | Renders the content part on the frontend, `content.article.inc.php` line 622 |
| `inc/cnt.list.php` | Marks the module as selectable; provides the list title via `$BL['modules'][name]['listing_title']` |

Content parts of type 30 whose module no longer exists are skipped silently on the frontend and in the article overview (`content.article.inc.php` line 582, `admin.functions.inc.php` line 359).

## Module activation overview

| Module | Internal name | Type | Content part | Frontend hooks |
| ------ | ------------- | ---- | ------------ | -------------- |
| Shop | `shop` | 0 (BE+FE) | Yes (product listing, cart, checkout) | init, render, search |
| Calendar | `calendar` | 0 (BE+FE) | No | render |
| Ads | `ads` | 0 (BE+FE) | No | init, render |
| Feed import | `feedimport` | 1 (BE only) | No | init |
| Addresses | `phpwcms_addresses` | 1 (BE only) | No | render |
| SEO log | `seo_log` | 1 (BE only) | No | — |
| Statistics | `statistics` | 1 (BE only) | No | — |
| Module promo | `modulpromo` | 1 (BE only) | No | — |
| Glossary | `glossary` | 0 (BE+FE) | Yes | render, search |

The newsletter is no module but part of the core with its own backend menu and the subscription content part type 12 — see [Newsletter (core)](06-newsletter.md).

## Reference pages

| Page | Module | Contents |
| ---- | ------ | -------- |
| [Shop – overview and activation](01-shop.md) | shop | Activation, backend area map, preferences, shop content part |
| [Shop – catalog management](02-shop-catalog.md) | shop | Products, categories, product fields, image sizing, shop tables |
| [Shop – ordering and checkout](03-shop-ordering.md) | shop | Cart, checkout, shipping, payment, order mails, order list, API |
| [Shop – product options](04-shop-options.md) | shop | Option engine, price modifiers, content part options and accordion |
| [Calendar](05-calendar.md) | calendar | Entries, repeat rules, frontend calendar rendering |
| [Newsletter (core)](06-newsletter.md) | – (core) | Subscribers, subscription lists, queue sending, content part 12 |
| [Ads](07-ads.md) | ads | Ad places, campaigns, ad delivery and tracking |
| [Feed import](08-feedimport.md) | feedimport | RSS/Atom feed import into articles |
| [Addresses](09-addresses.md) | phpwcms_addresses | Address records with geocoding, frontend address locator |
| [SEO log](10-seolog.md) | seo_log | Search engine referrer logging |

| [Module manager](12-module-manager.md) | modulpromo | Informational module promo panel |
| [Glossary](13-glossary.md) | glossary | Keywords highlighted as abbr tooltips, backend glossary management |

<!-- docs/modules/01-shop.md -->

# Shop

> Source: `include/inc_module/mod_shop/`

The shop module turns phpwcms into a small online store: products with categories and product options, a session based cart, checkout, order emails and an order backend. Module registration (`module.default.php`): `$_module_name = 'shop'`, `$_module_type = 0` (backend and frontend), content part `true`, frontend init, render and search hooks.

- Catalog: [Shop – catalog management](02-shop-catalog.md)
- Ordering: [Shop – ordering and checkout](03-shop-ordering.md)
- Product options: [Shop – product options](04-shop-options.md)

## Installation / activation

The module ships enabled in discovery — no install step exists; see [Modules overview](index.md). On the first backend visit the module proves the shop tables exist and adds missing columns to `phpwcms_shop_products` in one session pass (`backend.default.php` line 31): `shopprod_special_price`, `shopprod_track_view`, `shopprod_lang`, `shopprod_overwrite_meta` and `shopprod_opengraph`. After 1.x upgrades this migration fills the newer columns automatically.

## Backend

URL: `phpwcms.php?do=modules&module=shop`. The controller and action live in GET parameters (`backend.default.php`): `controller` selects the area, `edit`, `status`, `delete` and `show` select the action. Unknown controllers fall back to orders.

| Area | Controller value | Contents |
| ---- | ---------------- | -------- |
| Orders | `order` (default) | Order list, order detail, status switches — see [ordering](03-shop-ordering.md) |
| Products | `prod` | Product list and product form — see [catalog](02-shop-catalog.md) |
| Categories | `cat` | Product category tree — see [catalog](02-shop-catalog.md) |
| Preferences | `pref` | All module settings — see below |

Tabs render from `inc/tabs.inc.php`; backend helpers live in `inc/functions.backend.inc.php` and `inc/functions.global.inc.php`.

## Configuration

All shop settings are stored per key via `_setConfig(key, value, 'module_shop')` in `phpwcms_sysvalue` and edited on the Preferences tab (`inc/edit.preferences.inc.php`, processing `inc/processing.preferences.inc.php`):

| Setting / key | Type | Default | Description |
| ------------- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `shop_pref_felang` | checkbox | off | Frontend language support — adds per-language product records and cart isolation |
| `shop_pref_currency` | text, max 10 | – | Currency symbol used in output |
| `shop_pref_unit_weight` | text, max 10 | `kg` | Weight unit suffix |
| `shop_pref_vat` | textarea | 0.00 / 7.00 / 19.00, one rate per line | VAT rate choices for product prices |
| `shop_pref_email_to` | email list | – | Recipients of new-order mails, multiple addresses separated by `;` |
| `shop_pref_email_from` | email | – | Sender address of order mails |
| `shop_pref_email_paypal` | email | – | Stored preference, no gateway code uses it (see [payment](03-shop-ordering.md#payment)) |
| `shop_pref_id_shop` | text | `0` | Page id (article id) or URL of the shop start, used for category and product links |
| `shop_pref_id_cart` | text | `0` | Page id (article id) or URL of the cart page |
| `shop_pref_shipping_calc` | radio | – | Shipping calculation: 0 = weight, 1 = price, 2 = distance (see [shipping](03-shop-ordering.md#shipping)) |
| `shop_pref_shipping_selfpickup` | checkbox | off | Enables self pickup at checkout |
| `shop_pref_shipping` | floats | – | Five tier rows for the selected shipping mode |
| `shop_pref_zone_base` | text, max 200 | – | Base address for distance calculation |
| `shop_pref_loworder` | checkbox + floats | off | Low order value surcharge: threshold, charge, VAT |
| `shop_pref_autosubtract_off` | checkbox | off | Disables inventory subtraction after an order |
| `shop_pref_discount` | checkbox + floats | off | Three discount tiers with percent, minimum order value, free shipping toggle |
| `shop_pref_payment` | checkboxes | on each | Enabled payment methods; accepted credit cards (default American Express, Mastercard, Visa) |
| `shop_pref_terms` + `shop_pref_terms_format` | textarea + radio | – | Terms and conditions text; format 0 = text, 1 = HTML |
| `shop_pref_api_access` + `shop_pref_api_key` | checkbox + text | off | JSON order API, see [ordering](03-shop-ordering.md#order-api) |

The only `phpwcms` configuration key related to the shop defaults the OpenGraph flag of new products: `$phpwcms['set_sociallink']['shop']` (default false, `include/config/dist.conf.inc.php` line 144).

## Shop content part (Plug-in, type 30)

The module provides content parts through the generic Plug-in content part 30 — see the bridging table on [Modules overview](index.md). A shop content part placement does not render content itself; it emits exactly one of the shop engine tags into the page, which `frontend.render.php` then executes:

| Content part action | Emits | Purpose |
| ------------------- | ----- | ------- |
| `categories` (default) | `{SHOP_CATEGORIES}` | Category menu of the whole tree |
| `category` | `{SHOP_CATEGORY:<id>}` | Category menu rooted at one category |
| `productlist` | `{SHOP_PRODUCTLIST}` | Product list or product detail |
| `order` | `{SHOP_ORDER_PROCESS}` | Cart and checkout page |
| `smallcart` | `{CART_SMALL}` | Compact cart summary |

The content part form offers the shop template selection (`template/default.html`, `en.html`, `de.html`), per-action options in an accordion, and a custom INI overrides textarea — documented on [Shop – product options](04-shop-options.md#content-part-options-and-accordion). When several shop content parts sit on one page, the first one defines the template and settings — the engine renders one template per page (`inc/cnt.article.php`).

## Related

- [Modules overview](index.md) — architecture, activation, groups
- [Shop – catalog management](02-shop-catalog.md) — products, categories, tables
- [Statistics](11-statistic.md) — module-independent reporting

<!-- docs/modules/02-shop-catalog.md -->

# Shop catalog

> Source: `include/inc_module/mod_shop/inc/`, `setup/default_sql/phpwcms_init.sql`

Product and category management of the [shop module](01-shop.md). The backend areas run under `phpwcms.php?do=modules&module=shop&controller=prod` and `...&controller=cat`; actions (`edit`, `status`, `delete`) ride the same URL (`backend.default.php`).

## Products

`inc/listing.products.inc.php` lists products with pagination (rows per page via GET `c`, default 250, or `all`), active/inactive filter and a word filter over order number, model, names, tag, price and descriptions. Columns: visibility, order number, model, name, price, inventory. Visibility toggles via `status`; delete is a soft delete setting `shopprod_status = 9`.

### Product form

> Source: `inc/edit.products.inc.php`, save in `inc/processing.products.inc.php`

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Order number | text, max 20 | – | Required; unique among products of the same language |
| Model | text, max 200 | – | Free model designation |
| Language | radio | all | Only when `shop_pref_felang` is on: record applies to all languages or one of the allowed frontend languages |
| Product name | text, max 200 | – | Required — shown in listings, page title, mails |
| Additional name | text, max 200 | – | Secondary title line |
| Weight | text | – | Number with unit suffix from `shop_pref_unit_weight` |
| Inventory | number | – | Stock count; decremented per order unless `shop_pref_autosubtract_off` |
| Unit | text, max 100 | – | Sales unit shown with prices |
| Price | text | – | Price; max magnitude 10^10 |
| Price is gross | checkbox | off | Off = price entered as net, on = price entered as gross; the other value derives from the VAT rate |
| VAT | select | – | Rates from `shop_pref_vat`; a manually entered new rate is appended to the preferences list |
| Option 1 | textarea | – | Product options, see [Shop – product options](04-shop-options.md) |
| Option 2 | textarea | – | Second option dimension, same engine |
| Short description | textarea | – | `shopprod_description0`; product list teaser, meta description fallback |
| Description (WYSIWYG) | editor | – | `shopprod_description1`; full product text, editor from the session WYSIWYG setting |
| Product info 2 / 3 | textarea | plain | `shopprod_description2`, `shopprod_description3` |
| Images | multi-select + captions | – | Chosen from the file browser (`filebrowser.php?opt=5`); per-image caption lines; first image is the list image |
| Files | multi-select | – | Chosen from the file browser (`filebrowser.php?opt=9`) with optional captions |
| External link | text, max 250 | – | Product URL stored in `shopprod_var` |
| Category | multi-select | – | Shop categories, see below |
| Tags | comma list | – | Lowercased, reduced to `0-9a-z`, comma, space, `-`, `_` |
| On request | checkbox + URL | off | Product without cart — replaced by a request link, see options page |
| Status | checkbox | on | Active state (`shopprod_status` 0/1) |
| Show in all categories | checkbox | off | `shopprod_listall` — the product lists without an active category filter |
| Overwrite meta | checkbox | on | Product data wins over article meta on the detail page (`shopprod_overwrite_meta`) |
| OpenGraph | checkbox | `set_sociallink.shop` | Emits `og:product` meta (`shopprod_opengraph`) |
| Save as duplicate | checkbox | – | Only shown while editing; stores a copy |

The `shopprod_maxrebate` column exists in the schema but the form forces it to `0` on insert and no code reads it. The `shopprod_special_price` column likewise exists only after the migration — no code path sets or uses it, so it documents the schema, not a feature.

### Image sizing

No per-product size settings exist. Image sizes come from the template CONFIG (template file or content part custom INI — see [options page](04-shop-options.md)): `image_list_width/height/crop`, `image_detail_*` and `image_detail_more_*` keys. `shop_image_tag()` (`frontend.init.php`) renders through the cached thumbnail generator, cache key derived from file hash, size, sharpening and crop mode; lightbox output wraps the full-size image with the resize-image URL and a `lightbox[product_...]` relation. List views render the first image only; the detail view renders all images, applying the "more" sizes from the configured start index. Product files render through the file list renderer of content part 7 (`include/inc_front/content/cnt7.article.inc.php`), honoring its direct-download and template settings.

## Categories

Shop categories live in the shared category table `phpwcms_categories` with `cat_type = 'module_shop'`. Structure supports one nesting level: the parent select lists top-level categories only (`cat_pid = 0`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Name | text | – | Required; unique among shop categories regardless of nesting |
| Parent | select | 0 (top level) | Top-level categories only |
| Info | textarea | – | Category description |
| Sort | number | – | Ordering value |
| Status | switch | on | Active (`cat_status` 0/1) |

Deleting a category sets `cat_status = 9` for the category and its children (`processing.categories.inc.php`); deactivated and deleted categories disappear from product selection and frontend lists.

## Storage

> Source: `setup/default_sql/phpwcms_init.sql` line 733

Products live in `phpwcms_shop_products`:

| Column | Type | Contents |
| ------ | ---- | -------- |
| `shopprod_id` | int | Row id |
| `shopprod_createdate` / `shopprod_changedate` | datetime | Timestamps |
| `shopprod_status` | int(1) | 0 inactive, 1 active, 9 deleted |
| `shopprod_uid` | int | Backend user id of the creator |
| `shopprod_ordernumber` | varchar(255) | Order number, unique per language |
| `shopprod_model` | varchar(255) | Model designation |
| `shopprod_name1`, `shopprod_name2` | varchar(255) | Name lines |
| `shopprod_tag` | varchar(255) | Comma separated tags |
| `shopprod_vat` | float | VAT rate in percent |
| `shopprod_netgross` | int(1) | 0 = price is net, 1 = price is gross |
| `shopprod_price` | float | Price as entered |
| `shopprod_maxrebate` | float | Unused (forced 0) |
| `shopprod_description0` – `shopprod_description3` | text | Description fields |
| `shopprod_var` | mediumtext | Serialized: images, files, external URL, request flag and URL |
| `shopprod_category` | varchar(255) | Comma list of `phpwcms_categories.cat_id` |
| `shopprod_weight` | float | Weight |
| `shopprod_size`, `shopprod_color` | varchar(255) | Option definitions — see [options](04-shop-options.md) |
| `shopprod_listall` | int(1) | Show without category filter |
| `shopprod_special_price` | text | Unused (migration only) |
| `shopprod_track_view` | int | Detail view counter, indexed |
| `shopprod_lang` | varchar(255) | Language code when language support is on |
| `shopprod_overwrite_meta` | int(1) | Meta override flag, default 1 |
| `shopprod_opengraph` | int(1) | OpenGraph flag, default 1, indexed |
| `shopprod_unit` | varchar(100) | Sales unit |
| `shopprod_inventory` | int(11) | Stock count |

Further involved tables: `phpwcms_categories` (`cat_type = 'module_shop'` rows hold categories), `phpwcms_file` (product images and files), `phpwcms_sysvalue` (preference keys of the [overview page](01-shop.md)). Orders live in `phpwcms_shop_orders`, documented on the [ordering page](03-shop-ordering.md#storage). The cart is session only — no cart table exists.

## Manufacturer management

The module has none — no manufacturer table, field or backend page exists in `include/inc_module/mod_shop/`.

## Related

- [Shop – ordering and checkout](03-shop-ordering.md) — cart, payment, orders
- [Shop – product options](04-shop-options.md) — option engine and content part options

<!-- docs/modules/03-shop-ordering.md -->

# Shop ordering

> Source: `include/inc_module/mod_shop/frontend.render.php`, `frontend.init.php`, `inc/cart.*.inc.php`, `inc/shipping.parse.inc.php`, `inc/processing.orders.inc.php`

Cart and checkout of the [shop module](01-shop.md).

## Frontend entry points

`frontend.render.php` engages the shop engine when the page contains any of the tags `{SHOP_CATEGORIES...}`, `{SHOP_PRODUCTLIST}`, `{CART_SMALL}` or `{SHOP_ORDER_PROCESS}`. Request parameters drive the views: `shop_cat` (category, optional `_sub` level via `5_12` style), `shop_detail` (product detail id) and `shop_cart=show` (display cart, clears cart errors). Category and product links point to the pages configured by `shop_pref_id_shop` / `shop_pref_id_cart`.

The small cart `{CART_SMALL}` renders wherever `{CART_SMALL}` appears — with `{CART_LINK}` to the cart page and `{COUNT}` for the item count. The count sums all positions of the session cart.

## Cart mechanics

> Source: `frontend.render.php`, `inc/cart.items.inc.php`

The cart lives in the session only — there is no cart table. Key `shopping_cart` (+ language suffix when `shop_pref_felang` is on) holds:

| Session entry | Contents |
| ------------- | -------- |
| `products[product][option1][option2]` | Quantity per product and option combination |
| `options1`, `options2` | Resolved option data per product |
| `total[product.option1.option2]` | Quantity per combination for the small cart count |
| `amount[product]` | Total quantity per product |
| `step1` | Invoice address data of the checkout |
| `payby`, `error`, `delivery_address`, `distance`, `distance_details`, `selfpickup` | Checkout state (see below) |

Adding runs through POST `shop_action=add` with `shop_prod_id` and `shop_prod_amount` plus the chosen `prod_opt1` / `prod_opt2` values. When the product defines options in both dimensions, an option selection is required before the cart accepts the product. Updating uses array POST `shop_prod_amount[product][option1][option2]`; `shop_cart_delete` empties the cart.

The cart template drives the buttons: `[UPDATE]...[/UPDATE]`, `[CHECKOUT]`, `[DELETE]` render as `<button>` submit controls for the respective actions (a body that already contains a form control stays untouched). `{COUNT}` inside the cart becomes the quantity input of the position.

## Checkout flow

The `{SHOP_ORDER_PROCESS}` page runs the flow in `frontend.render.php`:

1. Empty cart renders the `CART_NONE` section; otherwise the cart (step 0).
2. POST `shop_cart_checkout` opens the invoice address form (step 1): first and last name, street address data, zip, city, valid email, phone and the payment choice are validated; additional required fields `shop_field_N` (text fields, textareas, checkboxes) come from the template CONFIG.
3. POST `shop_order_step1` moves to the terms step (step 2): the terms text from `shop_pref_terms` (text or HTML per `shop_pref_terms_format`) shows and requires the `shop_terms_agree` confirmation.
4. POST `shop_order_submit` creates the order. The order number is either random (`generic_string(8,2)` in the `RANDOM` style) or a counter formatted by the configured sprintf pattern (template CONFIG `order_number_style`, sample `EN%05s`).
5. Success renders the `ORDER_DONE` section and subtracts inventory unless `shop_pref_autosubtract_off` is set; on failure the `ORDER_NOT_DONE` section shows with a mailto fallback.

Both order mails (below) are serialized into the order record and remain readable in the backend.

## Shipping

Three modes exist, selected by `shop_pref_shipping_calc`; each holds five tier rows edited on the preferences page — see [Shop](01-shop.md#configuration):

> Source: `inc/cart.items.inc.php`

| Mode | Threshold column | Fee columns | Behavior |
| ---- | ---------------- | ----------- | -------- |
| 0 — weight | `weight` (kg) | `net`, `vat` | Shipping fee by cart weight tier |
| 1 — price | `price` | `price_net`, `price_vat` | Fee by order subtotal tier |
| 2 — distance | `zone` (km) | `zone_net`, `zone_vat`, `zone_label` | Shipping by distance from the base address to the delivery address |

Distance mode calls the Google Maps Directions and Geocoding APIs via `file_get_contents` — PHP needs `allow_url_fopen` (the preferences form warns about this); foreign delivery countries are detected and affect the result. Template tags: `[SHIPPING_DISTANCE]`, `[SHIPPING_DISTANCE_ADDRESS]`, `{SHIPPING_DISTANCE:KM|M|MI|CITY|POSTCODE|COUNTRY|LABEL}`, and the conditional `[SHIPPING_DISTANCE:FOREIGN]`.

With `shop_pref_shipping_selfpickup` enabled, the `[SELFPICKUP]` checkbox lets visitors pick up the order; `shop_pref_discount.freeshipping_pickup` (default on) zeroes shipping costs when selected.

## Payment

> Source: `frontend.init.php` (`get_payment_options()`)

The checkout radio list offers exactly the four methods whitelisted in code: `prepay` (prepayment), `pod` (cash on delivery), `onbill` (on account), `cash`. Conditionals `[PAYBY_PREPAY]`, `[PAYBY_POD]`, `[PAYBY_ONBILL]`, `[PAYBY_CASH]` switch template sections; `{PAYMENT}` renders the chosen label.

The preferences store a PayPal email and a credit-card flag with accepted card types, and mails can be addressed with `shop_pref_email_paypal` — but no PayPal or credit-card gateway processing exists in `include/inc_module/mod_shop/`: the checkout accepts these data as stored preferences only. Any payment processing beyond prepayment/cash-on-delivery/on-account/cash would be integration work (webhook, IPN or external provider) outside this code.

## Pricing, VAT and discounts

> Source: `inc/cart.parse.inc.php`, `frontend.render.php`

- Product VAT uses `shopprod_vat`; when `shopprod_netgross` is 1 the entered price is gross and the net value derives from price ÷ (1 + VAT / 100).
- Three discount tiers (`shop_pref_discount`, `..._1`, `..._2`) each define percent, minimum order value and free shipping; the highest qualifying tier wins.
- A low order surcharge (`shop_pref_loworder`: threshold `under`, charge, VAT) applies below the threshold.

Summary tags in cart and checkouts templates:

| Tag | Contents |
| --- | -------- |
| `{SUBTOTAL_NET}`, `{SUBTOTAL_VAT}`, `{SUBTOTAL_GROSS}`, `{SUBTOTAL_WEIGHT}` | Cart position sums |
| `{SHIPPING_NET}`, `{SHIPPING_VAT}`, `{SHIPPING_GROSS}` | Shipping costs |
| `{DISCOUNT_NET}`, `{DISCOUNT_VAT}`, `{DISCOUNT_GROSS}` | Discount |
| `{LOWORDER_NET}`, `{LOWORDER_VAT}`, `{LOWORDER_GROSS}` | Low order surcharge |
| `{TOTAL_NET}`, `{TOTAL_VAT}`, `{TOTAL_GROSS}` | Final amounts (net + shipping + low order − discount) |
| `{CURRENCY_SYMBOL}` / `{$}`, `{WEIGHT_UNIT}` | Units |

Conditionals: `[DISCOUNT]`, `[LOWORDER]`, `[SHIPPING]`, `[SELFPICKUP]`, `[SELFPICKUP_FREE]`. Option price display and number formatting follow the template CONFIG (`price_option_null`, `price_option_prefix/suffix/hide`, `price/vat/weight_decimals`, `dec_point`, `thousands_sep`).

## Order mails

> Source: `frontend.render.php`, sections in `template/default.html`

Two mail sections ship in the shop template: `MAIL_CUSTOMER` (to the customer) and `MAIL_NEWORDER` (to the shop). Both render with the invoice address tags `{INV_*}`, `{EMAIL}`, `{PHONE}`, custom fields `{shop_field_N}`, the item markup `{ITEMS}` (built per position from the `MAIL_ITEM` section) and all summary tags above; payment conditionals switch method-specific paragraphs.

| Aspect | Customer mail | Shop mail |
| ------ | ------------- | --------- |
| Subject template CONFIG | `mail_customer_subject`, default `[#{ORDER}] Your order at MyShop` | `mail_neworder_subject`, default `[#{ORDER}] New order` |
| Recipient | Cart step 1 email address | First valid address of `shop_pref_email_to`; further addresses get copies with sender = customer name/email |
| Sender | `shop_pref_email_from`, fallback `$phpwcms['SMTP_FROM_EMAIL']` | Same |

## Order backend

> Source: `inc/listing.orders.inc.php`, `inc/show.orders.inc.php`, `inc/processing.orders.inc.php`

The Orders tab (`...&controller=order`) lists orders — the status values `ARCHIVED` and `CLOSED` are excluded — sorted by date descending. Columns: order number (with language flag when language support is on), date, customer, net, gross, payment. Actions: open detail, mailto the customer (subject from language key plus order number), delete. Delete only sets the status to `CLOSED` — order rows are never physically removed.

The order detail shows the invoice address including custom fields, the position table with option-resolved prices (a `=` price modifier replaces the base price again at display time), the sum rows for subtotal, shipping, discount and low order surcharge, and both stored mails. Status buttons switch flags `PAYED`, `SENT`, `RETURN`, `COMPLETED`; the status is stored as a dash-joined combination of these flags, initially `NEW-ORDER`.

## Order API

> Source: `api.shop.php` (site root)

The JSON order API activates with `shop_pref_api_access`; a request must pass GET/POST `api` matching `shop_pref_api_key` (auto-generated from URL + database password when enabled empty). Action `getorders` returns all orders with status `NEW-ORDER` as JSON — order ids obfuscated with `md5`, positions carrying option-resolved prices and the option/order-number basis split, plus custom fields — and converts output to UTF-8. The action `setstatus` is listed in the API grammar but not implemented.

## Storage

> Source: `setup/default_sql/phpwcms_init.sql` line 717

Orders live in `phpwcms_shop_orders`:

| Column | Type | Contents |
| ------ | ---- | -------- |
| `order_id` | int | Row id |
| `order_number` | varchar(20) | Order number, indexed with status |
| `order_date` | datetime | Order time |
| `order_name`, `order_firstname`, `order_email` | varchar(255) | Customer identity |
| `order_net`, `order_gross` | float | Totals |
| `order_payment` | varchar(255) | Payment method and data |
| `order_data` | mediumtext | Serialized order payload: positions, options, address, both mails |
| `order_status` | varchar(100) | Status combination (see above) |

- [Shop](01-shop.md) — activation, preferences, content part
- [Shop catalog](02-shop-catalog.md) — products, categories, tables
- [Shop product options](04-shop-options.md) — option engine, price modifiers

# Shop options

> Source: `include/inc_module/mod_shop/inc/functions.global.inc.php`, `frontend.render.php`, `inc/cnt.form.php`

Product options of the [shop module](01-shop.md) exist in two dimensions — option 1 and option 2 — defined as plain lines in the product form, priced and rendered as dropdowns, and extended by per-action options on the shop content part.

## Defining product options

> Source: `inc/edit.products.inc.php`, `inc/processing.products.inc.php`

Option 1 stores in `shopprod_size`, option 2 in `shopprod_color` — both textareas on the product form. Each holds one option per line:

- The **first line** is the dropdown title (for example "Size").
- Every following line defines a selectable value in the format `Description|price|ADD`, described below.
- Once an option list has more than three lines, the values are sorted naturally; the title line stays first.

Both dimensions render as a single `<select>` dropdown each — no checkbox, radio or free-text option types exist. When a product defines options, the cart requires a selection (a product without option lines skips the selects).

### Option line format

> Source: `inc/functions.global.inc.php` (`get_shop_option_value()`)

```text
Description|price|ADD
```

| Part | Contents |
| ---- | -------- |
| `Description` | Option label shown in the dropdown |
| `price` | Price modifier, optional: `-50.00` subtracts from the base price, `=99.00` replaces the base price, any other value adds to it. Empty price = no modification (surcharge display controlled by the `price_option_null` template CONFIG key) |
| `ADD` | Optional string appended to the product order number for the cart position, for example `XL` |

Price parsing is lenient: commas become decimal points, thousands dots are stripped, remaining non-numeric characters removed.

### Rendered output

The cart form renders `prod_opt1` / `prod_opt2` selects; each option element carries `data-type` and `data-price` attributes, and the enclosing form holds a `data-prices` JSON (net / gross / VAT / weight per variant) that client side code uses to display the recalculated price. Relevant template CONFIG keys on the shop template (or content part custom INI):

| Key | Purpose |
| --- | ------- |
| `price_option_null` | Show options with zero price |
| `price_option_prefix` / `price_option_suffix` | Markup around the shown option surcharge (default `, ` and ` {$}` — space plus currency symbol) |
| `price_option_hide` | Never show option surcharges |
| `class_product_option_1` / `class_product_option_2` | CSS classes for the selects |
| `product_option_1_prefix` / `product_option_1_suffix` / `product_option_1_required` (same for option 2) | Wrapper markup and required flag around the option selects |
| `amount_input_position` | Position of the quantity input relative to the option blocks: `before`, `between`, `after` |
| `class_form_product_cart_option` | Cart form class |
| `class_request_form`, `class_request_button`, `class_cart_add_button` | Request/cart form and button classes |

The template marker `<!-- SHOW-AMOUNT -->` inside the `[CART_ADD]` block turns the quantity field into a visible text input instead of the default hidden input.

### Cart integration

The chosen options change the cart position:

- The option price modifier recalculates the price (option resolve happens again on the order display, so `=` still replaces the base price there).
- The `ADD` suffix appends to the order number of the cart position (`inc/cart.items.inc.php`).
- Options add to the session key structure `products[product][option1][option2]`, so each variant is its own cart position — see [Shop ordering](03-shop-ordering.md#cart-mechanics).

### On request products

A product flagged on request replaces the cart form with a request link: the link URL supports the placeholders `{PRODUCT}` (product name) and `{NUM}` (order number); `[ON_REQUEST]...[ON_REQUEST_ELSE]...[/ON_REQUEST]` and `[ON_REQUEST_LINK]` switch template sections. A product also switches to request mode when its computed net price equals the template CONFIG value `on_request_trigger` (`frontend.render.php`), a deliberate price threshold style.

## Content part options and accordion

> Source: `inc/cnt.form.php`, `inc/cnt.post.php`, `inc/cnt.sql.php`

The shop [content part](01-shop.md#shop-content-part-plug-in-type-30) form selects the action and carries per-action options, grouped in a Bootstrap accordion whose panels show or hide with the selected action (groups marked with `data-shop-action`):

> **Note:** Since 2.0, this form carries the action-specific options accordion and the custom INI overrides panel (added in commit c25dbef89).

| Action | Options in the panel |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| `categories`, `category` | `cat_all` — "all products" item label (default `@@All products@@`); `cat_all_pos` — position `bottom` (default), `top`, `none`; `cat_count_products` — enable product counts in the menu; `cat_list_products` — render a product list inside the menu |
| `category` | Category picker selecting the menu root |
| `productlist` | `cat_list_sort_by` — product sort whitelist (`shopprod_name1`, `shopprod_ordernumber ASC/DESC`, `shopprod_created DESC/ASC`, `shopprod_track_view DESC`); `image_list_width`, `image_list_height`, `image_list_crop`, `image_list_lightbox` — list image sizing |
| `order` | `order_number_style` — order number format, see [order page](03-shop-ordering.md#checkout-flow) |
| `smallcart` | `cart_url` — target link of the small cart |

Additional fields on the form:

- **Template select** — overrides the shop template file (`default.html`, `en.html`, `de.html` shipped in `include/inc_module/mod_shop/template/`).
- **Custom INI overrides** (`shop_config`) — a textarea merged over the CONFIG block of the chosen template at render time (`frontend.render.php`); the form displays the template's CONFIG block as reference.

The content part saves its settings serialized in the article content part row (`acontent_form`); the frontend content part emits only its replacement tag — see the tag table on the [overview page](01-shop.md#shop-content-part-plug-in-type-30).

## Related

- [Shop catalog](02-shop-catalog.md) — product form
- [Shop ordering](03-shop-ordering.md) — cart positions, price calculation

<!-- docs/modules/05-calendar.md -->

# Calendar

> Source: `include/inc_module/mod_calendar/`

The calendar module stores dated entries — events with start/end, location, description and images — in the backend and renders them on frontend pages through the `{CALENDAR}` replacement tag. Module registration (`module.default.php`): `$_module_name = 'calendar'`, `$_module_type = 0` (backend and frontend), no content part, frontend render hook only.

## Backend

Available to usergroups with the calendar module enabled. URL: `phpwcms.php?do=modules&module=calendar`.

### Listing

`backend.listing.php` shows a month calendar view with prev/next month navigation — the displayed month is kept in the session (`calendardate=MM-YYYY`). A word filter searches title, tag and text; status filter checkboxes limit the view to active or inactive entries. Actions per entry:

| Action | GET parameter | Behavior |
| ------ | ------------- | -------- |
| Activate / deactivate | `verify` | Toggles `calendar_status` between 1 and 0 |
| Edit | `edit` | Opens the entry form; the form's *save entry as duplicate* checkbox stores a copy on save |
| Delete | `delete` | Soft delete — sets `calendar_status = 9` |

The backend loads its CSS from `include/inc_module/mod_calendar/template/backend.calendar.css`.

### Entry form

> Source: `backend.editform.php`, `inc/processing.inc.php`

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Title (what) | text | – | Required; validation error `calendar_title` |
| Start date / time | date pickers | Today / now | `flatpickr` date entry (format `DD.MM.YYYY`), stored as datetime |
| End date / time | date pickers | start + 1 hour | Stored as datetime |
| All day | checkbox | off | Hides the time inputs, sets `calendar_allday` |
| Repeats | select | 0 = Does not repeat | 0–16: daily (1), Mon–Fri (2), Mon/Wed/Fri (3), Tue/Thu (4), weekly (5), monthly (6), yearly (7), individual weekdays (8–14), Wed–Sun (15), weekend (16); values above 16 reset to 0 |
| Repeat period | date range | – | Shown only when a repeat interval is selected; start and end date bound the repeats |
| Where | text, max 220 chars | – | Location; doubles as frontend `place` filter value |
| Calendar (tags) | tag list | – | Comma separated tag list, autosuggest select |
| Language | text | – | Autosuggest, characters outside `a-z` and `-` stripped |
| AID / alias / URL | text, max 500 chars | – | Frontend target for entry links (`calendar_refid`) |
| Teaser text | textarea | – | Short text for list views |
| Description | WYSIWYG | – | Full entry text, edited with the backend WYSIWYG editor |
| Image | image select + zoom/lightbox/caption/link | – | Serialized image data stored in `calendar_object` |
| Status | checkbox | – | Active state (`calendar_status`, 0/1) |
| Save as duplicate | checkbox | – | Stores the entry again as a new copy |

An entry needs start or end within the selected range to appear in frontend queries; the frontend query requires `calendar_status = 1`.

## Frontend

> Source: `frontend.render.php`, `inc/calendar.class.php`

The render hook parses `{CALENDAR:...}` tags in the finished page markup (registered through `$_module_fe_render`).

### Tag syntax

Two syntaxes exist, chosen by whether an `=` appears in the tag body:

```text
{CALENDAR:items = 10
template = calendar.tmpl
place = Town}

{CALENDAR:count, [template], [lang], [href], [tags]: [date_start], [date_end], [place]}
```

The first is INI style with newline separated `key = value` pairs, the second positional — square brackets mark optional values.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Value | Description |
| --------- | ----- | ----------- |
| `items` | int | Maximum entries (positional variant: `count`) |
| `template` | text | Template file name, see [Templates](#templates) |
| `lang` | text | Restrict to one language |
| `tag` / `tagmode` | text / `OR`,`AND` | Filter by tag and match mode |
| `href` | text | Fallback link target |
| `place` | text | Restrict to entries with this `where` value |
| `gettype` | text | Character that splits `calendar_title` into `{TITLE}` and `{TYPE}` |
| `teaserwords` | int | Truncate teaser to this word count |
| `width`, `height`, `crop` | int / int / int | Image dimensions for the entry image |
| `expired` | `hide`, `top`, `bottom` | Where expired entries go |
| `expired_date` | `START`, `END` | Which date decides expiration |
| `expired_prefix`, `expired_suffix` | text | Markup wrapped around expired entries |
| `date_start`, `date_end` | see below | Date range for the query |

Date values for `date_start` accept `TODAY`, `WEEKSTART`, `MONTHSTART`, `YEARSTART` or any `strtotime` string; `date_end` accepts an integer (days added to start), `TODAY`, `WEEKEND`, `MONTHEND`, `YEAREND`, or a relative value like `7 DAYS`, `2 WEEKS`, `3 MONTHS`.

Site visitors can change the range: GET, POST or session parameters with the `pcal_` basis (`pcal_limit`, `pcal_place`, `pcal_start`, `pcal_end`) override the tag values for the request (session `$_SESSION['pcal']`); the `{CALENDAR_RESET}` tag link clears them.

The query selects entries with status 1 where the repeat range start is not after the requested period end and the repeat range end is not before the period start, ordered by `calendar_start` ascending.

### Item template tags

| Tag | Contents |
| --- | -------- |
| `{ID}`, `{GROUP}`, `{URL}`, `{TARGET}`, `{TITLE}`, `{TYPE}` | Entry id, repeat group, link, title parts (see `gettype`) |
| `{TEASER}`, `{TEXT}`, `{PLACE}`, `{ALLDAY}` | Text fields and all-day flag |
| `{IMAGE}` and `{IMAGE_ID}`, `{IMAGE_NAME}`, `{IMAGE_ALT}`, `{IMAGE_TITLE}`, `{IMAGE_TEXT}`, `{IMAGE_COPYRIGHT}`, `{IMAGE_URL}`, `{IMAGE_URL_TARGET}`, `{IMAGE_LIGHTBOX}`, `{IMAGE_LINK}`, `{IMAGE_LINK_TARGET}` | Image fields |
| `{RANGEDATE}`, `{STARTDATE}`, `{ENDDATE}` | Dates; note `{STARTDATE`/`{ENDDATE` written without closing brace in template files are remapped to the date renderer |
| `{CALENDAR_RESET}` | Link resetting visitor range selections |

### Templates

> Source: `inc/calendar.class.php`

Template files resolve in this order: first `include/inc_module/mod_calendar/template/<name>`, then `template/calendar/<name>` in the site layout directory. A sample ships as `include/inc_module/mod_calendar/template/calendar.tmpl`; when no template is set, a hardcoded default markup renders the list.

## Storage

> Source: `setup/default_sql/phpwcms_init.sql` line 274

Entries live in `phpwcms_calendar`: `calendar_id`, `calendar_created`, `calendar_changed`, `calendar_status` (0 inactive, 1 active, 9 deleted), `calendar_start`, `calendar_end`, `calendar_allday`, `calendar_range` (0–16 repeat interval), `calendar_range_start`, `calendar_range_end`, `calendar_title`, `calendar_where`, `calendar_teaser`, `calendar_text`, `calendar_tag`, `calendar_object` (longtext, serialized image data), `calendar_refid`, `calendar_lang`.

Tags are stored as entries in the core category tree `phpwcms_categories` with `cat_type = 'calendar'`; the entry id is the parent id of the tag rows. There is no dedicated calendar category table and no separate categories management UI — tags are managed on the entry form.

## Configuration

The module registers no own configuration keys. Backend access follows the module group in the usergroup editor — see [Modules overview](index.md).

## Related

- [Modules overview](index.md) — architecture and activation
- [Glossary](13-glossary.md) — the other module with frontend replacement rendering beyond content parts

<!-- docs/modules/06-newsletter.md -->

# Newsletter

> Source: `include/inc_act/`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt12.article.inc.php`, `include/inc_lib/backend.functions.inc.php`

The newsletter is not a module — it belongs to the core. It provides backend subscription management, newsletter creation and queue based sending (backend menu **Communication**), plus the self-registering subscribe form for the frontend as content part type 12 ("Newsletter"). Backend visibility requires `$phpwcms['enable_backend_newsletter']` (default true, `include/config/dist.conf.inc.php` line 165) and the usergroup `nl` group membership; its pages are admin-only (`$_SESSION['wcs_user_admin']`), and the send action additionally requires the `nl` or `adm` admin permission (`act_sendnewsletter.php`). There is no `{SUBSCRIBE}` replacement tag — subscription happens only through content part 12.

See [Modules overview](index.md) for how the menu is gated; the module group mechanism does not apply here.

## Backend

URL root: `phpwcms.php?do=messages`, pages by `p` parameter:

| Page | Contents |
| ---- | -------- |
| `p=2` Newsletter subscriptions | Subscription lists (`phpwcms_subscription`): add, edit, delete, active toggle; shows per-list recipient count via `countNewsletterRecipients()` |
| `p=3` Newsletter | Newsletter overview with paging; duplicate an entry; edit form; sending view |
| `p=4` Newsletter subscribers | Subscriber list from `phpwcms_address`: verify toggle, delete (removes duplicate emails by that address), edit form, CSV import |

### Newsletter form

> Source: `include/inc_tmpl/newsletter.form.tmpl.php` and the form processing

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Subject | text | – | Required |
| Publication date | date | – | Shown in the overview |
| Language | text | – | Newsletter language |
| Sender name | text | – | `from_name` |
| Sender email | text | – | Validated |
| Reply-to | text | – | Validated |
| HTML body | textarea | – | HTML email content |
| Text body | textarea | – | Plain text content |
| Template name | text | – | Optional template file, see [Sending](#sending) |
| Active | checkbox | off | Activation triggers queue building |
| Subscriptions | list select | all | Recipients limited to chosen subscription lists (0 = all) |

Saving serializes the form into `phpwcms_newsletter.newsletter_vars`.

### Sending

> Source: `include/inc_act/act_sendnewsletter.php`, `include/inc_tmpl/newsletter.send.tmpl.php`

Activating a newsletter builds the send queue: it takes verified addresses (`address_verified = 1`) matching the chosen subscription lists and inserts rows into `phpwcms_newsletterqueue` in chunks of 100. Queue states: 0 = unsent, 1 = sent, 2 = error (message stored in `queue_errormsg`), 3 = reset (never send; re-activating an existing newsletter resets old unsent rows to this state). Deactivating deletes unsent rows.

Actual sending is browser driven — there is no cron. The send view loads `act_sendnewsletter.php` in an iframe loop with `loop`/`pause` GET parameters; each batch marks `newsletter_lastsending`. A test-email mode (`send_testemail`, comma/semicolon separated list) sends without touching the queue. Confirmed sends join `phpwcms_address` with `phpwcms_newsletterqueue` (`queue_status = 0`, `queue_pid` = newsletter id) in batches, default loop size 25 or 500, using the `PhpwcmsMailer` with SMTP keep-alive.

Placeholders the sender resolves per recipient:

| Placeholder | Contents |
| ----------- | -------- |
| `###RECIPIENT_NAME###` / `###RECIPIENT_EMAIL###` | Subscriber data |
| `###SITE_URL###` | Site URL |
| `###VERIFY_LINK###` / `###DELETE_LINK###` | Verify / delete links of the subscription |
| `###OPENER###` | Tracking image `verify.php?o=<queue_id>` — increments `queue_opener` |

When the newsletter carries a template name, `template/inc_newsletter/<name>/newsletter.tmpl` is loaded. Its `<!--HTML-->` and `<!--TEXT-->` sections wrap `{CONTENT}` with the layout; relative URLs in the HTML body are made absolute. When a recipient has no HTML mail set up, the HTML body is converted to text.

### Subscribers and double opt-in

Subscribers are stored per email in `phpwcms_address` along with the serialization of their subscription choices. The opt-in flow:

1. The [content part 12](#content-part-12-newsletter-subscription) form posts email, name and per-list checkboxes.
2. The address row is inserted or updated with `address_verified = 0` and a random verification key; the registration mail links `{NEWSLETTER_VERIFY}` and `{NEWSLETTER_DELETE}`.
3. `verify.php` — the same script in the site root — processes the key: `s=` sets `address_verified = 1`, `u=` deletes the address row, `o=` counts the open.

Backend edits can set the verified state directly; the subscriber CSV import expects the email address in the first column.

## Content part 12 (Newsletter subscription)

> Source: `include/inc_tmpl/content/cnt12.inc.php`, `include/inc_front/content/cnt12.article.inc.php`

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Subscriptions | list select | all | Which lists the visitor can pick (0 = all) |
| Label overrides | text | – | Custom labels for email, name, subscription group and "all" entry |
| Button text | text | – | Submit button label |
| Table align | select | 0–3 | Positioning of the form table |
| Info text | textarea | – | Shown above the form |
| Success text | textarea | – | Shown after successful registration |
| URL 1 / URL 2 | text | – | Stored as address `url1` / `url2` |
| reCAPTCHA | select | off | 0 = off, 1 = checkbox, 2 = invisible; with config textarea `site_key = `, `secret_key = `, `type = image` |
| Mail texts | textareas | – | Custom registration / change of subscription mail body |
| Logoff text | textarea | – | Unsubscribe mail text |

The public form renders name and email inputs, the subscription checkboxes and the submit button. Mail texts accept the parser tags `{NEWSLETTER_NAME}`, `{NEWSLETTER_EMAIL}`, `{NEWSLETTER_VERIFY}`, `{NEWSLETTER_DELETE}`, `{IP}`, `{DATE:m/d/Y}` and the `[SUBJECT]...[/SUBJECT]` block. The verify/delete links point at the site root `verify.php` handled as described above.

## Storage

> Source: `setup/default_sql/phpwcms_init.sql` lines 4, 656, 670, 775

| Table | Columns | Contents |
| ----- | ------- | -------- |
| `phpwcms_address` | `address_id`, `address_key`, `address_email`, `address_name`, `address_verified`, `address_tstamp`, `address_subscription` (serialized, blob), `address_iddetail`, `address_url1`, `address_url2` | Subscribers |
| `phpwcms_newsletter` | `newsletter_id`, created, `newsletter_lastsending`, `newsletter_pub`, lang, subject, changed, `newsletter_vars` (mediumblob), trashed, active | Newsletter entries |
| `phpwcms_newsletterqueue` | `queue_id`, created, changed, `queue_status`, `queue_pid` (newsletter), `queue_rid` (address), `queue_errormsg`, `queue_opener` | Send queue |
| `phpwcms_subscription` | `subscription_id`, name, info (blob), active, lang, tstamp | Subscription lists |

Subscriber rows share the `phpwcms_address` table with the frontend login's user-details relationship only through `address_iddetail` — contact records of the [Addresses](09-addresses.md) module are unrelated.

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `$phpwcms['enable_backend_newsletter']` | bool | true | Enables the Communication menu (`include/config/dist.conf.inc.php` line 165) |
| `$phpwcms['SMTP_*']` keys | text | – | Mail server settings used by the sender (same block, lines 170–185) |

## Related

- [Modules overview](index.md) — module architecture (newsletter is core, gated like a module menu)
- [Addresses](09-addresses.md) — distinct contact module with its own table
- [Statistics](11-statistic.md) — subscription and log overviews

<!-- docs/modules/07-ads.md -->

# Ads

> Source: `include/inc_module/mod_ads/`

The ads module manages banner campaigns and ad places, delivers them on frontend pages through `{ADS_<id>}` tags and tracks views and clicks. Module registration (`module.default.php`): `$_module_name = 'ads'`, `$_module_type = 0` (backend and frontend), no content part, frontend init and render hooks.

It defines the constant `PHPWCMS_ADS_DIR` from `$phpwcms['ads_path']` (fallback `'ads'`, `module.default.php` line 31) — mainly used to keep ad delivery paths flexible against ad blockers.

## Installation / activation

Ships as part of the codebase; place the module directory under `include/inc_module/` (`include/inc_module/mod_ads/INSTALL.txt`). The backend creates the media directory `content/<ads_path>/` with an `index.html` automatically on first use (`backend.default.php`). Uploaded campaign media land in `content/<ads_path>/<campaign_id>/` with an `.htaccess` denying PHP execution (`processing.campaign.inc.php`).

Backend access follows the module group in the usergroup editor — see [Modules overview](index.md).

## Backend

URL: `phpwcms.php?do=modules&module=ads`. The routing lives in `backend.default.php`: without parameters the campaign list shows; `listadplace` lists ad places; `campaign=1` / `adplace=1` open the respective new-entry forms; `edit`, `verify`, `delete` act on the ids. Deleting is a soft delete (`status = 9`); campaign media files are renamed to a `_deleted_` prefix. Duplicating a campaign copies the row with a title suffix (`_dbDuplicateRow`).

### Campaign form

> Source: `backend.form.campaign.php`, `inc/processing.campaign.inc.php`

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Title | text | – | Campaign name |
| Adplace | select | – | One of the existing [ad places](#ad-place-form); shows the place size read-only |
| Target URL | text | – | Link target of the banner |
| Target | select | – | Window target: `_blank`, `_top`, `_self`, `_parent` |
| Start date / time | date picker | – | `DD.MM.YYYY` / `HH:MM` entry |
| End date / time | date picker | – | Same format |
| Max views | number | – | Delivery stops when reached |
| Max clicks | number | – | Delivery stops when reached |
| Max views per visitor | number | – | Per-visitor cap, counted via tracking cookie |
| Ad type | radio | image (0) | 0 = image, 1 = video, 2 = HTML, 3 = HTML5 package, 4 = remote HTML |
| Media | file select/upload | – | Per type: image (GIF/JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP), video (MP4/WebM), HTML5 zip package (extracted server side; its CSS gets an entry field) |
| HTML | textarea | – | Raw HTML for types 2 and 4 |
| Alt / title text | text | – | Image HTML attributes |
| Background / border color | color | – | Wrapper box colors |
| Comment | textarea | – | Internal note |
| Activate | checkbox | – | Campaign state |
| Save as duplicate | checkbox | – | Stores a copy on save |

Media metadata is stored serialized in the campaign's `adcampaign_data` column.

### Ad place form

> Source: `backend.form.adplace.php`

Ad places define the slot: a title, a format from `phpwcms_ads_formats` (user-created; no seed data ships), width and height shown read-only from the format, optional HTML prefix and suffix wrapping the output, the ready-to-copy banner code `{ADS_<id>}`, and a status switch.

## Frontend

> Source: `frontend.render.php`, `inc/ads.fe_render.inc.php`

Any `{ADS_<id>}` placeholder in the page markup triggers delivery (regex `/\\{ADS_(\\d+)\\}/`) of a matching campaign:

- Delivery selects randomly (`array_rand`) among campaigns of that ad place that are active, inside their date window, and under their max views, max clicks and per-visitor caps. Bot user agents and unknown browsers (`BROWSER_OS` = `Other`) receive nothing.
- Per-visitor view counting uses the tracking cookie set by the module's delivery logic.
- Output shapes by ad type: `<a><img>` for images; `<video autoplay muted loop playsinline>` with poster fallback for videos; HTML rendered inside a colored box; HTML5 packages inside an iframe with `clickTag=` appended; remote HTML inserted raw.
- When at least one ad rendered, a view tracking pixel `img/blank.php?t=...` is appended to the page.
- Renders skip ad-specific URL paths — together with the configurable `PHPWCMS_ADS_DIR` this reduces ad-blocker collisions.

### Click tracking

Banner clicks route through `index.php?adclickval=<id>&url=...`. The init hook (`inc/ads.fe_init.inc.php`) validates the `u` parameter against the visitor cookie key, counts the click in `phpwcms_ads_tracking`, increments the campaign click counter and redirects to the target URL. The view counter runs in the site root script `img/blank.php`, which anonymizes IPs when the constant `PHPWCMS_GDPR_MODE` is defined — set through `$phpwcms['enable_GDPR']` (default true, `include/config/dist.conf.inc.php` line 158) — and sets a two-year cookie.

## Storage

> Source: `setup/default_sql/phpwcms_init.sql` lines 18–82

| Table | Contents |
| ----- | -------- |
| `phpwcms_ads_campaign` | Campaigns: title, comment, date start/end, max view/click/visitor caps plus current counters, type, place reference, serialized `adcampaign_data` |
| `phpwcms_ads_place` | Ad places: title, format reference, HTML prefix/suffix, status |
| `phpwcms_ads_formats` | Format definitions (width/height); user created, none seeded |
| `phpwcms_ads_tracking` | Per-visit tracking rows: campaign id, ip, cookie id, click and view counts, user agent, referrer, category id, article id |

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `$phpwcms['ads_path']` | string | `'marketing'` | Directory below `content/` for campaign media (`include/config/dist.conf.inc.php` line 48) |

## Related

- [Modules overview](index.md) — architecture and activation
- [Statistics](11-statistic.md) — module-independent backend dashboards

<!-- docs/modules/08-feedimport.md -->

# Feed import

> Source: `include/inc_module/mod_feedimport/`

The feed import module turns RSS/Atom feed items into phpwcms articles. Imports run on request of a trigger URL, not on a cron schedule. Module registration (`module.default.php`): `$_module_name = 'feedimport'`, `$_module_type = 1` (backend only), no content part, frontend init hook.

## Storage

> Source: `inc/processing.inc.php`

Feed definitions have no own table. Each feed is a row in `phpwcms_content` with `cnt_module = 'feedimport'`:

| Column | Contents |
| ------ | -------- |
| `cnt_text` | Feed URL |
| `cnt_prio` | Update interval in seconds (0 = import off) |
| `cnt_sort` | Timestamp of the last import |
| `cnt_object` | Serialized configuration from the [feed form](#feed-form) |

Deleting a feed sets `cnt_status = 9`.

## Backend

Available to usergroups with the feed import module enabled. URL: `phpwcms.php?do=modules&module=feedimport`. The routing (GET parameter `edit`, `active` toggle, else listing) lives in `backend.default.php`.

### Feed form

> Source: `inc/processing.inc.php`, `backend.editform.php`

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| Title | text | – | Feed name in the listing |
| Feed URL | text | – | Validated as URL; reachable via HEAD request with HTTP 200 check |
| Category | select | – | Structure level the imported articles land in |
| Detail template | select | – | Article summary templates from `template/inc_cntpart/articlesummary/` |
| List template | select | – | Article list templates from the same source |
| Image folder | select | – | File storage directory where enclosure images are stored |
| Image URL replace | text | – | `search>replace` string pair applied to image URLs |
| Enable custom update intervals | checkbox + select | 14400 (4 hours) | Interval for the next import, 60 seconds to 1 month |
| Set new articles visible by default | checkbox | off | Initial visibility of imported articles |
| Author | select | – | Backend user set as article author |
| Fallback author name | text | – | Used when no backend user is selected |
| Source link | checkbox + text | on, `@@Source@@` | Appends a source link to the article text |
| Status email | text | – | Optional notification address receiving the import log |
| Active | checkbox | on | Feed participates in imports |

The form shows the read-only trigger URL: `index.php?feedimport=<md5 of cnt_id + cnt_text>`.

## Import flow

> Source: `frontend.init.php`, `inc/functions.inc.php`

1. A request to the trigger URL (or `index.php?feedimport=<hash>-now`, which bypasses the interval) matches the hash against active feed rows. The interval gate compares the stored last-import timestamp against `cnt_prio` when the standard interval is not overridden.
2. The feed is fetched and parsed with SimplePie, cache disabled.
3. Each item is checked against `phpwcms_crossreference` with `cref_type = 'feed_to_article_import'`; the reference id hashes feed URL, item title and item date, so repeated imports skip known items.
4. Matching items create a new article: the item date becomes the article start date, the summary serves as article summary, and the cleaned body goes into a first content part — either WYSIWYG HTML (type 14) or plain text (type 0).
5. The optional source link is appended with the class `feed-permalink`; enclosure imagery is downloaded into the file storage (`phpwcms_file`, inserted with parent directory `f_kid = 1`) and attached as serialized article image.
6. When a status email is configured, the import log is mailed; the script terminates after the import.

There is no scheduled execution in the module itself — the trigger URL has to be requested (manually or by an external scheduler/cron hitting the URL).

## Frontend

The `frontend.init` registration is the mechanism above: it reacts on the `feedimport` GET parameter before the page renders and then exits. Imported articles render like any other article — see [Core concepts](../general/concepts.md).

## Configuration

The module registers no `phpwcms` configuration keys. Update intervals live per feed in the feed form. Backend access follows the module group in the usergroup editor — see [Modules overview](index.md).

## Related

- [Modules overview](index.md) — architecture and activation
- [Calendar](05-calendar.md) — the other module driven by time-based processing
